7067C3.text:
Regina
Prince, are you really listening? We've only just begun!

70681C.text:
Regina
You'll be king of Arcadia one day...

706850.text:
Regina
So please pay attention to your lessons.

706894.text:
Regina
Now, back to where we left off yesterday.{page}Regina
The Royal Chronicle, Chapter Eight...

7068DE.text:
Regina
...And so, diplomatic ties were established with the Republic.

706917.text:
Regina
All right. Let's take a short break.

7069C7.text:
Regina
Don't leave this room! Is that clear, Prince {player}?

706A91.text:
Jack
You've slipped out of your lessons again, haven't you?

706AF4.text:
Jack
...Oh, dear. I can just picture Regina's face.

706B33.text:
Jack
Don't make things difficult for her, Prince.

706B69.text:
Jack
A prince should look out for the people who look after him.

706C2B.text:
Earth
Don't see you around here often.

706D22.text:
Earth
Unless you'd rather train with me...?

706D82.text:
Regina
Prince! I told you to stay in your room!{page}Regina
You aren't trying to skip class, are you?

706DE3.text:
Royal Guard
His Majesty's inspecting the castle.

706E1E.text:
Royal Guard
I believe he's in the room at the back.

706E50.text:
Royal Guard
Oh, and he was looking for you, Prince {player}.

706EBB.text:
{player}
You wanted to see me, Father?

706ED3.text:
King of Arcadia
How are your studies?

706EFB.text:
King of Arcadia
Are you listening to what the Three Beast Knights teach?

706F6F.text:
King of Arcadia
One day, you'll take my place as--

70701F.text:
Regina
So this is where you've been hiding! Skipping lessons again!

70705D.text:
Regina
Oh! Y-Your Majesty! Forgive me!

7070C0.text:
Regina
I'm in charge of the prince's lessons. This is my fault!

707113.text:
Regina
Whatever punishment you see fit--

707195.text:
King of Arcadia
That's enough. Now, {player}...

7071C1.text:
King of Arcadia
...the future king of Arcadia.

7071F1.text:
King of Arcadia
What is your duty? To run around playing?

707252.text:
King of Arcadia
No. It's to protect this kingdom and keep its people safe.

707299.text:
King of Arcadia
And to guard the ancient legacy hidden deep within this castle.

7072E2.text:
King of Arcadia
Its secrets are ours to protect.

70731A.text:
King of Arcadia
...The peace we have now won't last forever.

707356.text:
King of Arcadia
It depends on a fragile balance between the Republic{page}King of Arcadia
and the Empire.

7073B1.text:
King of Arcadia
If either gains the upper hand... Or if another power emerges...

7073FC.text:
King of Arcadia
...that alone could destroy the balance.

707502.text:
King of Arcadia
What's going on?!

70752A.text:
Soldier
W-We're under attack! They've caught us by surprise!

7075AE.text:
Soldier
They're attacking from the south!{page}Soldier
They're breaking through the walls!

7076D1.text:
Soldier
The Imperial army! They're coming in from the north!

7077AE.text:
King of Arcadia
Wait! All three of you!

707803.text:
King of Arcadia
Take {player} and escape.

7078CC.text:
King of Arcadia
...They're after the ancient legacy.

707908.text:
King of Arcadia
Then you three must protect it, along with {player}!

70794D.text:
The Three Beast Knights
Yes, Your Majesty!

70799B.text:
King of Arcadia
The Three Beast Knights are sworn to protect you.{page}King of Arcadia
But remember: as their prince, you must protect them, too.

707A39.text:
King of Arcadia
Now go! ...Forgive me for placing such a burden on you.

707AC0.text:
Regina
Prince, hurry! Down to the basement!

707B8D.text:
Armored Man
Just surround the castle!

707BC5.text:
Their Leader
Secure the basement first...

707C4D.text:
Regina
Who are they?{page}Regina
They aren't Imperial or Republican soldiers...

707C92.text:
Jack
We can talk about that later.

707CBE.text:
Jack
Right now, we need to get out of here.

707D11.text:
Regina
You're right. Come on, Prince.

707DB8.text:
Jack
Zoids... They're rather old, though.

707E1C.text:
Regina
We can't afford to be picky.

707E4C.text:
Earth
Let's see if they work...

707EA9.text:
Regina
Prince, you remember what I told you about the Zoid{page}Regina
Commander, don't you?

707F1B.text:
Regina
I asked you to keep it on so it could learn{page}Regina
your thought patterns.

707FA9.text:
Regina
Yes, that thing on your head!

707FDC.text:
Regina
It sends your thoughts to the Zoid and helps you control it.

70803B.text:
Regina
With that, even you should be able to manage...

7080AB.text:
Regina
Don't give me that look!

7080D1.text:
Regina
If you hadn't kept skipping practice, {player},{page}Regina
we wouldn't be in this mess!

708139.text:
Regina
Now, as for which Zoid you'll pilot...

70817B.text:
Earth
We're in luck. They all work.

7081B0.text:
Jack
Prince, we're running out of time.

7081D8.text:
Jack
Please choose a Zoid to pilot.

708226.text:
Regina
This is a Shield Liger.{page}Regina
A fast combat Zoid with excellent defense.

708277.text:
Regina
Its E-Shield protects it from damage.

7082BA.text:
Regina
Will you pilot this Zoid?

7082F3.text:
Earth
This is a Zaber Fang. Fast, and it hits hard.

708342.text:
Earth
A fine Zoid. It used to be the backbone of the Imperial army.

70838A.text:
Earth
Will you pilot this Zoid?

7083C1.text:
Jack
This is a Raynos. It's built for high-speed aerial combat.

7083FE.text:
Jack
Flying Zoids can only use their built-in weapons.

708443.text:
Jack
But they're hard to hit without anti-air weapons.

708486.text:
Jack
Will you pilot this Zoid?

7084BF.text:
Earth
...All set. Our Zoids are loaded, too.

70855D.text:
Jack
Just relax. You'll be fine.

7085D0.text:
Earth
No time to load the remaining Zoids...

70867F.text:
{player}
Right! We're getting out of the castle! Gustav, move out!

7086A1.text:
Jack
Still... who were those people back there?

7086EA.text:
Earth
Don't know. They're the enemy. That's enough.

708716.text:
Jack
...As blunt as ever. What do you think, Regina?

708765.text:
Regina
I've never seen them before. But right now...

7087B2.text:
Jack
Of course. First, we escape and regroup...

708809.text:
Earth
Then we take back the castle!

708856.text:
Regina
And the royal family's legacy...

70888A.text:
Jack
The king mentioned that, too. What exactly is this legacy?

7088E9.text:
Regina
I don't know much about it myself...

708911.text:
Regina
Only that it's in a sealed room in the castle...

708964.text:
Earth
We'll find out when we take the castle back.

7089C6.text:
Regina
...Earth's right. Worrying won't help us now.

708A1D.text:
Jack
This tunnel goes on forever. Where does it lead?

708B09.text:
Regina
Let's head for Arcana. It's the nearest town.

708B59.text:
Regina
Prince! First, we need to find out what the enemy's doing{page}Regina
beyond the space-time transporter!

708BA4.text:
Regina
Please remember what we came here to do!

708BDF.text:
Earth
Not yet, Prince.{page}Earth
Our chance to take back the castle will come.

708C31.text:
Jack
Looks like the Emperor's army has put everything into{page}Jack
defending the castle.

708C73.text:
Jack
We'll take it back soon, Prince. I'm sure of it.

708D07.text:
Regina
I suppose they weren't going to leave us an easy way back in...

708D56.text:
Jack
Let's split up and see what's happening in town.

708DF8.text:
Earth
...Putting on quite a show, aren't they?

708E58.text:
Jack
They want everyone to know who's in charge now.

708EC7.text:
Captain
You there! Don't you know there's a curfew?!

708F5F.text:
Soldier 2
We'll throw you in jail!

708FBF.text:
Jack
We've only just arrived from the countryside...

709005.text:
Captain
The countryside? Where? What brings you to Arcadia?

70905E.text:
Jack
Well, you see... Up north... Over the mountains...

7090B2.text:
Captain
Spit it out! Men, take them away!

709101.text:
Jack
W-Wait! We're just travelers! Really!

709179.text:
Old Man
Well, if it isn't T-Thomas! I've been waiting for you!

7091C8.text:
Jack
Huh? Oh! U-Uncle! It's been ages! We just got here!

70921C.text:
Captain
Who are you? You know these people?

709262.text:
Old Man
My name's Roman. I look after things here in town.

7092A7.text:
Roman
They're relatives of mine. This is T-Thomas.

709324.text:
Captain
A likely story. Is that true?

709356.text:
Roman
Of course, sir. Here, please take this...

709389.text:
Captain
Hmph! Watch yourselves from now on.

709431.text:
Roman
We shouldn't talk here. Come to my house.

7094AA.text:
Roman
Yes. I served the king of Arcadia.{page}Roman
A long time ago, mind you.

70950D.text:
Regina
Do you know anything about the enemy?{page}Regina
Or what's happened to the castle?

70957A.text:
Roman
I'm afraid I know nothing about the enemy.

7095A6.text:
Roman
The castle went up in flames.{page}Roman
Before we knew it, they'd taken the whole place.

70960D.text:
Roman
And no one knows what's become of the king...

7096CE.text:
Jack
...This isn't good. We have so little to go on.

70970D.text:
Jack
How can we take back the{page}Jack
castle when we don't even know{page}Jack
what they're after?

709753.text:
Roman
...I don't know if it's what they're after, but...

7097BA.text:
Roman
Yes. I heard them talking about a sealed room in the castle.

709817.text:
Regina
A sealed room?! Then they're after the ancient legacy?

709864.text:
{player}
The legacy Father told me about...?

709885.text:
Jack
We can't be sure of that just yet.

7098D4.text:
Earth
It's the only lead we've got.

709902.text:
Jack
...True. And we don't have time to sit here worrying.

70995B.text:
Earth
Right. We'll have to follow it.

7099B3.text:
{player}
Thank you, Roman. But I have to go... I just have to.

7099D5.text:
Jack
...Well, they're certainly in a hurry.

709A15.text:
Earth
Heh. Those two make quite a pair.

709A47.text:
Jack
They do. We'd better catch up. Thank you for everything, sir.

709AC2.text:
Jack
Whew. Security's lighter than I expected.

709B00.text:
Earth
Looks like they're short on troops, too...

709B4B.text:
Regina
Even so, we can't force our way through the main gate.

709B92.text:
Earth
We'd have to leave the Zoids behind.{page}Earth
The four of us wouldn't stand a chance.

709BF1.text:
Regina
We should be able to reach the sealed chamber through the{page}Regina
underground factory entrance on the left...

709C51.text:
Regina
...This passcode will open the door.

709C93.text:
Earth
You know a lot about this place, Regina...

709CCD.text:
Regina
My family studies the ancient legacy.

709D05.text:
Regina
Though Father never told me much about the legacy itself.

709D52.text:
Jack
Then how did his daughter end up becoming a knight?

709DB8.text:
Regina
W-Well, everyone has their strengths and weaknesses!

709E41.text:
Regina
Oh! Forgive me, Prince. Let's go.

709EAE.text:
Regina
This is the sealed... chamber? Where's the royal legacy?

709F5F.text:
Regina
What do you mean?! Did the enemy already--?!

709F97.text:
A Man's Voice
Only just worked it out, have you? Too late, little rats!

709FDD.text:
Blood
The royal legacy, the space-time transporter,{page}Blood
was moved elsewhere long ago!

70A038.text:
Jack
A space-time transporter? That's the royal legacy?!

70A07D.text:
{player}
You...!{page}Blood
What, you didn't know? No matter.{page}Blood
You're all going to die here anyway.

70A0DA.text:
Regina
What are you planning to do with it?! And His Majesty?{page}Regina
What have you done to the king?!

70A145.text:
Blood
I don't owe you an explanation! Enough talk!

70A1A8.text:
Jack
We'll break through! Regina, protect the prince!{page}Jack
Earth, with me!

70A241.text:
Blood
Don't underestimate me! Command Wolf unit, attack!

70A2AC.text:
Jack
The fighting's blasted a hole in the wall?!

70A2EE.text:
Regina
Prince! Everyone! Through that hole!

70A343.text:
Blood
What?! Damn it! Why is there a passage here?!

70A386.text:
Blood
The ruins?! Damn it! My whole plan...

70A3F5.text:
Jack
Wait! Where are we going?!

70A439.text:
Regina
I don't know! We'll have to see where this passage takes us!

70A518.text:
Regina
It's too dangerous to go back!

70A548.text:
Jack
Let's keep following this passage for now.

70A603.text:
Jack
...Let's hope so. We'd better look farther in.

70A66E.text:
Regina
What was that?! And this place...!

70A6D2.text:
Jack
...Yes. It feels just like the sealed chamber...

70A749.text:
Blood
That's right! A space-time transporter!

70A784.text:
Blood
The one in the castle was a copy of this.

70A7B4.text:
Blood
Though it was in much better condition...

70A83F.text:
Blood
The space-time transporter is a relic of the ancient{page}Blood
Zoidians' advanced technology.

70A88C.text:
Blood
With it, you can travel freely between the past{page}Blood
and the future...

70A8E9.text:
Regina
And Arcadia had something like that?!

70A92B.text:
Blood
Arcadia was founded to protect the space-time transporter.

70A9D3.text:
Blood
Think about it. How else could such a tiny kingdom survive{page}Blood
between the Empire and the Republic?

70AA3E.text:
Jack
...A neutral buffer,{page}Jack
to stop either side from opening that Pandora's box...

70AAA3.text:
Blood
Exactly. But that role is over.{page}Blood
We control the space-time transporter now.

70AB08.text:
Blood
And what it brings won't be peace. It'll be chaos.

70ABB6.text:
Blood
Heh heh. We'll use it to build the ultimate Zoid army!

70AC0F.text:
Blood
We'll gather the strongest Zoids from the past and the future!

70AC43.text:
Blood
Then plunge the world into chaos and claim{page}Blood
it for ourselves!

70AC9C.text:
Blood
...we had to get rid of Arcadia's king and take his kingdom.

70ACE5.text:
Blood
That was our Emperor's plan.{page}Blood
And so far, everything's gone exactly as he intended.{page}{player}
The Emperor...?

70AD72.text:
Blood
You won't let us? Hmph. It's too late.

70ADA3.text:
Blood
We Four Generals have already begun our hunt,{page}Blood
using the castle's space-time transporter.

70ADEA.text:
Blood
Another of us has just gone through that device over there.

70AE2D.text:
Blood
It's only a matter of time before our army is complete.

70AE71.text:
Jack
We'll stop you. You won't get away with this.

70AEAD.text:
Blood
Will you? And for the record,{page}Blood
this is the Emperor's ambition. Not mine.

70AF38.text:
Blood
Heh heh... That's none of your concern.

70AF74.text:
Blood
You escaped me once. It won't happen again!

70AFB1.text:
Blood
This place will be your grave!

70B046.text:
Blood
How admirable... Then come at me!

70B08D.text:
Blood
Blood Keel, one of the Four Generals! Here I come!

70B0F8.text:
Blood
What?! The command system hasn't been calibrated?!{page}Blood
Damn that Opis and his shoddy work!

70B15F.text:
Blood
...Then again, I suppose a cheap machine like this could{page}Blood
never keep up with me.

70B1BE.text:
Blood
I'll repay this insult! {player}...{page}Blood
I won't forget you!

70B22A.text:
Regina
A space-time transporter... This is awful!{page}Regina
We've got to do something!

70B2BE.text:
Jack
But how? Where would we even start?

70B302.text:
Regina
Of course! They only just used the device!

70B338.text:
Regina
The destination data might still be there...

70B3A2.text:
Regina
Prince, if we use this device right now, we can follow them.

70B3EB.text:
Regina
...But there's no guarantee we'll be able to come back.

70B434.text:
Regina
What do you want to do, Prince?

70B4C4.text:
Jack
Good grief... He really doesn't hesitate, does he?

70B560.text: Several hours earlier... Arcadia Castle, the Emperor's chamber.

70B593.text:
Fran
We've secured Arcadia Castle, Your Majesty.

70B5D6.text:
Fran
The town is under our control as well.{page}Fran
A curfew is now in effect.

70B61F.text:
Fran
Both armies realized we'd caught them off guard.{page}Fran
They've withdrawn to the border{page}Fran
to avoid destroying each other.

70B688.text:
Emperor
All we needed was for them to give us an opening.

70B6C5.text:
Emperor
Now they can stay out of our way...

70B6F5.text:
Emperor
...Such a drab castle.{page}Emperor
Though I suppose that suits its former master...

70B754.text:
Fran
His former... master, Your Majesty?

70B78A.text:
Emperor
That doesn't concern you. Forget it.

70B7F2.text:
Emperor
Which Zoids deserve to stand at the head of my army?

70B845.text:
Fran
At the head, Your Majesty?

70B87B.text:
Emperor
Indeed... And I don't mean{page}Emperor
cheap, mass-produced machines.

70B8B8.text:
Emperor
I want two proud beasts worthy of leading my army.

70B907.text:
Fran
The Shield Liger and Zaber Fang. And... the Organoids.

70B96A.text:
Emperor
Then go! Cross time itself and find those two Zoids!

70B9D8.text:
Emperor
...Heh heh. Arcadia Castle... I've returned!

70BA17.text:
Emperor
His son escaped, did he? Let's see what he's made of!

70BA54.text:
Emperor
No one... No one will stand in the way of my ambition!

70BB2B.text:
Regina
And another thing! Running off on your own like that--

70BB6E.text:
Jack
Now, Regina. I think he's had enough...

70BBBD.text:
Regina
You stay out of this!

70BC43.text:
Jack
Come on, you two! Earth, stop teasing her.

70BCA8.text:
Jack
Our first priority is to find the Zoid that came{page}Jack
through before us.

70BD55.text:
Jack
What's wrong, Earth? Something bothering you?

70BDC6.text:
Earth
It hasn't been long. They should still be nearby. Let's move.

70BE94.text:
Jack
We seem to be just across the Red River,{page}Jack
on the Republic's side.

70BEE9.text:
Jack
If I remember right,{page}Jack
there's a town called Sand Colony a little farther north.

70BF38.text:
Jack
Let's head there for now.

70BFC4.text:
Regina
...We risked everything to get here.

70C017.text:
Regina
We should find out what the enemy's planning{page}Regina
before we leave.

70C074.text:
Regina
They said they wanted to build the ultimate Zoid army...

70C0B3.text:
Regina
But is that really all they're after?

70C10E.text:
Jack
Who knows? We could always find them and ask.

70C165.text:
Regina
How can you be so casual about this?!

70C191.text:
Jack
Panicking won't help. We still know far too little.

70C1DE.text:
Jack
All we know is what they say they're planning.

70C214.text:
Jack
We don't know who they are, how strong they are... anything.

70C33C.text:
Fran
And what if it was?!

70C3A0.text:
Fran
I don't owe a traitor like you an explanation!

70C40C.text:
Fran
You always do this! That look, as if you've got everything{page}Fran
figured out! Just like back then!

70C46B.text:
Fran
Earth! One day, I'll make you regret it!

70C49E.text:
Fran
I'll make you regret betraying us!

70C518.text:
Regina
Earth! Who was that woman?!

70C56A.text:
Regina
She got away? That's all you've got to say?!

70C5CB.text:
Jack
Calm down... We know which way she went.

70C669.text:
Regina
Earth and that woman... Do they know each other?

70C6CE.text:
Jack
What makes you think that?

70C704.text:
Regina
It sounded like there was something between them.

70C744.text:
Jack
Perhaps. But until Earth decides to tell us himself...

70C7A1.text:
Regina
You're saying we shouldn't ask?

70C7D3.text:
Jack
Exactly. Everyone has a secret or two.

70C91D.text:
Jack
...He seems all right. How about you, little boy?

70C9A0.text:
Van
I'm not a little boy! My name's Van!{page}Van
And this is my partner, Zeke!

70C9E7.text:
Van
Wait! I don't have time for introductions!

70CA1E.text:
Van
I've got to catch that woman!

70CA50.text:
Van
Sorry! I'm in a hurry! Come on, Zeke!

70CA96.text:
Earth
That woman? Does he mean Fran...?

70CACE.text:
Regina
What? Was that boy chasing her, too?

70CB29.text:
Jack
We can't be sure yet...

70CB93.text:
Regina
Could it have something to do with that Organoid?

70CC63.text:
Earth
Then we'd better find some answers.

70CC8D.text:
Jack
Right. Let's ask around town. Someone might know something.

70CD05.text:
Townsperson
A suspicious woman? Hmm. That's not much to go on.

70CD78.text:
Townsperson
Oh! You mean the woman with that blonde girl?

70CDF8.text:
Townsperson
Yeah. Neither was from around here. I remember them clearly.

70CE4F.text:
Regina
Who could that be? Are we talking about the same woman?

70CED7.text:
Townsperson
I hear the Republic recently destroyed Fire Bridge,{page}Townsperson
over the Red River.

70CF38.text:
Townsperson
There's been fighting along the river, too...{page}Townsperson
Are we heading for war?

70CFB2.text:
Townsperson
War? Doesn't bother me.{page}Townsperson
If anything, it means more business.

70D015.text:
Townsperson
Don't know about any suspicious woman.{page}Townsperson
But that kid with the Organoid has friends here.{page}Townsperson
Try the tavern.

70D0A0.text:
Townsperson
Yeah. A mean-looking guy, a woman who looked pretty{page}Townsperson
greedy, and a blonde girl with her head in the clouds.

70D0FF.text:
Townsperson
The guy and the girl were shopping here just a while ago.

70D141.text:
Townsperson
Whoever blew up Fire Bridge has a lot to answer for.

70D1A2.text:
Townsperson
No goods coming in from the Empire anymore.{page}Townsperson
It's ruining my business!

70D1EF.text:
Townsperson
I hear bandits have been seen in nearby Rock Colony.{page}Townsperson
Nowhere's safe these days.

70D248.text:
Townsperson
A kid with an Organoid?{page}Townsperson
Yeah, he was making a fuss about a girl being kidnapped.

70D2A7.text:
Townsperson
She probably just got lost.{page}Townsperson
Happens all the time around here...

70D2FE.text:
Townsperson
This is Sand Colony.{page}Townsperson
Everyone traveling through these parts stops here.

70D355.text:
Townsperson
I don't know if she's the woman you're after,{page}Townsperson
but someone was asking a lot of questions about Zoids.

70D3E9.text:
Townsperson
Ligers and Tigers, mostly.{page}Townsperson
As if we'd have rare Zoids like that out here in the sticks!

70D48C.text:
Townsperson
You're looking for a child? Sorry, I haven't seen one.

70D4D1.text:
Moonbay
Sorry, we're in the middle of something important.

70D514.text:
Dr. D
Oh, what a lovely young lady!{page}Dr. D
Care to have some tea with me?

70D572.text:
Irvine
Huh? What do you want?

70D5A4.text:
Jack
Do you know a boy named Van?

70D602.text:
Irvine
Who the hell are you...?

70D636.text:
Earth
We're looking for Van. Where is he?

70D679.text:
Irvine
I don't owe you an answer.

70D7E3.text:
Dr. D
What, over already? How dull.

70D85A.text:
Moonbay
You too, Irvine. Now, who are you people?

70D8A9.text:
Jack
We're following a woman. And it seems Van's after her, too...

70D93C.text:
Jack
Yes. He was with an Organoid named Zeke.

70D98F.text:
Irvine
Just Zeke? No one else?

70D9D2.text:
Earth
I don't owe you an answer.

70DA5D.text:
Regina
I'm sorry. Yes, it was just him and the Organoid.

70DACF.text:
Dr. D
The girl wasn't with him, then?

70DB31.text:
Moonbay
Her name's Fiona. We assumed she was with Van.

70DBB8.text:
Regina
Van's chasing Fran, and Fiona,{page}Regina
who should be with him, is missing...

70DC8B.text:
Irvine
You know something, don't you?!{page}Irvine
You'd better not be holding out on us!

70DD0C.text:
Moonbay
You want that woman. We want to know why Van's chasing her.

70DD5B.text:
Moonbay
Sounds like we've got the makings of a deal.

70DDAE.text:
Jack
You want to work together?

70DDDE.text:
Moonbay
Exactly. We all want to find her. Let's team up until we do!

70DE67.text:
Moonbay
And finding Van and Fiona on our own won't be easy.

70DEBA.text:
Jack
She's right. More people means we can cover more ground.

70DF0F.text:
Irvine
Tch. Fine. We'll call a truce. For now.

70DF51.text: Irvine and his friends joined the party!

70DF81.text:
Irvine
So, we're working together. Where do we start looking?

70E041.text:
Earth
Flam hasn't been here long.

70E080.text:
Earth
Kidnapping someone wouldn't be easy on her own.

70E0BE.text:
Jack
...You think she's got an accomplice?

70E0F6.text:
Moonbay
An accomplice... You don't think it's them?!

70E15C.text:
Regina
You have someone in mind?

70E184.text:
Moonbay
The Desert Arcobaleno. Desert bandits. It'd be just like them.

70E205.text:
Irvine
By the way, if you want me fighting alongside you,{page}Irvine
add my Zoid to the formation!

70E268.text:
Townsperson
I heard bandits turned up in nearby Rock Colony.

70E2A8.text:
Townsperson
Come to think of it,{page}Townsperson
that boy with the Organoid was asking about them, too...

70E301.text:
Townsperson
Bandits? Never heard of them.

70E327.text:
Townsperson
Bandits, huh? With all this talk of war,{page}Townsperson
things are getting rough around here.

70E386.text:
Townsperson
Desert... what? Never heard that name around here.

70E3EF.text:
Irvine
Running off on your own again!

70E461.text:
Irvine
You're in a hurry, right? Let's finish these guys off!

70E4AC.text:
Van
Thanks, Irvine! I'll leave them to you!

70E4F2.text:
Irvine
Hey! Wait! I'm telling you to stop running off on your own!

70E54F.text:
Moonbay
Irvine! We've got enemies right in front of us!{page}Moonbay
Deal with them first!

70E592.text:
Moonbay
You guys, too! Give us a hand!

70E5E8.text:
Irvine
Damn that Van... There he goes. Impatient little brat.

70E661.text:
Irvine
Oh, yeah? Who's that supposed to be?

70E6F7.text:
Jack
Can we please get back to following him?

70E7CD.text:
Jack
...Looks like there's been a battle.

70E855.text:
Moonbay
Let's ask someone what happened.

70E88F.text:
Townsperson
What happened? A Redler attacked us out of nowhere!

70E8E0.text:
Townsperson
Must've been those bandits prowling around here lately!

70E931.text:
Townsperson
Bandits? Who knows? All I saw was one Redler.

70E97A.text:
Townsperson
The bandits? I hear their hideout's in a cave{page}Townsperson
to the north.

70E9C7.text:
Townsperson
I couldn't get a good look at the pilot...{page}Townsperson
Looked like a woman, though.

70EA20.text:
Townsperson
There are some terrifying women out there.{page}Townsperson
Makes my wife look tame!

70EA77.text:
Boy
A blonde girl...? I think I caught a glimpse of one...

70EAC0.text:
Boy
But it all happened so fast...

70EAF6.text:
Townsperson
A blonde girl? Yeah, in the Redler's cockpit!{page}Townsperson
I saw her myself!

70EB58.text:
Irvine
A Redler. That settles it.

70EC14.text:
Moonbay
Would even those guys attack a town with just one Zoid...?

70EC71.text:
Irvine
It was a Redler. And they had Fiona with them.

70ECE8.text:
Irvine
No point standing here wondering.{page}Irvine
We'll ask them ourselves. Come on!

70ED35.text:
Townsperson
Ever since that attack, I can't sleep.{page}Townsperson
What if the bandits come back...?

70ED8E.text:
Townsperson
Before you sort out the bandits,{page}Townsperson
could someone sort out my wife...?

70EDE3.text:
Townsperson
Bandits, trouble... This used to be such a quiet place.

70EE2E.text:
Townsperson
This is Rock Colony.{page}Townsperson
Just a little village in the middle of nowhere.

70EE6A.text:
Boy
They say it's still too dangerous to play outside. It's so boring!

70EEBD.text:
Townsperson
The bandits worry me, but I wish this war would end, too...

70EF15.text:
Rosso
So, it's you... Just as that woman said.

70EF85.text:
Irvine
The star always makes a late entrance.

70EFE3.text:
Rosso
Still, you've saved me the trouble of fetching the Organoid.

70F030.text:
Rosso
Once I present it to him...

70F06F.text:
Rosso
...I'll be able to return to the army.

70F102.text:
Van
You're not getting Zeke! Now give Fiona back!

70F183.text:
Van
Don't play dumb! Let's go, Zeke!

70F1BC.text:
Jack
Van! Join our formation properly before you fight!

70F246.text:
Rosso
They broke through my Red Horn's armor?!

70F2EF.text:
Rosso
Fiona? What are you talking about?

70F31F.text:
Irvine
Don't play dumb. You took her away in a Redler.

70F39C.text:
Irvine
Your Redler, right? The one that attacked Rock Colony?

70F513.text:
Rosso
It belonged to a woman named Fran.

70F595.text:
Rosso
It's all right. We lost.{page}Rosso
I'm the one who let her talk me into this.

70F644.text:
Rosso
All we wanted was that Organoid.

70F681.text:
Rosso
Flam said she'd bring it to us. That's why we helped her...

70F6D4.text:
Rosso
I know nothing about this girl, Fiona.

70F71D.text:
Van
You expect us to believe that?!

70F74D.text:
Rosso
Believe what you like. She used us.

70F79A.text:
Rosso
Probably to keep you busy while she got away.

70F7EF.text:
Jack
And we fell for it. We've wasted all this time here...

70F8AA.text:
Jack
What do you think, Prince?

70F8DC.text:
{player}
Yeah... I don't think he's lying.

70F8FD.text:
Jack
Do you know where Fran and Fiona went?

70F9A4.text:
Viola
...Probably west, to the Red River.{page}Viola
Across Fire Bridge, into Imperial territory.

70FA0F.text:
Van
Fire Bridge? We destroyed it in that last battle!

70FA52.text:
Van
What do we do now?!

70FA7E.text:
Rosso
...There should be a cave somewhere along the Red River.{page}Rosso
A way around.

70FB05.text:
Rosso
Hmph. I've told you enough. Find it yourselves.

70FB54.text:
Van
Then let's get going! Hang on, Fiona!

70FB97.text:
Van
Irvine! Moonbay! And...{page}Van
uh, whoever you guys are! Let's move!

70FBED.text:
Irvine
Hey! Stop running off! Will you listen for once?!

70FC7B.text:
Rosso
Heh. They beat us completely.

70FCD7.text:
Rosso
Well, we'd better get out of here, too.

70FD31.text:
Rosso
Knowing her, she's probably set us up with the Empire and{page}Rosso
Republic, not just that town.

70FD8A.text:
Rosso
We're bandits in the Empire's eyes now, too.

70FDFF.text:
Rosso
But I'm not about to dance to her tune forever!

70FE5E.text:
Townsperson
The bandits are gone. That's a relief, at least.

70FE98.text:
Townsperson
Right! No more bandits. Back to business!

70FEDC.text:
Townsperson
Someone actually beat those bandits? That took guts!

70FF29.text:
Zoid Pilot
The bandits are gone already...?{page}Zoid Pilot
I was hoping to collect the bounty...

70FF88.text:
Townsperson
The bandits are gone, but the war's still going, isn't it?{page}Townsperson
I hope it ends before my grandson grows up...

70FFF3.text:
Townsperson
Bandits or no bandits, we'll die in this war anyway.{page}Townsperson
I'd rather die here, where I belong...

710062.text:
Townsperson
Men are useless when it counts!{page}Townsperson
The future belongs to women!

7100D2.text:
Van
Raven?! What are you doing here?!

71010B.text:
Van
Aren't you with the Imperial army?!{page}Van
Or do you want another fight?!

710158.text:
Van
It won't go like last time!

710193.text:
Raven
All talk, as usual, Van.

7101C5.text:
Raven
You can't even handle a Zoid without{page}Raven
your Organoid. Pathetic...

71027A.text:
Raven
You're a lousy pilot, and an even worse fighter.

7102FE.text:
Raven
Heh. That was almost entertaining.

710324.text:
Raven
But it seems that woman arranged this little battle...

710399.text:
Raven
...I don't like being used. I'll let you off for today.

710421.text:
Irvine
...Not a chance. He didn't even fuse with his Organoid.

710474.text:
Moonbay
So he let us go?

71050E.text:
Van
Are you all right, Fiona?! Are you hurt?

71056A.text:
Moonbay
You had us worried sick!

7105A0.text:
Van
Hey, where'd the woman who took you go?

710617.text:
Regina
What? Did she run away?

710683.text:
Earth
Don't know. But I doubt this is over.

710737.text:
Moonbay
Right! We shouldn't hang around here. Let's go.

710790.text:
Irvine
Yeah. All that noise might bring the Imperial army down on us.

7107EA.text:
Van
Thanks. You really helped us out.

710818.text:
Moonbay
What are you guys going to do now?

710854.text:
Jack
...Look around here a little longer.

71095C.text:
Jack
So you were hiding here after all...

710996.text:
Fran
...Saw right through me, did you?

7109CA.text:
Jack
No. We still don't know what you're after.

710A0C.text:
Fran
Isn't it obvious?{page}Fran
Make the Shield Liger and Zaber Fang fight.

710A53.text:
Fran
With luck, they'd take each other out.{page}Fran
Even the winner wouldn't escape unscathed.

710AA8.text:
Fran
Then capturing them would be child's play.

710ADA.text:
Fran
Getting Raven here took quite a bit of work, you know.

710B25.text:
Jack
That isn't what I meant.{page}Jack
Why didn't you leave when your plan failed?

710B84.text:
Jack
You didn't need to show yourself to us at all.

710CDD.text:
Fran
You betrayed us!{page}Fran
He was supposed to be your best friend...!

710D38.text:
Fran
And to me... He was...!

710D83.text:
Fran
So why?! Why did you leave him to die?!

710E0F.text:
Earth
...Is that all you've got to say?

710E6D.text:
Earth
I asked if that's all you've got to say.

710EAB.text:
Fran
I'll make you regret killing him!

710EF5.text:
Fran
Why?! Why can't I beat you?! You'll pay for this, Earth!

710F53.text:
Earth
...As if I could forget. Not for as long as I live...

710FD4.text:
{player}
Earth... what happened between you two?

710FF5.text:
Earth
...I'm sorry, Prince. ...I'll tell you. Someday.

711061.text:
Jack
...Let's go back. Back to Arcadia.

7110A7.text:
Emperor
{player} and his companions followed Fran{page}Emperor
through the transporter in the ruins?

7110F3.text:
Blood
Yes, Your Majesty! Forgive me.

711127.text:
Emperor
So that transporter still works...

711187.text:
Emperor
Very well. Destroy the ruins. We don't need two transporters.

7111D2.text:
Blood
But if the one in the castle breaks down...!

71121F.text:
Emperor
You'd have me keep the other one?

711249.text:
Emperor
One trump card is enough. And I hold it.

7112B5.text:
Gale
We've received a report from Fran.

711303.text:
Gale
She's failed to capture the Shield Liger,{page}Gale
Zaber Fang, and Organoids.

711366.text:
Emperor
...I see. I'd hoped she'd be more useful than that.

7113A5.text:
Emperor
Tell her to destroy the transporter in the ruins.

71140B.text:
Emperor
I'll leave {player} and his friends stranded beyond{page}Emperor
time itself! Hahahahaha!

711486.text:
Fran
Destroy the transporter? Are you serious, Gale?

7114C0.text:
Gale
His Majesty wants the prince and his companions trapped{page}Gale
in another time.

711560.text:
Regina
Wait! Something's wrong... The gate's becoming unstable!

71162B.text:
Fran
...Earth! I'll finish you with my own hands...!

711676.text:
Fran
But if I destroy this device...

711702.text:
Fran
Can you really live with that, Fran?!

711758.text:
Royal Soldier
The Royal Army of Arcadia!{page}Royal Soldier
These ruins are under our control!

7117AA.text:
Royal Soldier
Step away from the transporter!

7117EA.text:
Fran
...The Royal Army? That was quick.

711816.text:
Fran
Did someone let them slip through the net...?

71185F.text:
Fran
...Heh heh. Fine. Whoever you are, I'll play along.

7118AE.text:
Fran
I'd sell my soul to the devil for a chance to kill you, Earth!

71194F.text:
Royal Soldier
Welcome back, Prince! And the Three Beast Knights!

7119C3.text:
Royal Soldier
Arcadia's Royal Army, sir. We escaped the enemy in the{page}Royal Soldier
chaos. We've finally managed to regroup.

711A2A.text:
Royal Soldier
We heard the prince had gone to the ruins, so we came to help.

711A89.text:
Royal Soldier
Just in time, too.{page}Royal Soldier
An enemy soldier was about to destroy the transporter...

711B31.text:
Royal Soldier
Are under our control, ma'am.

711BAF.text:
{player}
Before that... I'm glad you're all safe.

711C95.text:
Emperor
You failed to destroy the space-time transporter?!

711D14.text:
Emperor
And you let the remnants of Arcadia's army{page}Emperor
seize the ruins...

711D91.text:
Emperor
You fool! Get out of my sight!

711DD3.text:
Emperor
Damn it... Is there no one here I can rely on?!

711E13.text:
Opis
Well, well, Your Majesty. In fine spirits again today, I see...

711E68.text:
Emperor
Hmph. Is that supposed to be funny, Opis?

711E98.text:
Opis
Hee hee. Perish the thought.

711EC8.text:
Opis
I've brought news that's sure to improve your mood.

711F21.text:
Emperor
Is it finished? The Rare Hertz amplifier?

711F68.text:
Opis
All it needs now is a field test.

711FC0.text:
Opis
What?! I built it! I'll be in command!

712015.text:
Opis
I'm not letting someone else have all the fun!

712055.text:
Blood
With respect, Doctor, military command isn't your field.

7120A0.text:
Opis
Hee hee. What are you plotting, Blood?

71210C.text:
Emperor
Enough! Opis will command this operation.

71217D.text:
Emperor
Blood, Gale. Strengthen our defenses against{page}Emperor
the Royal Army.

7121E8.text:
Opis
With the Rare Hertz amplifier,{page}Opis
even the most powerful Zoids will be helpless...

71224B.text:
Emperor
I'm counting on you, Opis.

7122A6.text:
Blood
The Royal Army got back on its feet rather quickly...

712338.text:
Blood
Someone deliberately let the survivors escape.

7123B9.text:
Blood
Wouldn't you call that betrayal?

7123FE.text:
Gale
You seem to prefer scheming to fighting.

712445.text:
Blood
Indeed. I'd rather stab someone in the back than{page}Blood
be stabbed myself.

712498.text:
Gale
Then I'll be sure not to turn my back on you.

7124D7.text:
Royal Soldier
Time distortion detected!{page}Royal Soldier
The castle's transporter has been activated!

71255F.text:
Regina
Can you tell which era they've gone to?

71258C.text:
Royal Soldier
Not yet... But we can follow the distortion's signal.

71261F.text:
Jack
Wait. We have time to check our equipment first.

712670.text:
Royal Soldier 1
It looks like the enemy buried the lower ruins{page}Royal Soldier 1
when they withdrew.

7126C5.text:
Royal Soldier 2
The gate's active. Be careful!

712752.text:
Jack
...I'm not sure. Let's look around.

712789.text:
Jack
If there's a town nearby, we might be able to find out more.

712830.text:
Regina
What's happening?! My Zoid won't respond!

7128A1.text:
Jack
Regina! Activate your Pulse Guard!

71291A.text:
Jack
We seem to be in a Rare Hertz zone.

71298F.text:
Jack
A mysterious frequency that drives Zoids berserk.

7129BD.text:
Jack
Pulse Guards offer some protection,{page}Jack
but not complete protection.

712A0E.text:
Jack
It's dangerous to enter this area.

712A50.text:
Regina
...Right. Let's find another route, Prince.

712A9A.text:
Regina
Prince! We're entering a Rare Hertz zone. It's dangerous.{page}Regina
Let's turn back.

712AEF.text:
Townsperson
What do you want? I'm busy getting ready to leave!

712B51.text:
Townsperson
Just when I thought we'd finally have some{page}Townsperson
peace... Another war...

712BA8.text:
Townsperson
Chronos Fortress is out in the desert ahead.

712BE2.text:
Townsperson
If that place weren't there,{page}Townsperson
maybe we wouldn't have a war on our doorstep...

712C37.text:
Townsperson
The desert around here has become a Rare Hertz zone.

712C73.text:
Townsperson
A Zoid's Pulse Guard can block some of it, but...

712CBE.text:
Townsperson
I wonder what's happening at Chronos Fortress,{page}Townsperson
right in the middle of it all.

712D05.text:
Townsperson
Is the Imperial army coming again...?

712D37.text:
Townsperson
Even if we leave town... Where can we go...?

712DA0.text:
Townsperson
They're stationed at Mount Ossa Fortress, to the south.

712DFF.text:
Townsperson
Even the Imperial army can't cross this desert.

712E33.text:
Townsperson
All they can do is stare each other down from outside the{page}Townsperson
Rare Hertz zone.

712E77.text:
Townsperson
You want to cross the desert? Well, there is a way...

712EB4.text:
Townsperson
Take the mountain route to the east. It goes around the desert.

712EF2.text:
Townsperson
Where am I going? Not across the desert, that's for sure.{page}Townsperson
It's a Rare Hertz zone.

712F3F.text:
Townsperson
Head east along the desert.{page}Townsperson
There's a path through the mountains.

712F8A.text:
Townsperson
It's too narrow for an army. They'd be asking for an ambush.

712FE7.text:
Townsperson
Which makes it safe for the rest of us.

7130B8.text:
Regina
What's the big idea?! Attacking us without warning!

713103.text:
Jack
So much for talking this out.

713137.text:
Earth
Then we don't need to hold back. Let's go!

71317F.text:
Regina
Was that the last of them?

7131E4.text:
Regina
What? Is something else wrong?

713278.text:
Regina
Could you explain that properly?!

7132AA.text:
Jack
Now, Regina. Didn't you notice anything strange?

713321.text:
Regina
Well... They didn't seem to be trying to outmaneuver{page}Regina
us or anything...

71339C.text:
Jack
When a Zoid has a pilot,{page}Jack
you can usually sense their habits in how it moves.

713419.text:
Jack
Their pilots should have proper military training.

713458.text:
Jack
But there was no sign of that. Which means...

7134F4.text:
Earth
No. Wild Zoids don't normally attack in groups like that.

7135B1.text:
Opis
Prince {player}! And the Three Beast Knights!

7135E1.text:
Opis
How did you like my army of berserk Zoids?

71365C.text:
Opis
Opis! One of the Four Generals serving the Emperor of the{page}Opis
New Arcadian Empire!

7136A3.text:
Opis
A scientist specializing in Zoids. A pleasure to meet you.

713712.text:
Regina
New Arcadian Empire?! Don't make me laugh!

71375F.text:
Opis
Such an unbecoming racket from a young lady.{page}Opis
Shall I make a few improvements to you?

71382B.text:
Opis
Hee hee. Quite right. You'll give yourself wrinkles.

71386F.text:
Jack
And what brings you here, Dr. Opis?

7138AF.text:
Opis
I thought I'd show off my latest invention:{page}Opis
the Rare Hertz amplifier.

713938.text:
Opis
Yes!{page}Opis
It amplifies naturally occurring Rare Hertz waves and{page}Opis
sends Zoids berserk!

7139A1.text:
Opis
Magnificent! The work of a true genius!

713A0C.text:
Jack
...Why would you build such a thing?

713A40.text:
Opis
Why? You have to ask?! Very well. Allow me to enlighten you!

713A99.text:
Opis
My magnificent amplifier puts every Zoid under its influence.

713AF4.text:
Opis
Even those using Pulse Guards!

713B26.text:
Opis
The Zoids go berserk and escape human control.{page}Opis
Collecting them afterward is child's play.

713B87.text:
Opis
Hee hee! Do you see my brilliance now?

713BC9.text:
Opis
Sadly, my beloved amplifier is still experimental.

713C14.text:
Opis
Its range is limited. But genius never rests!{page}Opis
And it never retreats!

713C71.text:
Opis
This test has brought Chronos Fortress and the surrounding{page}Opis
area completely under my control.

713CC4.text:
Opis
Next, I'll expand to Mount Ossa Fortress! Then New Helic City!

713D1F.text:
Opis
A fine chance for the Republican army to learn just{page}Opis
how brilliant I am.

713D62.text:
Opis
Eventually, I'll build a device that puts the entire planet{page}Opis
under my control.

713DBF.text:
Opis
A flash of inspiration! Tireless research! Wonderful!{page}Opis
I really am a genius! Hee hee!

713E83.text:
Jack
Mount Ossa Fortress... This is bad.{page}Jack
It's the Republic's last line of defense.

713EE6.text:
Jack
They'll have a huge number of Zoids there.{page}Jack
Including the Republic's most powerful...

713F67.text:
Regina
Of course! We can't leave someone that{page}Regina
dangerous running loose!

713FB6.text:
Regina
...I'll teach him a lesson he won't forget!

714039.text:
Earth
...Maybe you should let him make those improvements.

7140AA.text:
Jack
Anyway! We'd better hurry to Mount Ossa Fortress!

7140EB.text:
Republic Soldier
Halt! Who goes there?!

714120.text:
Republic Soldier
This is Mount Ossa Fortress! No civilians allowed!

714177.text:
Republic Soldier
Stay back! This area's off-limits!{page}Republic Soldier
If you've got business here,{page}Republic Soldier
use the main entrance to the south!

7141D4.text:
Republic Soldier
There are still plenty of wild Zoids underground,{page}Republic Soldier
thanks to the old eruption and the Rare Hertz waves.

714245.text:
Republic Soldier
No entry without the commander's permission.{page}Republic Soldier
Please step back.

7142B3.text:
Republic Soldier
Halt! Who goes there?!

7142E8.text:
Republic Soldier
Mount Ossa Fortress is ahead! No civilians allowed!

71437D.text:
Jack
We have information your commander needs to hear.

7143F0.text:
Jack
They won't let us in without something to back us up...{page}Jack
We'll need another approach.

714445.text:
Earth
What now? Back to town to work out a plan?

714490.text:
Regina
...I suppose so. Standing here won't change their minds.

7144E0.text:
Dr. D
Oh, I'd know this lovely young lady anywhere.{page}Dr. D
Even when she's scowling...

71452F.text:
Regina
Eek! W-What are you doing?!

71456D.text:
Jack
You?! Weren't you with Van and his friends...?

7145B8.text:
Regina
Dr. D! What are you doing here?

714609.text:
Dr. D
Isn't it obvious? Getting to know you better.

714656.text:
Regina
That's not what I meant!

7146A1.text:
Republic Soldier
How dare you call Dr. D a thief!

7146E6.text:
Republic Soldier
He's one of the Republic's most distinguished scientists!

71473A.text:
Jack
I see. Then please, hear us out. In the desert ahead...

71478F.text:
Dr. D
Rare Hertz waves. Artificial ones, at that...

7147F7.text:
Dr. D
Ah, excuse me. Could you let us see the commander?

714835.text:
Republic Soldier
Of course, sir! Right this way!

71486A.text:
Dr. D
Come along, youngsters.{page}Dr. D
Help this poor old man get to the command room...

7148F8.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Dr. D! Your timing couldn't be better!

71493C.text:
Dr. D
Chronos Fortress, I take it?

71496E.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
You've heard, then...

7149A3.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Wait... Who are they?

7149E2.text:
Dr. D
Friends of mine. Let's leave it at that.

714A1D.text:
Dr. D
More importantly, what's the situation?

714A53.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
A few hours ago, near Chronos Fortress...

714A8A.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
...we detected abnormally high levels of Rare Hertz radiation.

714ACF.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
We lost contact with the fortress at the same time.

714B1E.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
The Imperial advance force attacking the fortress seems to{page}Lt. Col. Ford
have lost contact as well.

714B7D.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
From intercepted Imperial communications{page}Lt. Col. Ford
and aerial reconnaissance...

714BD4.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
...we believe their main force{page}Lt. Col. Ford
has pulled back from the desert.

714C2D.text:
Dr. D
Have you sent anyone to the fortress?

714C67.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Yes. But the Rare Hertz waves send our Zoids berserk before{page}Lt. Col. Ford
we can get close.

714CD2.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Pulse Guards don't help at all.

714D12.text:
Dr. D
I thought as much. These waves aren't natural.

714D61.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
They're artificial?! Then the Empire has a new weapon--

714DB4.text:
Dr. D
Not the Empire.{page}Dr. D
Apparently, someone these people know brought it here.

714E0D.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Who exactly are these people...?

714E6F.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
...Can we trust them?

714ECF.text:
Dr. D
First, we need to deal with whatever's{page}Dr. D
generating those waves.

714F20.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
...There's something else, Doctor.{page}Lt. Col. Ford
Colonel Krueger is missing.

714F8D.text:
Dr. D
What? Was he at Chronos Fortress?

714FC7.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
No. He was testing the ZG nearby.

71500E.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
His last message said he'd received a distress call and{page}Lt. Col. Ford
was heading for the fortress...

715079.text:
Dr. D
Who knows about this?

7150AF.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Myself and a few others.{page}Lt. Col. Ford
Captain Herman, and his aide, Lieutenant O'Connell.

71510E.text:
Dr. D
Captain Herman? Rob's here?

715152.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
He returned from New Helic City last night...

715195.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
He came for the ZG.{page}Lt. Col. Ford
He and Colonel Krueger argued over who would pilot it...

71523B.text:
Captain Herman
That's a little harsh, Dr. D. I'm the right man to pilot the ZG.

7152A0.text:
Dr. D
Ah. There you are...

7152D6.text:
Captain Herman
I suggested the old gentleman take a well-earned rest.

715319.text:
Captain Herman
But he's rather stubborn...

71535D.text:
Dr. D
Never mind that.{page}Dr. D
Keep Krueger's disappearance quiet for now.{page}Dr. D
It would hurt morale.

7153F2.text:
Dr. D
I'll need your help with the investigation.{page}Dr. D
I'm a sick old man, after all.

715472.text:
Dr. D
For now, I'll work out how to counter the{page}Dr. D
Rare Hertz amplifier.

7154F9.text:
Regina
So, Dr. D, what do we do?

715533.text:
Dr. D
Listen carefully. To locate the source of those waves...

71557E.text:
Dr. D
...I've fitted your Zoids with measuring equipment.

7155F0.text:
Dr. D
With waves this powerful...

715631.text:
Dr. D
...there must be more than one device.

715665.text:
Jack
So we use the equipment around Chronos Fortress{page}Jack
to locate them?

7156C8.text:
Dr. D
Exactly. You're a sharp one.

715709.text:
Dr. D
Unlike a certain someone.

715784.text:
Regina
W-Well, let's get going, then.

7157BA.text:
Jack
Y-Yes. How do we take the measurements?

7157F6.text:
Dr. D
Easy. Enter the Rare Hertz zone.

715831.text:
Dr. D
Stay there until the equipment says it's finished.

71586F.text:
Regina
Won't the waves affect us if we go in there?

7158B8.text:
Dr. D
Don't worry. The equipment includes a{page}Dr. D
powerful Pulse Guard.

71590F.text:
Dr. D
It'll protect you long enough to get the readings.

71594B.text:
Earth
The berserk Zoids will attack.

71597D.text:
Dr. D
I'm sure you can handle them. Unless you're scared?

715A04.text:
Dr. D
Ho ho ho! Off you go, then. Good luck!

715A43.text:
Dr. D
Ho ho ho! Off you go, then. Good luck!

715A82.text:
Captain Herman
I wonder if the ZG made it to Chronos Fortress safely...

715AD0.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
I hope Colonel Krueger is safe at Chronos Fortress...

715B21.text:
Lt. O'Connell
...Another mission left in civilian hands...

715B77.text:
Jack
Prince, the Rare Hertz zone starts here.

715BD7.text:
Regina
...Please don't push yourself too hard, Prince.

715C17.text:
Jack
Let's go. Keep fighting until the measurements are complete.

715CD1.text:
Jack
That should do it. Prince, we're withdrawing. Regina!

715D24.text:
Regina
Got it. Come on, Prince.

715D50.text:
Regina
Now we just need Dr. D to analyze the readings.

715D95.text:
Regina
Let's head back to Mount Ossa Fortress, Prince.

715DDA.text:
Dr. D
Well done, all of you.

715E0C.text:
Jack
So, Doctor? What do the readings tell us?

715E44.text:
Dr. D
It seems there are five Rare Hertz amplifiers.

715EB7.text:
Dr. D
The main unit's at Chronos Fortress.{page}Dr. D
The other four support it.

715EF4.text:
Dr. D
They're positioned around the edges of the affected area.

715F34.text:
Captain Herman
Then all we need to do is destroy them together.

715F71.text:
Captain Herman
I'll send a Pteras squadron to bomb them out of existence!

715FBC.text:
Dr. D
Not that easy. The waves affect Zoids in the air, too.

716011.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Dr. D is right, Captain Herman. We couldn't bomb them{page}Lt. Col. Ford
accurately under those conditions.

71607A.text:
Jack
And approaching from the air would be too obvious.{page}Jack
We'd alert the enemy.

7160CF.text:
Captain Herman
...Very well. We'll send a small, elite team in by land.

716134.text:
Dr. D
That sounds about right.

71616C.text:
Regina
But Doctor, what about the Rare Hertz waves?

7161A8.text:
Dr. D
Hmm... Let's discuss that in the hangar.

7161EF.text:
Irvine
Damn that idiot! Running off on his own again!

71623E.text:
Moonbay
That doesn't mean you should do the same, Irvine!

716297.text:
Moonbay
You saw those berserk Zoids!

7162D4.text:
Moonbay
You'd be torn apart before you reached Chronos Fortress!

71637E.text:
Earth
Just that mean-looking man making a scene.

7163BA.text:
Irvine
Huh?! You're one to talk!

716488.text:
Irvine
Van ran off to see what was happening at Chronos Fortress!

7164ED.text:
Moonbay
And Fiona went with him, of course.{page}Moonbay
They left Zeke behind, though.

71658E.text:
Dr. D
Ho ho! Just like that boy.

71660E.text:
Dr. D
Well, with those two gone, it'll have to be you youngsters.

716674.text:
Captain Herman
Absolutely not! We can't rely on civilians!

7166C1.text:
Dr. D
Don't be like that. They know the person behind this.{page}Dr. D
Isn't that right?

716778.text:
Dr. D
You two might as well hear this, too.

7167A8.text:
Dr. D
The enemy's amplifier has turned Chronos Fortress into a{page}Dr. D
powerful Rare Hertz zone.

716811.text:
Irvine
A Rare Hertz amplifier? What's that supposed to be?

71688B.text:
Dr. D
There are five amplifiers in all.

7168BF.text:
Dr. D
Destroy all five, and that should do it.

7168FD.text:
Moonbay
But how can we get close with all those waves?

716941.text:
Dr. D
I've built shields to protect you against them.

716989.text:
Dr. D
They're already fitted to your Zoids.

7169CD.text:
Captain Herman
Wait. I still can't leave this to civilians. I'm coming with you.

716A4E.text:
Captain Herman
Chronos is a military installation.{page}Captain Herman
Having a Republican officer along will be useful.

716AB3.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
True... Very well. I'll come, too.{page}Lt. Col. Ford
Lieutenant O'Connell, you're with us.

716B68.text:
Dr. D
Everyone doing as they please... Oh, suit yourselves.

716BB6.text: Herman and his comrades joined the party!

716BE3.text:
Lt. O'Connell
Rare Hertz amplifier spotted!

716C48.text:
Irvine
When Van gets back, he's getting the lecture of his life!

716CA4.text:
Moonbay
All these Rare Hertz waves are terrible for business!

716D19.text:
Jack
The waves inside the fortress are too strong!{page}Jack
Our shields can't handle them!

716D62.text:
Jack
It's too dangerous! Pull back!

716D9D.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
This is Chronos Fortress, but...

716DD7.text:
Captain Herman
The waves around the fortress are too strong for our shields.

716E2C.text:
Jack
We'll have to destroy the support units first, won't we?

716E7E.text:
Captain Herman
We made it this far.

716EBA.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
This far, yes. But now we're facing the main amplifier.

716F0F.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
The enemy will have prepared for us...

716F58.text:
Captain Herman
I'd be disappointed if they hadn't.

716F9C.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
You never change.

716FD0.text:
Lt. O'Connell
Let's search the area first.

717058.text:
Van
Whoa! Hold on! It's me! Me!

7170D8.text:
Van
You're doing that on purpose!{page}Van
You're just as annoying as Irvine!

717161.text:
Van
I'm not flustered! Just surprised!

7171E0.text:
Captain Herman
You never stop surprising us, kid.

717214.text:
Captain Herman
Have you seen Colonel Krueger?

71725A.text:
Van
Colonel Krueger? Does he mean that old guy, Fiona?

7172A5.text:
Fiona
Is the old guy Colonel Krueger?

7172DF.text:
Van
That's what I'm asking you, Fiona!

71734B.text:
Captain Herman
Stop babbling! Where is this old guy?!

717397.text:
Colonel Krueger
Being called an old guy by a bunch of green youngsters...

7173EE.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Colonel Krueger! You're safe!

71744E.text:
Colonel Krueger
Let's not stand around here. Come with me.

71749D.text:
Colonel Krueger
Now, who are your companions?

7174DB.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Friends of Dr. D, apparently.

71750F.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
We've asked them to destroy the Rare Hertz amplifier.

71758D.text:
Colonel Krueger
I see. So that's what's driving the Zoids berserk.

7175FE.text:
Jack
A device that amplifies Rare Hertz waves and drives Zoids{page}Jack
out of control.

717651.text:
Jack
It's the work of an associate of that woman from before.

71768F.text:
Van
Damn it! Those guys again?!

7176C5.text:
Captain Herman
The main unit is supposed to be here, in Chronos Fortress.

717766.text:
Captain Herman
The underground hangar? Are you certain?

7177A8.text:
Colonel Krueger
It's crawling with berserk Zoids.

7177E4.text:
Colonel Krueger
Whether they know what they're doing or not,{page}Colonel Krueger
they must be guarding something important.

71787B.text:
Jack
We'd better take a look.

717923.text:
Colonel Krueger
Captain Herman, hold this position.

71795F.text:
Captain Herman
Colonel, please leave this to me!

717999.text:
Colonel Krueger
Now that I know what's happening, I can't stand by.{page}Colonel Krueger
If Zoid pilots won't save Zoids, who will?

717A08.text:
Van
That's the spirit, old man! I'm coming, too!

717A4B.text:
Captain Herman
...When it comes to stubbornness,{page}Captain Herman
you've got me beaten, Colonel.

717A9A.text:
Captain Herman
Understood. We'll concentrate on defending the fortress.

717AE1.text:
Colonel Krueger
Thank you... Come on, everyone!

717B17.text: Van and Krueger joined the party!

717B49.text:
Captain Herman
Look after Colonel Krueger. The Republic needs him...

717BAC.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
...My superiors, my subordinates...{page}Lt. Col. Ford
Everyone does whatever they like.

717BF1.text:
Lt. O'Connell
Good luck. With your skills, I'm sure you'll manage!

717C6C.text:
Regina
This must be the main amplifier.

717C9E.text:
Van
So this is what's hurting the Zoids!

717CD4.text:
Colonel Krueger
And now it ends!

717D8A.text:
Earth
Not good. They're surrounding us.

717DED.text:
Captain Herman
What's going on?! They're still berserk!

717E35.text:
Jack
I don't know. We destroyed the amplifier...

717E8A.text:
Captain Herman
Then why haven't they stopped?!

717EEA.text:
Captain Herman
What was that?! You...!

717F1C.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Enough, Captain Herman!

717F58.text:
Colonel Krueger
I see... It looks like the enemy outplayed us.

717FF6.text:
Colonel Krueger
The amplifier did more than drive the Zoids berserk.

71805F.text:
Captain Herman
What do you mean, Colonel?

7180A5.text:
Colonel Krueger
That much, I don't know. Finding out is Dr. D's job.

7180FE.text:
Colonel Krueger
We'd better return to Mount Ossa Fortress.

718168.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Colonel Krueger, please return with them.

7181BB.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
Captain Herman, Lieutenant O'Connell,{page}Lt. Col. Ford
and I will remain here...

718204.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
...and keep watch over the situation.

71826E.text:
Lt. Col. Ford
That's an order, Captain Herman!

7182DE.text:
Colonel Krueger
I'll leave things in your hands. Come on, everyone.

718325.text:
Dr. D
So destroying it didn't stop them...

71835F.text:
Jack
What does that mean, Doctor?

71839D.text:
Dr. D
The enemy's thought this through.{page}Dr. D
Driving the Zoids berserk wasn't{page}Dr. D
the amplifier's real purpose.

7183FE.text:
Irvine
Huh? What are you talking about, old man?

71843C.text:
Dr. D
Can't you work it out?

718498.text:
Dr. D
Still a lot to learn, haven't you? Very well. I'll explain.

71853F.text:
Dr. D
The amplifier's purpose was to brainwash the Zoids.

7185C0.text:
Dr. D
Yes. Zoids aren't just weapons.{page}Dr. D
They're living creatures with wills of their own.

71860F.text:
Dr. D
That's why they respond to their pilots.

71864E.text:
Dr. D
You've felt that yourself, haven't you?

7186B8.text:
Dr. D
Driving them berserk with Rare{page}Dr. D
Hertz suppresses their own will.

718703.text:
Dr. D
Then, presumably, a new set of commands is forced onto them.

718762.text:
Colonel Krueger
Then how do we stop them...?

7187D2.text:
Colonel Krueger
Now the waves are gone, the Imperial army may take{page}Colonel Krueger
advantage of the chaos and attack again.

718843.text:
Colonel Krueger
But we can't leave those Zoids as they are.

7188B6.text:
Colonel Krueger
Until we know whose side they're on,{page}Colonel Krueger
we have no choice but to eliminate them. Quickly.

718923.text:
Dr. D
Even if the treatment's drastic?

71895B.text:
Colonel Krueger
Better than letting the patient die.

7189BB.text:
Dr. D
We'll divert magma from Mount Ossa toward Chronos Fortress.

718A04.text:
Dr. D
It's a terrible shame,{page}Dr. D
but that will wipe them out in one stroke.

718A4A.text:
Jack
But how do we divert the magma?

718A93.text:
Dr. D
Mount Ossa is still an active volcano.

718AD4.text:
Dr. D
Open a hole in the right spot,{page}Dr. D
and the magma should flow toward the fortress.

718B31.text:
Dr. D
Much easier than making it snow.

718B71.text:
Regina
You make it sound so simple, Doctor.{page}Regina
How do we open that hole?

718BBA.text:
Dr. D
There was a rock-drilling laser cannon around here{page}Dr. D
somewhere, wasn't there?

718C1E.text:
Colonel Krueger
Nothing gets past you.{page}Colonel Krueger
There should be one in the fortress expansion area.

718C77.text:
Colonel Krueger
Though after the eruption and those berserk Zoids,{page}Colonel Krueger
who knows what shape it's in.

718CDE.text:
Dr. D
That's enough to go on. The rest is up to you youngsters.

718D4B.text:
Jack
Understood. We'll retrieve it right away.

718D90.text:
Colonel Krueger
Wait. You, young man. You'll take my place.

718DEB.text:
Irvine
Hold on! You're not coming?

718E2E.text:
Colonel Krueger
With the Rare Hertz waves gone,{page}Colonel Krueger
the Imperial army could attack.

718E7D.text:
Colonel Krueger
A capable commander wouldn't miss this chance.

718EC0.text:
Colonel Krueger
I can't leave the fortress.

718F38.text:
Colonel Krueger
Who knows? I couldn't tell you...

718F6E.text:
Colonel Krueger
But how about this?

718F94.text:
Colonel Krueger
Dr. D has finished the weapon you used before.

718FE5.text:
Colonel Krueger
Care to try it out again?

719033.text:
Irvine
Heh. I'll take that challenge! I'm borrowing it, old man!

7190B4.text:
Dr. D
This is our last option. We're counting on you.

7190F3.text:
Colonel Krueger
I'll leave the rest to you!

71914D.text:
Jack
So this is the rock-drilling laser cannon...

719191.text:
Regina
That looks powerful enough to punch a hole in a volcano.

7191D3.text:
Dr. D
Have you recovered the laser cannon?

719235.text:
Dr. D
Good. The berserk Zoids have started moving toward{page}Dr. D
Mount Ossa's crater.

7192DA.text:
Dr. D
Someone is definitely controlling them. Hurry!

719329.text:
Jack
Prince... Opis is probably there, too.

7193E0.text:
Jack
What's happening with the berserk Zoids?

719410.text:
Dr. D
No change. They're heading straight for the crater.

719451.text:
Dr. D
You need to get there quickly, too.

71948A.text:
Dr. D
I'll tell you where to drill once you're there.

7194ED.text:
Opis
Hee hee. This won't do.{page}Opis
Interfering with such a grand experiment...

719588.text:
Opis
Can't you appreciate the brilliance of my amplifier?

71963D.text:
Opis
Nonsense?! You're the fools here!

71966F.text:
Opis
I won't let you interfere!

7196DF.text:
Opis
I'll destroy you myself! Hee hee... Hahahahaha!

719743.text:
Jack
Van, Irvine. We need to split up.

719782.text:
Jack
You two, head for the crater.

7197C0.text:
Irvine
What? You expect us to just say yes and leave you here?

719819.text:
Van
Yeah! We're fighting with you!

719851.text:
Jack
No. Those Zoids are moving closer to the crater{page}Jack
as we speak.

719898.text:
Jack
Leave this to us. Get to the crater!

719948.text:
Irvine
Move it, kid! And don't forget the drilling laser!

7199C8.text:
Opis
Hey! You! I haven't finished talking!

719A17.text:
Jack
We'll be happy to hear you out.

719A79.text:
Opis
I'll teach you that great science always triumphs!{page}Opis
Hee hee hee!

719AD9.text:
Opis
Impossible! My magnificent science! My brilliant mind...!

719B2E.text:
Regina
{player} would never lose to a wicked scientist like you!

719B76.text:
Jack
You've lost, Dr. Opis. Why don't you leave?

719BFD.text:
Opis
Hee hee. You'll regret being so soft!

719C45.text:
Jack
...I'm sorry, Prince. That wasn't my decision to make.

719CD2.text:
Regina
...You're too kind for your own good, Jack.

719D0E.text:
Regina
I wonder how Van and Irvine are doing...

719D56.text:
Irvine
Looks like this is the spot...

719D90.text:
Van
All right! Let's blast it open!

719DCA.text:
Irvine
Careful. That laser isn't a weapon.{page}Irvine
You only get one shot, so don't miss!

719E51.text:
Van
Come on! Let's get out of here!

719E81.text:
Irvine
I'd rather not burn to death!

719EC2.text:
Dr. D
...Looks like the eruption's settled down.

719F07.text:
Colonel Krueger
Still, using Rare Hertz as a weapon...{page}Colonel Krueger
I never expected that.

719F5E.text:
Dr. D
It won't work twice.

719F86.text:
Dr. D
We just need to mass-produce the protective shields.

719FD3.text:
Dr. D
The Empire will probably develop{page}Dr. D
its own countermeasures, too.

71A04A.text:
Dr. D
Well done, all of you.

71A087.text:
Colonel Krueger
You have my thanks as well.

71A0C7.text:
Regina
Please, there's no need. This is our problem, too.

71A10C.text:
Dr. D
Ho ho. Will you tell me why someday?

71A19F.text:
Dr. D
Don't worry. I'll hear it from you eventually.

71A1E1.text:
Jack
I'm sorry, Doctor. Someday, we'll explain.

71A21F.text:
Dr. D
I'll look forward to it. Until next time.

71A293.text:
Dr. D
Friends of mine. And now they're friends of yours, too.

71A2F0.text:
Colonel Krueger
...I see. We'll leave it at that.

71A33A.text:
Emperor
Opis. Such big talk,{page}Emperor
and this is all he has to show for it. Pathetic.

71A385.text:
Blood
Yes, Your Majesty. Though the amplifier could still be useful...

71A3D4.text:
Emperor
Only as a surprise weapon.{page}Emperor
Once they develop defenses, it's worthless.

71A46B.text:
Emperor
Spare me the flattery. You knew that perfectly well.

71A4DA.text:
Emperor
Now, what of the castle's defenses?

71A516.text:
Blood
We've strengthened them throughout the castle.

71A557.text:
Blood
Even if the Royal Army attacks,{page}Blood
the garrison alone can repel them.

71A5B2.text:
Emperor
Good. I'm counting on it. You may go.

71A60F.text:
Emperor
{player}... An irritating little fly.{page}Emperor
I won't let you interfere...

71A6CC.text:
Royal Soldier
The enemy seems to be strengthening the castle's{page}Royal Soldier
defenses. Apart from that, nothing.

71A77B.text:
Jack
...I'm not sure. But we can't be too careful.

71A7C4.text:
Jack
Please keep watching the castle.

71A830.text:
Earth
Whatever they throw at us--

71A8A2.text:
Regina
Right. Let's keep at it, Prince.

71A92F.text:
Emperor
Yes. Have you heard about Opis?

71A968.text:
Gale
I understand Prince {player} destroyed the{page}Gale
Rare Hertz amplifier.

71A9BE.text:
Emperor
He's no prince! I rule this country now!

71AA29.text:
Emperor
I need a plan! You were a Republican officer.{page}Emperor
Put that experience to use!

71AA84.text:
Gale
We don't have enough troops to hold all of Arcadia.

71AAC9.text:
Gale
We should fortify the castle, use mobile defenses to repel{page}Gale
attacks, and prepare for a long campaign--

71AB36.text:
Emperor
Letting {player} run free will only encourage{page}Emperor
the Royal Army!

71AB72.text:
Emperor
If we lack numbers, make up for it with quality!

71AB9E.text:
Emperor
Yes, quality! Study the Empire's Zoids from the latter half{page}Emperor
of the war!

71ABE1.text:
Emperor
We'll use that data to strengthen our own Zoids!

71AC1C.text:
Emperor
Gale! Travel through time and investigate the Imperial Zoids.

71AC95.text:
Gale
Then I'll crush {player} and his companions together.

71ACDF.text:
Emperor
That's what I wanted to hear. I'm counting on you, Gale.

71AD36.text:
Emperor
Let's see how loyal you really are... Gale.

71AD83.text:
Royal Soldier 1
Time distortion detected!{page}Royal Soldier 1
The castle's transporter has been activated!

71ADD4.text:
Royal Soldier 2
Again?! Inform the prince at once!

71AE23.text:
Royal Soldier 2
Damn them... What are they planning this time?!

71AE6C.text:
Jack
Prince, they've detected another time distortion.

71AECA.text:
Regina
Again?! Where to this time?

71AF20.text:
Jack
But we can't ignore it.

71AF4E.text:
Jack
Let's follow as soon as we're ready!

71AF84.text:
Royal Soldier 1
The gate's active. Be careful!

71AFBD.text:
Royal Soldier 2
Make sure you give the enemy a beating!

71B04B.text:
Jack
I'm not sure. Let's look around.

71B179.text:
Regina
What could have done this?

71B1C9.text:
Jack
But there might be survivors.

71B2D2.text:
Jack
Cooperate, and we won't hurt you.

71B319.text:
Gale
...You won't hurt me? You haven't changed, Jack.

71B40B.text:
Jack
Instructor Gale! Why are you here?! Don't tell me you...!

71B4B4.text:
Gale
You won't hurt me? Hmph. Still too soft, Jack.

71B521.text:
Gale
I taught you this.{page}Gale
Chapter One of the Republic's combat manual.

71B562.text:
Jack
...Victory belongs to the one who stays a step ahead.

71B5B1.text:
Gale
Exactly. This is war, Jack!

71B5F4.text:
Jack
War... Why are you fighting, sir?!

71B66D.text:
Gale
I won't let anyone stand in my way. Not even you, Jack.

71B74D.text:
Jack
Prince, that was my mistake.

71B7BF.text:
Regina
Earth! Give him a moment!

71B7ED.text:
Jack
No, it's all right. Prince, you should hear this, too.

71B858.text:
Jack
His name's Gale.{page}Jack
He was my instructor when I was a cadet in the Republic.

71B89F.text:
Jack
Then he became my commanding officer when I{page}Jack
joined a combat unit.

71B8E4.text:
Jack
He taught me everything.{page}Jack
How to pilot a Zoid, how to command troops...

71B93D.text:
Jack
No... More than that. He taught me how to be a better person.

71B9AA.text:
Jack
I got it when I was still inexperienced.{page}Jack
The enemy surrounded me...

71B9F1.text:
Jack
I thought I was going to die.{page}Jack
He broke through their lines alone and saved me.

71BAA6.text:
Jack
So why?! Why is he working with them?!

71BB49.text:
Earth
We'll meet him again. Ask him yourself when we do.

71BC62.text:
Earth
You owe me. Don't forget it.

71BD52.text:
Jack
You can call him the enemy.

71BD7C.text:
Regina
...Gale, was it? Why did he attack this place?

71BDF3.text:
Jack
We don't have enough information.{page}Jack
Let's search the base.

71BEAC.text:
Regina
Isn't that Fiona? The girl who was with Van?

71BF55.text:
Regina
You're right. Then this must be a different time from{page}Regina
our last visit...

71BFD8.text:
Jack
Everyone, about our time travel...

71C014.text:
Earth
Right. We don't need any more complications.

71C0D1.text:
Jack
It's been a while, Fiona.

71C109.text:
Fiona
It has! Um... Jack, right?

71C149.text:
Jack
You've grown quite a bit.

71C17F.text:
Fiona
Well, it has been about two years.

71C1E9.text:
Fiona
It's good to see you again, too, Earth.

71C23D.text:
Fiona
Hee hee. You haven't changed.

71C263.text:
Fiona
Where have you been all this time?

71C291.text:
Jack
Oh! Well, you see... Um...

71C38C.text:
Fiona
{player} and Regina haven't changed at all.

71C40A.text:
Fiona
...It's almost as if time stopped for you...

71C49F.text:
Regina
I've grown plenty where it counts--

71C532.text:
Fiona
Hee hee hee. Just like old times.

71C56D.text:
Jack
How embarrassing. Anyway, what brings you here?

71C5D4.text:
Fiona
Bases along the border have been attacked,{page}Fiona
one after another...

71C63B.text:
Regina
So it isn't just this one?

71C66F.text:
Fiona
No. Quite a few have been hit already...

71C6A1.text:
Fiona
I was hoping to at least find out who's behind it...

71C6E0.text:
Fiona
But I got here too late again.

71C781.text:
Fiona
I'm helping the Guardian Force with its missions.

71C800.text:
Fiona
Yes. Van and Zeke are with us, too. And Lieutenant Schubaltz.

71C853.text:
Earth
The Guardian Force, eh? Impressive.

71C894.text:
Fiona
Hee hee. Pretty great, right?

71C8C5.text:
Regina
Earth knows about the Guardian Force...?

71C91C.text:
Jack
Of course not. He's making it up as he goes.

71C956.text:
Fiona
What are you all doing here?

71C988.text:
Earth
We're following a man. We saw him nearby.

71C9D1.text:
Fiona
...Hmm. Could he be involved in the attacks?

71CA42.text:
Fiona
Then why don't we look for him together?{page}Fiona
It'll be more fun with everyone!

71CACC.text:
Regina
Earth! What do you mean, fine by you?!

71CB0F.text:
Jack
Actually, Earth may have a point.

71CB7E.text:
Jack
She knows more than we do. We have nothing to lose.

71CC18.text:
Fiona
Great! We get to travel together again!

71CC5B.text:
Fiona
Bego Base, to the west, will probably be next.{page}Fiona
We'd better hurry.

71CCB4.text:
Fiona
It might already be under attack.

71CD14.text:
Regina
Why didn't you say so sooner?! Let's go!

71CDD9.text:
Regina
Have they already been attacked?

71CE03.text:
Jack
...Hard to say. The enemy could still be here.{page}Jack
We'd better be careful--

71CEBD.text:
Earth
Said she was going inside. Went on her own.

71CEFD.text:
Regina
What were you thinking?! You should've stopped her!

71CF89.text:
Earth
They've got us completely surrounded.

71CFB5.text:
Jack
...I didn't even notice them. What am I doing...?!

71D01C.text:
Earth
Save the self-criticism for later.

71D046.text:
Regina
Right. We need to get out of this first!

71D0BE.text:
Earth
Bad. No gaps in their lines. Well trained.

71D0FB.text:
Earth
What you'd expect from the Empire's First Armored Division.

71D165.text:
Earth
Yes. I'd know that banner anywhere.

71D19D.text:
Jack
The Imperial army... Then they aren't the attackers--

71D1E6.text:
Schubaltz
This is Colonel Schubaltz,{page}Schubaltz
commander of the Imperial First Armored Division.

71D29A.text:
Schubaltz
I repeat: cease resistance and disarm.

71D2E9.text:
Regina
Such a gentleman. Unlike someone I could name.

71D325.text:
Earth
I can be a gentleman. When I'm dealing with a lady.

71D3A0.text:
Jack
Earth! Regina! This really isn't the time.

71D53F.text:
Schubaltz
I'm sorry for the rough welcome. Please forgive us.

71D588.text:
Jack
Not at all.{page}Jack
Your troops' handling of the situation was impressive.

71D5D1.text:
Schubaltz
Ha ha! That's kind of you.

71D603.text:
Schubaltz
If you're with Fiona, are you Guardian Force members, too?

71D696.text:
Fiona
Yes. We're investigating the recent attacks on border bases.

71D715.text:
Schubaltz
...No. We received a distress call from this base{page}Schubaltz
and rushed over...

71D776.text:
Jack
But the attackers had already left...

71D7F8.text:
Fiona
So you don't know who the attackers are either?

71D84F.text:
Schubaltz
No. All the distress call mentioned was{page}Schubaltz
a blue-haired woman.

71D912.text:
Schubaltz
A bearded man? There was no mention of one. Who is he?

71D973.text:
Jack
...We believe he's involved in the attacks.

71DA14.text:
Schubaltz
What will you do now?

71DA4C.text:
Fiona
Since things are under control here,{page}Fiona
we'll try Zeta Base, farther west.

71DA91.text:
Fiona
It could be a target, too.

71DACF.text:
Schubaltz
Then I'll come with you.

71DB47.text:
Schubaltz
That blue-haired woman is very likely someone I know.

71DBCC.text:
Schubaltz
You don't mind if I join you?

71DC2E.text:
Regina
We're glad to have you, Colonel.

71DCD3.text:
Jack
...There might still be a clue somewhere.

71DD95.text:
Schubaltz
You look well, Van Flyheight.

71DDD3.text:
Van
Schubaltz! You're here, too? You look pretty good yourself!

71DE5C.text:
Jack
It's been a while, Van.

71DE92.text:
Van
It sure has! What've you been up to?

71DEF0.text:
Van
Yeah? You'll have to tell me about it sometime!

71DF22.text:
Van
Hey, {player}. You haven't grown at all!

71DFC0.text:
Van
You can't be picky! You'll never be a proper Zoid pilot like that.

71E03B.text:
Fiona
Did you find anything, Van?

71E069.text:
Van
No. It was already like this when I got here.

71E0E1.text:
Van
The survivors say a man with a red Organoid attacked them.

71E1E6.text:
Van
We don't know. Just a man with a red Organoid.

71E223.text:
Van
But he's definitely working toward something.

71E2BC.text:
Jack
Every base seems to have had a different attacker.

71E324.text:
Fiona
Yes. The woman Colonel Schubaltz heard about sounds{page}Fiona
like Reese. And at Ark Base...

71E3E1.text:
Fiona
A man with a beard.

71E411.text:
Van
That doesn't tell me much.

71E435.text:
Schubaltz
We still know far too little.

71E46D.text:
Jack
We should stop and compare what we've learned.

71E4AF.text:
Van
Oh! There's a town nearby!

71E55E.text:
Moonbay
Huh? Fiona! How have you been?

71E5C1.text:
Moonbay
Van? Look at you! Getting tougher by the day!

71E60E.text:
Van
You're looking good, too! What are you doing here?

71E64D.text:
Irvine
I'm the deeesert transpooorter...{page}Irvine
Or however it goes.

71E68A.text:
Irvine
And she's the one paying me.

71E6C6.text:
Moonbay
That's right. The border's dangerous lately,{page}Moonbay
so I hired him as a bodyguard.

71E74D.text:
Irvine
Quite a gathering of familiar faces.

71E794.text:
Jack
Good to see you again.

71E7BE.text:
Earth
Still as mean-looking as ever.

71E7F2.text:
Irvine
And you're still the same jerk!

71E850.text:
Moonbay
Seriously, what are you doing here?{page}Moonbay
Investigating the base attacks?

71E8A3.text:
Van
Yeah. But all we've got are descriptions of the attackers.

71E8DF.text:
Fiona
A blue-haired girl,{page}Fiona
a man with a red Organoid, and a bearded man.

71EA37.text:
Moonbay
...we saw three people like that heading toward Dame Base.

71EAE0.text:
Irvine
They stand out. I doubt we're mistaken.

71EB22.text:
Moonbay
Well, we'd better get going. See you, Van. Fiona.

71EBA1.text:
Moonbay
This delivery's on a strict deadline.

71EBDC.text:
Moonbay
We can't afford too many detours.

71EC0E.text:
Irvine
Heh. Here. Just for you guys.

71EC86.text:
Van
Dame Base next, then. What are they after?

71ECC6.text:
Regina
If all three were together...

71ED00.text:
Jack
Instructor Gale is working with Hiltz and Reese... But why?

71ED5B.text:
Fiona
Let's find out. To Dame Research Base.

71ED99.text:
Earth
Right. We'll get our answers there.

71EDF3.text:
Imperial Soldier
No civilians beyond this point.

71EE2D.text:
Imperial Soldier
No civilians beyond this point.

71EE6F.text:
Schubaltz
Colonel Schubaltz, First Armored Division.{page}Schubaltz
Let us through!

71EECB.text:
Imperial Soldier
No one may enter without Commander Hiltz's permission.

71EF26.text:
Schubaltz
Commander Hiltz?! That's not the name of{page}Schubaltz
this base's commander!

71EF71.text:
Schubaltz
I'll force my way through if I have to!

71EFA2.text:
Imperial Soldier
I'm sorry, sir, but...

71EFDE.text:
Jack
Colonel, we still don't have clear proof.

71F021.text:
Jack
Let's investigate the area a little more.

71F05F.text:
Fiona
That's right. Cool off with some salt coffee.{page}Fiona
There's a big town to the south.

71F159.text:
Thomas
Brother... I'll defeat you and prove I'm the better officer...

71F1BC.text:
Van
Huh? What are you talking about, Thomas?{page}Van
Has the heat got to you?

71F207.text:
Thomas
You can't have Fiona... Die, Van.

71F30E.text:
Van
Damn it! I'll knock some sense into him!

71F39A.text:
Thomas
M-Miss Fiona! What happened?!{page}Thomas
...Van! This is your doing!

71F3F9.text:
Van
Why me?! Reese was controlling you!

71F446.text:
Thomas
Don't be ridiculous! I'd never fall into enemy hands!

71F49F.text:
Fiona
It's true, Lieutenant. Reese was controlling you.

71F4F2.text:
Thomas
Yes, Miss Fiona. You're absolutely right.{page}Thomas
I was being controlled.

71F58B.text:
Jack
Quite a character, isn't he?

71F5BD.text:
Regina
Such a shame. He's good-looking, too.

71F5E9.text:
Jack
Oh? Is he your type?{page}Jack
I always thought you preferred someone like the prince--

71F646.text:
Regina
W-W-Wait, Jack! What are you talking about?!

71F699.text:
Earth
You've got your work cut out for you, Prince.

71F782.text:
Thomas
I don't owe you an answer.

71F7DA.text:
Fiona
Lieutenant Schubaltz, where did Reese and the others go?

71F83A.text:
Thomas
Reese and Hiltz went inside the base with a bearded man.

71F8BD.text:
Thomas
Stop standing around, Van! We're going after them!

71F937.text:
Hiltz
You certainly took your time.

71F971.text:
Reese
What did you expect? They're a bunch of idiots!

71F9E0.text:
Thomas
How dare you use me like that?!

71FA56.text:
Thomas
What?! Trying to look good in front of Miss Fiona?{page}Thomas
I won't let you!

71FAB9.text:
Van
What are you talking about?!

71FADD.text:
Thomas
Something important! Very important!{page}Thomas
You can't have Miss Fiona!

71FB60.text:
Hiltz
Forgive me, but I don't have time for your comedy routine.

71FC22.text:
Van
...Whose fault is that? Come on, Fiona!

71FD2B.text:
Gale
Why don't we have our own important conversation...?

71FDAB.text:
Gale
Instructor Gale... That's in the past.

71FDD7.text:
Gale
I'm Gale, one of His Majesty's Four Generals.

71FE17.text:
Earth
What are you after? Why attack the bases?

71FE59.text:
Gale
Blood told you the Emperor's goal, didn't he?

71FE8F.text:
Gale
I'm merely helping him achieve it.

71FECB.text:
Regina
Building the ultimate Zoid army...

71FF05.text:
Gale
