Exactly. I was gathering combat data on this era's{page}Gale
Zoids. Nothing more.

71FF6A.text:
Regina
What about those two? Why were you with them?

71FFA4.text:
Gale
Hm? Hiltz and Reese? I don't know what they're really after.

71FFF5.text:
Gale
The Imperial bases were in their way,{page}Gale
so we agreed to help each other.

72003E.text:
Gale
They wanted the bases gone. I wanted Zoid data.{page}Gale
Destroying the bases served both purposes.

720099.text:
Gale
I've gathered what I need. We can now improve our Zoids and{page}Gale
make up for our lack of numbers.

720142.text:
Jack
Why are you telling us all this?

720176.text:
Jack
Why reveal your own side's secrets to us?

7201B7.text:
Jack
Instructor Gale! What are you really trying to do?

7201F8.text:
Jack
What happened to you? Please, tell me!

720277.text:
Gale
I've sworn loyalty to the Emperor.{page}Gale
Nothing more, nothing less.

7202F2.text:
Gale
The Gale you knew is gone.

720322.text:
Gale
I'm Gale of the Four Generals.{page}Gale
...For now, that's all you need to know.

720385.text:
Jack
I don't know what you're thinking. But I will stop you!

7203E8.text:
Gale
...Can you? Do you really have the resolve to stop me?

72047B.text:
Gale
...Ghh... I see. You've shown me your resolve.

7204BE.text:
Gale
But you're still too soft. Don't expect to win next time.

720534.text:
Regina
...There's more to this than he's telling us.

7205B3.text:
Regina
Van! How did things go on your end?

7205EB.text:
Thomas
Thanks to this incompetent fool, they escaped.

720629.text:
Van
What?! You're the one who kept firing Megalomax everywhere!

72067A.text:
Thomas
There's nothing like firing every weapon at once.

7206AC.text:
Van
Then stop locking onto me while you do it!

7206F9.text:
Fiona
What happened to the bearded man?

720763.text:
Fiona
Then we're back where we started...

72079F.text:
Jack
No. We should be all right for a while.{page}Jack
He said he'd accomplished his objective.

7207FA.text:
Fiona
The bearded man told you that?

720858.text:
Thomas
You can't believe that! Never trust the enemy!

7208A1.text:
Fiona
But he doesn't seem like such a bad person.

7208E4.text:
Fiona
Ark Base was badly damaged,{page}Fiona
but surprisingly few people were hurt...

720939.text:
Thomas
Exactly, Miss Fiona.{page}Thomas
Enemy or not, we should start by trusting people.

7209E2.text:
Earth
For now, that's enough. Right, Jack?

720A64.text:
Van
We're heading out. What about you guys?

720AA9.text:
Jack
We still have things to take care of.

720B70.text:
Regina
Yes. We've still got plenty to do.

720BDF.text:
Jack
Let's go back. To our own time!

720C5E.text:
Emperor
Tell me, Blood. Have you heard of Zoid Battles?

720CA9.text:
Blood
A sport where Zoids compete under standardized rules...

720D4C.text:
Emperor
But precisely because of that,{page}Emperor
the individual Zoids are often exceptional.

720DA3.text:
Blood
Understood. I'll travel to the era of Zoid Battles{page}Blood
and gather information!

720E02.text:
Emperor
Heh heh. I'm counting on you, Blood.

720E32.text:
Royal Soldier 1
Time distortion detected!{page}Royal Soldier 1
The castle's transporter has been activated!

720E83.text:
Royal Commander
What?! Can you identify the destination?

720EDA.text:
Royal Soldier 1
But the coordinates are very different from before.

720F25.text:
Royal Commander
...Different coordinates? Where are they going now...?

720F6C.text:
Royal Commander
Notify the prince immediately! Hurry!

720FC5.text:
Jack
Prince, another time distortion has been detected.

72104B.text:
Regina
Jack, do we know any more?

721085.text:
Jack
Unfortunately not... But this destination seems different{page}Jack
from the others.

72110C.text:
Earth
Neither the Republic nor the Empire.

7211C2.text:
Jack
Now, now. We need to follow them either way.

721204.text:
Jack
Prince, let's leave as soon as we're ready.

7212AC.text:
Regina
This place is a wasteland. Where are we?

721331.text:
Jack
Yes. It looks like a training ground... Or a battlefield.

7213A6.text:
Jack
I can't be sure, but probably...

721419.text:
{player}
I've got a bad feeling about this...

72143A.text:
Regina
Enemies?! Where's that fire coming from?!

72149E.text:
Jack
Let's get out of here!

7214D9.text:
Judge
Unauthorized participants detected on the battlefield!

721518.text:
Judge
Unauthorized participants detected on the battlefield!

721557.text:
Judge
Under Zoid Battle regulations, this match is canceled.

72169C.text:
Blood
So you're the ones who interrupted the battle.

7216E7.text:
Blood
Heh. Perhaps these dull little matches will{page}Blood
finally get interesting.

721735.text:
Jack
That's Blood... One of the Four Generals.

721822.text:
Leena
What were you thinking,{page}Leena
wandering in there with those clueless looks on your faces?!

721861.text:
Leena
Are you blind?!{page}Leena
Is there anything in those heads of yours?!

7218B8.text:
Jamie
Leena, you don't have to go that far...

7218F6.text:
Leon
Can you blame her? We worked hard for that match.

72198B.text:
Leena
Exactly! The Royal Cup's over,{page}Leena
and Bit and Brad have both gone off traveling!

7219E2.text:
Leena
Leon even came home to help us out!

721A47.text:
Leon

Thank you for everything, Leena.

728AF9.text:
Leena
What are you talking about? Thank me after we win!

728B3E.text:
Regina
Right! Let's smash them to pieces!

728BCD.text:
Regina
The Trinity Liger?! What's it doing here?

728C18.text:
Blood
The prize for winning the championship.

728C4F.text:
Blood
The Blitz Team... So it was you after all.

728C9E.text:
Jack
And you, Blood. Just as we thought.

728CCC.text:
Jack
The disappearing Zoids. That's your work, too.

728D22.text:
Blood
But you're too late.{page}Blood
Every missing Zoid has already been sent to the Emperor.

728D75.text:
Blood
All your hard work was for nothing.

728DB7.text:
Blood
And that Trinity Liger will be mine, too!

728E24.text:
Regina
That doesn't change anything! We're still taking you down!

728EAD.text:
Blood
Can you defeat the champion?!

728F1F.text:
Gold Judge
The Blitz Team versus the Blood Team!

728FD8.text:
Blood
Damn it! Is this as far as I go?!

72900D.text:
Blood
{player}! You won't have the Trinity Liger!

729074.text:
Blood
If I can't have it, I'll destroy it!

729143.text:
Regina
No! Not the Trinity Liger...!

7291D6.text:
Regina
The Trinity Liger... It's still alive!

729218.text:
Jack
Impossible! It's completely destroyed...{page}Jack
Unless the Zoid Core is still...?

7292A9.text:
Jack
Let's take it to Dr. T. He might be able to do something.

729331.text:
Dr. Toros
That was quite entertaining.

729363.text:
Jamie
Still, it's a shame how things turned out.

7293C1.text:
Earth
We've still got a chance.

729415.text:
Bit
Those were some great battles!{page}Bit
Next time, you and me, all right?!

7294F2.text:
Leena
And good luck with {player}, too!

729532.text:
Regina
H-Hey! Not here! What are you saying?!

7296A4.text:
Blood
The data I collected should already be in your hands.

7296FF.text:
Emperor
Yes. Opis has reported his findings. Very interesting data.

729792.text:
Opis
Though you did lose to {player} and his friends{page}Opis
at the end. Hee hee.

7297E0.text:
Blood
The mission was to gather Zoid data.{page}Blood
Not to eliminate {player} and his companions.

72983C.text:
Opis
Hee hee. Your tongue works better than your Zoid, it seems.

72988B.text:
Blood
I'm honored by your praise.

7298B9.text:
Blood
Still, I'd say it was far more useful than that worthless{page}Blood
amplifier of yours.

729956.text:
Emperor
Blood, Opis. You've done your work. You may leave.

729A80.text:
Emperor
How are the improvements to our Zoids progressing?

729ABC.text:
Gale
With the combat data from both missions,{page}Gale
we've made some progress.

729B54.text:
Gale
We have enough close-combat data. But we lack firepower.

729BA9.text:
Emperor
Firepower... There's an ideal candidate, isn't there?

729BE2.text:
Emperor
A Zoid armed with a Charged Particle Cannon!

729C2F.text:
Gale
The Death Saurer... But that machine is--

729C70.text:
Emperor
I don't care! Data, Gale! Gather the data!

729CAD.text:
Emperor
I'll reduce {player} and his companions to particles!

729CD7.text:
Emperor
And everyone else who defies me!

729D01.text:
Emperor
Yes! The Death Saurer! Ah, the Death Saurer!

729D42.text:
Emperor
Gale! Get me its data at once! Go!

729E03.text:
Royal Soldier 1
Time distortion detected!{page}Royal Soldier 1
The castle's transporter has been activated!

729E74.text:
Royal Soldier 1
Inform the prince immediately!

729E9C.text:
Royal Soldier 2
Damn them... What are they planning this time?!

729EE5.text:
Jack
Prince, they've detected another time distortion.

729F43.text:
Regina
Again?! Still no idea where they've gone?

729FA3.text:
Regina
I thought so... Wait! You know?!

72A008.text:
Jack
After this many attempts, we're starting to get the hang of it.

72A053.text:
Regina
Then where did they go?

72A083.text:
Jack
Imperial territory, near the end of the last war.

72A0C0.text:
Jack
Let's follow as soon as we're ready!

72A190.text:
Jack
We're near Miletos Castle, an Imperial residence.{page}Jack
Let's head there first.

72A1F1.text:
Regina
Right. We still don't know what they're after.{page}Regina
Let's gather information.

72A268.text:
Regina
You'd expect no less from the Empire. This place is bustling.

72A2D1.text:
Jack
It feels more like a festival, though...

72A342.text:
Townsperson
What's all the fuss about? Where have you been living?

72A37B.text:
Townsperson
Crown Prince Rudolph's coronation!{page}Townsperson
That's why everyone's celebrating!

72A3E0.text:
Townsperson
Prince Rudolph only just turned ten.{page}Townsperson
He has a difficult road ahead.

72A42B.text:
Townsperson
But Lord Prozen will support him as regent. I'm sure of it.

72A48E.text:
Townsperson
We owe the Empire's prosperity to the late Emperor Zeppelin II.

72A4D9.text:
Townsperson
Prince Rudolph will surely carry on his work.

72A520.text:
Townsperson
I hear Prince Rudolph is a kind boy.{page}Townsperson
Perhaps he'll bring us peace at last.

72A57D.text:
Townsperson
They say we were so close to taking the Republic's capital.

72A5C4.text:
Townsperson
If the Republic had fallen,{page}Townsperson
the whole continent would've been ours...

72A79D.text:
Jack
...How's your daughter? Is Julia well...?

72A80C.text:
Jack
Wait... Has something happened to Julia...?!

72A8BD.text:
Gale
...That's enough for today. We'll meet again.

72A97E.text:
Jack
Miletos Castle. An Imperial residence.{page}Jack
What could he want here?

72A9D9.text:
Earth
Work it out later. We're following him.

72AAD7.text:
Rudolph
Do you know who I am?! Rudolph Gerhard Zeppelin III!

72AB3C.text:
Rosso
I'm well aware, Your Highness.

72AC02.text:
Rosso
I'm honored you remember us.

72AC36.text:
Rudolph
Let go! Release me at once!

72AC6A.text:
Jack
Who's that boy? Don't tell me...!

72ACCD.text:
Rosso
Damn it! Are those Imperial soldiers trying to{page}Rosso
kill Rudolph, too?!

72AD51.text:
Rosso
Right. Perhaps we'll meet again!

72ADBD.text:
Jack
Regina! It's too dangerous here. Let's pull back!

72AE13.text:
Regina
Jack... That boy the bandits had with them...

72AE64.text:
Jack
Yes. Most likely Crown Prince Rudolph.

72AEC6.text:
Regina
But why? Aren't they just bandits?

72AF71.text:
Earth
The Empire wouldn't let ordinary bandits kidnap its crown{page}Earth
prince so easily.

72B060.text:
Jack
I'm all right, Prince. We need to rescue Rudolph.

72B0E7.text:
Jack
No. Those soldiers fired even though Rudolph was right there.

72B134.text:
Jack
We don't have proof, but--

72B164.text:
Earth
The Empire isn't as united as it looks.

72B1B6.text:
Jack
And Instructor... No, Gale's involvement worries me.

72B1FB.text:
Jack
We'd be wiser to act on our own.

72B242.text:
Regina
But where could they have gone?

72B2FA.text:
Jack
The desert's to the north. It'd be hard to cross with a child.

72B371.text:
Jack
An aerial patrol would spot them immediately.

72B3A5.text:
Jack
The Iselina Mountains to the east are on the front line.{page}Jack
There'll be plenty of Imperial troops there.

72B40C.text:
Earth
That leaves the Galil Highlands. Plenty of places to hide there.

72B46B.text:
Regina
Then let's head for the highlands.

72B4B4.text:
Jack
Right. They're northeast of here.

72B4F3.text:
Jack
They may have stopped in a town on the way.{page}Jack
Someone there might know something.

72B570.text:
Imperial Soldier
Long live the Empire! Glory to Lord Prozen!

72B5B4.text:
Imperial Soldier
That tavern's famous for its excellent drinks.

72B5F0.text:
Townsperson
A bearded man? No, haven't seen one.

72B62E.text:
Townsperson
This is Hagen City. The richest city in the Empire.

72B66A.text:
Townsperson
Heard of the Galil Ruins?{page}Townsperson
Ancient ruins up in the highlands.

72B6B7.text:
Townsperson
Prince Rudolph is such a sweet boy.

72B6EA.text:
Townsperson
I saw a Zoid I'd never seen before last night!{page}Townsperson
Its face was scarier than Mom when she's angry!

72B75B.text:
Townsperson
I wish I had a big brother like Prince Rudolph...

72B7AC.text:
Stinger
Well, hello. I don't recognize you lovely faces.{page}Stinger
What brings you to town?

72B837.text:
Stinger
Me? Never mind little old me. I want to hear about you.

72B8A2.text:
Jack
W-We're just looking for someone...

72B8DE.text:
Stinger
Oh! Looking for someone? Who?

72B926.text:
Regina
A man and a woman with a child...

72B964.text:
Stinger
I wasn't asking you! Pushy little thing!

72B9E5.text:
Jack
Regina. Sorry about that.{page}Jack
We're looking for a man and a woman traveling with a child.

72BA3E.text:
Jack
There may be a bearded man with them, too.

72BA87.text:
Stinger
Hmm... A couple with a child? Can't say I know them.

72BB1A.text:
Stinger
Oh, don't rush off. Stay a little longer.

72BB69.text:
Jack
S-Sorry! We're in a hurry! Goodbye!

72BBAF.text:
Stinger
Until next time... Heh heh heh.

72BC1B.text:
Bartender
What's wrong, Stinger? Where's that usual flair of yours?

72BC60.text:
Bartender
Leave it somewhere? Here. Your usual.

72BCB7.text:
Stinger
Ahh... That's better. What a horrible bunch!

72BD00.text:
Stinger
And I was only trying to talk things out!

72BD4D.text:
Regina
Really? Is that what you call talking things out?

72BD97.text:
Stinger
You?! What are you doing here?!

72BE10.text:
Stinger
Eek! You'll pay for this!

72BE53.text:
Jack
Earth... You didn't have to go that far...

72BF3D.text:
Jack
Regina! Get the prince out of here!

72BFB7.text:
Stinger
Oh, you're not getting away that easily.

72C033.text:
Stinger
Stinger. Bounty hunter, at your service.

72C069.text:
Stinger
I'm not trying to kill you. I just want a little information.

72C0C2.text:
Stinger
You're looking for Prince Rudolph, aren't you?{page}Stinger
Tell me what you know.

72C129.text:
Regina
Cough, cough... Was that really necessary?!

72C169.text:
Stinger
Well, would you have told me nicely?

72C1A1.text:
Stinger
Come on, now.{page}Stinger
Hurry, before the gas spreads through your whole body.

72C1E6.text:
Stinger
Don't worry, it won't kill you. You'll just be numb for a while.

72C23D.text:
Stinger
Personally, I wouldn't mind tormenting you a little longer.

72C2B6.text:
Stinger
A fight, then? Even better. I do love a bit of fun!

72C2FD.text:
Stinger
Let me show you what the Stinger Special can do!

72C357.text:
Regina
Prince! Are you all right?!

72C3AB.text:
Jack
You may still feel numb for a while, but you should be fine.

72C44A.text:
Jack
But if he wanted us dead, he'd have used a stronger gas.

72C4AB.text:
Regina
That doesn't make any of this acceptable!

72C4EB.text:
Jack
Easy, now. Let's rest a little before moving on.

72C580.text:
Jack
Looks like it was destroyed recently.

72C634.text:
Earth
What do you think destroyed it?

72C6AB.text:
Jack
There are signs of close combat here and there.{page}Jack
But the fatal damage...

72C702.text:
Jack
I can't tell what kind of attack caused it.

72C744.text:
Regina
...You're saying there's an enemy up ahead with a weapon{page}Regina
we can't even identify?

72C7BB.text:
Earth
Don't know. But we'd better be careful.

72C851.text:
Jack
The bandits. But where's Prince Rudolph?

72C8C5.text:
Rosso
You again. We do keep running into each other.

72C907.text:
Jack
How did you get hurt? Where's Prince Rudolph?

72C954.text:
Rosso
One question at a time.

72C98C.text:
Regina
First, those injuries.{page}Regina
You seem all right, but she looks like she's in pain.

72C9ED.text:
Viola
...We don't need your pity! Ah...!

72CA6C.text:
Jack
Let's treat the wounds first.

72CB47.text:
Jack
How about what caused those injuries?

72CB87.text:
Rosso
Did you see the Iron Kong at the entrance to the ruins?

72CC05.text:
Rosso
Yes. We were in it.

72CC33.text:
Rosso
Rudolph got lost, so we were searching nearby.

72CC78.text:
Earth
Lost? Don't you mean he escaped?

72CCB6.text:
Viola
No! Rudolph was lost,{page}Viola
and Rosso was desperate to find him!

72CD0D.text:
Rosso
Viola, leave it. They're free to think what they like.

72CD4C.text:
Rosso
Rudolph was with Van and his friends.{page}Rosso
And that thing was attacking them.

72CD9D.text:
Regina
Van? Then Rudolph's with them now?

72CE42.text:
Jack
All right. That tells us where Rudolph is.{page}Jack
But what attacked you?

72CE99.text:
Rosso
I don't know. A Zoid I'd never seen before. Incredibly strong.

72CEE4.text:
Rosso
But I know one thing. It was after Rudolph's life.

72CF2D.text:
Viola
So we left Rudolph with Van and the others.{page}Viola
We couldn't hope to win...

72CF92.text:
Regina
Someone wants Rudolph dead? Who?

72CFFA.text:
Rosso
Rudolph stands between him and control of the Empire.

72D045.text:
Viola
That's why we were protecting Rudolph--

72D0F5.text:
Viola
But someone was trying to kill him, too. So we...

72D154.text:
Rosso
Believe us or don't. That's your choice.

72D23F.text:
Jack
You were hurt helping Rudolph escape with Van{page}Jack
and his friends.

72D296.text:
Jack
I believe you were trying to protect him.

72D2FE.text:
Jack
One more question. Do you know a man named Gale?

72D385.text:
Jack
We thought he might be the one behind your operation...

72D3CF.text:
Rosso
Heh. We used to be Imperial special forces.{page}Rosso
We can kidnap a prince without outside help.

72D432.text:
Viola
Come to think of it... I don't know if it was this Gale, but...

72D4B9.text:
Viola
I saw a Gojulas heading into these ruins.

72D55A.text:
Jack
Perhaps there's something deeper inside{page}Jack
that interests Gale.

72D5AB.text:
Jack
Let's take a look, Prince.

72D5D4.text: Rosso and Viola joined the party!

72D650.text:
Jack
I'm afraid we can't believe you.

72D670.text:
Jack
It does seem that someone wants Rudolph dead...

72D6B7.text:
Jack
But that doesn't change the fact that you kidnapped him.

72D736.text:
Rosso
Leave it, Viola! It's a reasonable conclusion.

72D7C2.text:
Rosso
In return for treating our wounds, I'll give you a tip.

72D7FF.text:
Rosso
Look deeper in the ruins.{page}Rosso
You might find something interesting.

72D84C.text:
Jack
Deeper inside...? Let's go, Prince.

72D892.text:
Earth
Looks like we're too late.

72D8BC.text:
Jack
Yes. But what was here?

72D968.text:
Regina
Did Gale do this, too?

72D998.text:
Jack
...I'm not sure.{page}Jack
Whatever was here seems too big for one person to move.

72D9F1.text:
Jack
Either way, there's nothing left here now.

72DA3A.text:
Regina
Right. Let's head back outside.

72DA9F.text:
Regina
Van and the others? Or Gale?

72DADB.text:
Jack
I don't know. Let's find out!

72DB44.text:
Regina
Command Wolves? Why are Republican troops here?

72DB95.text:
Earth
...What did this? A beam weapon? No...

72DBD8.text:
Jack
It looks far more powerful than a beam weapon...

72DC19.text:
Jack
But first, let's look for survivors.

72DC73.text:
Intelligence Officer
Y-Yes, somehow... Who are you?

72DCD2.text:
Intelligence Officer
Passing through...? Rather heavily armed for that.

72DD21.text:
Jack
What happened? Who attacked you?

72DD55.text:
Intelligence Officer
It happened so fast.

72DD77.text:
Intelligence Officer
A lone Zoid charged in and opened fire without warning.

72DDC6.text:
Intelligence Officer
I've never seen anything like it. It's not in our identification{page}Intelligence Officer
charts. Maybe a new Imperial model.

72DE2B.text:
Earth
What kind of weapon did it have?

72DE58.text:
Intelligence Officer
I don't know.{page}Intelligence Officer
It was as if the whole Zoid turned into a cannon.

72DEA1.text:
Intelligence Officer
I've never seen such firepower.{page}Intelligence Officer
Never faced anything so terrifying.

72DEF8.text:
Intelligence Officer
It had a black Organoid, too.{page}Intelligence Officer
Perhaps it was that Raven we've heard about.

72DF83.text:
Regina
That frighteningly strong pilot we fought before...

72DFC7.text:
Jack
But he was piloting a Zaber Fang then.

72E03D.text:
Rosso
The Zoid that attacked us was probably the same one.

72E078.text:
Rosso
Van definitely called its pilot Raven.

72E0B1.text:
Intelligence Officer
Van? The boy in the blue Shield Liger?{page}Intelligence Officer
Then you know Dr. D, too?

72E11A.text:
Regina
Yes. We know both of them.

72E147.text:
Intelligence Officer
Then we're in luck.

72E167.text:
Intelligence Officer
We were taking plans for a new Imperial flying Zoid back{page}Intelligence Officer
to the Republic.

72E1C2.text:
Intelligence Officer
If you know Dr. D, we can trust you.{page}Intelligence Officer
Will you help us deliver them?

72E24D.text:
Jack
But we have our own mission--

72E285.text:
Rosso
We'll go. The Republic's across the Iselina Mountains, isn't it?

72E2CA.text:
Rosso
We were heading that way anyway.

72E347.text:
Rosso
Yes. I've been meaning to visit those mountains.

72E3CD.text:
Intelligence Officer
That would help us a great deal. Let's leave at once.

72E414.text:
Rosso
See you around. Thanks for everything.

72E4CC.text:
Earth
Yes. But we'll probably meet again.

72E502.text:
Intelligence Officer
H-He... He's back! That thing's back!

72E5A7.text:
Jack
I don't know! It could be Raven!

72E664.text:
Jack
Van! Then his opponent must be Raven!

72E6A6.text:
Raven
Allow me to introduce my new Zoid. The Geno Saurer.

72E723.text:
Raven
Honestly, you've put up a good fight against me.{page}Raven
I'll give you that.

72E766.text:
Raven
But it ends today. Fight me, Van!

72E7B1.text:
Van
Damn it! Forgive me, Fiona... I'm fighting!

72E814.text:
Jack
He's strong. Far too strong...

72E84C.text:
Regina
This isn't a battle! He's just tormenting him!

72E8D1.text:
Dr. D
That fool. I told him not to fight.

72E9D0.text:
Raven
Heh... This is the end.

72EAA9.text:
Dr. D
Oh, it's you youngsters. Been a while.

72EAED.text:
Jack
Good to see you, Dr. D. Um... How's Van?

72EB60.text:
Dr. D
Don't worry about him. He's gone to rescue Prince Rudolph.

72EBF3.text:
Dr. D
Van's moving forward again.

72EC1F.text:
Dr. D
It hurts, but he's decided to face that pain.

72EC66.text:
Dr. D
Standing still won't solve anything.

72EC9E.text:
Dr. D
Don't worry about the Shield Liger either.{page}Dr. D
It took a terrible beating, but...

72ECF3.text:
Dr. D
...it's time for it to gain a new power.

72ED85.text:
Dr. D
Now, there's something I'd like you to do for me.

72EDF0.text:
Dr. D
There's a secret Imperial research facility in the{page}Dr. D
mountains southeast of here.

72EE41.text:
Dr. D
I'd like you to investigate it.

72EEAB.text:
Earth
That's none of our business.

72EF05.text:
Dr. D
Lately, an unfamiliar bearded man has been seen coming{page}Dr. D
and going there.

72EF9E.text:
Dr. D
Ho ho! I haven't lived this long for nothing.

72F00F.text:
Fiona
...Please. Do what Dr. D asks.

72F0AE.text:
Jack
All right. We'll do it.

72F118.text:
Jack
Give Van our regards. Let's go.

72F1AC.text:
Jack
So, a research facility in the mountains...

72F1FD.text:
Regina
That's not much to go on. Let's ask around.

72F23A.text:
Regina
We might learn something about Gale, too.

72F28B.text:
Earth
A good idea. For a change.

72F2EF.text:
Jack
Easy, you two. Let's gather some information.

72F327.text:
Villager
Huh? Gray Colony's got trees. That's about it!

72F376.text:
Villager
Oh, and Lord Prozen's castle, I suppose.

72F3BF.text:
Villager
Lately, a pillar of light flashes up from deep in the{page}Villager
woods at night.

72F3FE.text:
Villager
They say it leaves nothing but burned trees{page}Villager
behind. Frightening stuff.

72F449.text:
Villager
Did you hear? Someone saw a Republican Zoid nearby!

72F498.text:
Villager
Is another war coming...? I'm worried.

72F4CD.text:
Villager
Still, Lord Prozen's estate is close by.{page}Villager
That makes me feel safer.

72F51C.text:
Townsperson
I'm sure he'll protect us.

72F57D.text:
Villager
...I saw a Gojulas and some Zoid I'd never seen before{page}Villager
heading into the mountains.

72F5CC.text:
Villager
Even a Zoid couldn't cross the mountains from that direction.

72F61B.text:
Villager
Maybe they were heading for Lord Prozen's estate.

72F68D.text:
Jack
...It looks like a military facility.{page}Jack
We'd better not approach carelessly.

72F70F.text:
Jack
Probably the secret lab Dr. D mentioned.

72F75E.text:
Earth
Getting in won't be easy...

72F796.text:
Jack
Prince, keep out of sight of the guards.

72F7D3.text:
Jack
If they spot us, we'll have to start the infiltration over.

72F886.text:
Jack
No choice. We'll have to try again.

72F8C5.text:
Regina
What is this...? It looks like something went on a rampage.

72F910.text:
Jack
...It does. This looks like a Zoid maintenance tower, but...

72F969.text:
Earth
Too big. Twice the size of a Gojulas.

72F9A5.text:
Jack
Yes. If it is a maintenance tower,{page}Jack
what kind of Zoid could it be for...?

72FA4E.text:
Jack
Quiet, please. Stay calm and we won't hurt you. Understand?

72FAD0.text:
Jack
Thank you. What were you researching here?

72FB3A.text:
Regina
You'd better talk. This man is every bit as nasty as he looks.

72FB99.text:
Earth
That's right. I'm nasty. Talk.

72FC21.text:
Jack
Ancient ruins? The Galil Ruins?

72FC58.text:
Scientist
Yes! They were trying to revive a Zoid Core found there! I think!

72FCD6.text:
Scientist
They don't tell low-level researchers like me anything!{page}Scientist
It's true! Believe me!

72FD31.text:
Scientist
I don't know the details of the experiment! Really!

72FD76.text:
Scientist
I only altered genes in Zoid Cores extracted from Zoids!

72FDD7.text:
Jack
Your own research doesn't interest us.

72FE18.text:
Jack
...All right. Where is that experimental Zoid now?

72FE62.text:
Scientist
It went berserk recently. They moved it to a better-equipped{page}Scientist
lab in Hagen City.

72FEB7.text:
Scientist
There's nothing left here! That's all I know!

72FF02.text:
Scientist
Please! Take me with you!

72FF34.text:
Scientist
If they find out I talked, I'll... Prozen will kill me!

72FFCA.text:
Earth
Take responsibility for your own actions.

730000.text:
Regina
I don't usually approve of how you do things.{page}Regina
But I'll make an exception this time.

73005F.text:
Earth
An honor to agree with you.

730091.text:
Jack
There's nothing more for us here.

7300C7.text:
Jack
Let's head to the lab in Hagen City.

73012B.text:
Regina
That's the Geno Saurer! Raven?!

730170.text:
Jack
And his opponent seems to be Gale... What's going on?

7301BD.text:
Raven
Where do you think you're going?

730211.text:
Raven
That's classified data you're carrying, isn't it?{page}Raven
Not that I care about it.

73026A.text:
Raven
All I care about is fighting, Gale. Come on. Entertain me!

73032D.text:
Gale
You're strong, yes. But what is that strength for?{page}Gale
What will you do with it?

730388.text:
Raven
Shut up! I've never liked you!

7303D1.text:
Raven
I'll feed you to my Charged Particle Cannon right here!

730470.text:
Gale
Jack! Come to the lab in Hagen City!

7304B4.text:
Raven
Damn! You're not getting away, Gale!

730502.text:
Regina
What? Are they turning on each other?

73052E.text:
Jack
I don't know. None of this makes sense...

73057A.text:
{player}
Let's follow him. We're bound to find some answers.

73059C.text:
Earth
We'd better hurry to that lab.

7305DD.text:
Imperial Officer
No civilians beyond this point!

730620.text:
Regina
This is the Zoid lab? There aren't many guards.

730660.text:
Jack
Probably a disguise. But we don't have time to hesitate.

7306AF.text:
Jack
We'll force our way in!

73076D.text:
Earth
Forget it. Let's break through, then.

730856.text:
Prozen
Well. You've made it this far already.

7308E0.text:
Prozen
Allow me to introduce myself. Gunther Prozen.

730925.text:
Prozen
The next emperor of Guylos.

73094F.text:
Prozen
Gale told me about you. The flies buzzing around our plans.

7309A6.text:
Prozen
Though he seems to have stolen my Death Saurer data.{page}Prozen
Another fly, then.

730A39.text:
Prozen
Yes! Let me introduce the symbol of my power!

730A8F.text:
Prozen
This is only a prototype,{page}Prozen
using a Geno Saurer's Zoid Core as a substitute...

730AEE.text:
Prozen
But even a prototype should be more than enough for you.

730B3C.text:
Prozen
Now, if you'll excuse me.{page}Prozen
I have a coronation to attend in the capital.

730B93.text:
Prozen
Take your time appreciating the Death Saurer's power.

730C15.text:
Jack
Drunk on your own power!

730C4F.text:
Earth
They're all like that.{page}Earth
We know another one ourselves, don't we?

730CA8.text:
Regina
The man squatting in Arcadia Castle.

730CD8.text:
Regina
{player}, let's show him we won't lose to the{page}Regina
likes of him!

730D2F.text:
{player}
Right... Everyone, get ready to fight!

730DE6.text:
Gale
You won. But that was unfinished.{page}Gale
The real Death Saurer is far beyond it.

730E84.text:
Gale
Do you have the strength to defy my Emperor?{page}Gale
I'll test that myself.

730F3F.text:
Regina
Earth's right, Jack. If this man wants to test us... we'll fight!

731024.text: Van and Irvine joined the party!

7310AF.text:
Irvine
You and me need to settle this one day!

731136.text:
Regina
Earth, stop it! Van, what's that Zoid?

731185.text:
Van
My new partner! The Blade Liger!

731205.text:
Gale
Revived by an Organoid's power...

731243.text:
Van
Hey, old man! How'd you know?

731273.text:
Van
That's right! Zeke and Fiona brought it back!

7312BE.text:
Gale
I see. So that's how...

7312F6.text:
Irvine
What now, old man? Six against one. A bit much for you?

7313AD.text:
Gale
If you can't get past me, you'll never achieve your goal!

73141B.text:
Gale
Ghh... You've improved again, Jack!

7314A2.text:
Gale
Heh. I can't do that.

7314C2.text:
Gale
You have things you must do. So do I.

731511.text:
Gale
The Death Saurer data I gathered is already{page}Gale
with His Majesty.

73155E.text:
Gale
He wants to create the ultimate Zoid.

731594.text:
Gale
Naturally, he'll use that data.

7315C6.text:
Gale
I don't know how much that prototype taught you,{page}Gale
but it may prove useful.

731667.text:
Gale
Enough talk. Until next time, Jack.

7316B3.text:
Van
Hey! You're letting him go? Is that all right?

7316F1.text:
Irvine
They've got their reasons. Come on, kid.

731778.text:
Irvine
To do our own job.{page}Irvine
We're taking Rudolph to the capital, remember?

7317EA.text:
Van
Hey! Wait, Irvine! See you guys around!

73186C.text:
Regina
What is that man thinking?

7318AE.text:
Earth
Don't know. Start with what we do know.

7318EE.text:
Jack
...Right. Prince, shall we go home?

731933.text:
{player}
Yeah. Let's head back to Arcadia!

7319C7.text:
Emperor
The Death Saurer is a magnificent Zoid.{page}Emperor
What do you think, Opis?

731A16.text:
Opis
Indeed. Though its charged-particle intake fan{page}Opis
appears to be a weak point.

731A79.text:
Emperor
Hmph. I assume you've already worked out a solution.

731ABC.text:
Opis
Hee hee. You know me too well.

731B2D.text:
Emperor's Soldier
Lady Fran used the space-time transporter.{page}Emperor's Soldier
She's left this era.

731B86.text:
Blood
What?! Where did she go?

731BAF.text:
Emperor's Soldier
We don't know the exact destination,{page}Emperor's Soldier
but we can follow her!

731C5A.text:
Emperor
Follow her. Dead or alive, bring her before me.

731D26.text:
Emperor
Death is all a fool deserves... What will you do, Blood...?

731D7F.text:
Royal Soldier 1
Time distortion detected!{page}Royal Soldier 1
The castle's transporter has been activated!

731DD0.text:
Royal Commander
What?! Can you identify the destination?

731DFF.text:
Royal Soldier 1
The signal only lasted an instant...

731E2D.text:
Royal Soldier 1
Another time distortion detected!

731E82.text:
Royal Soldier 1
It seems to be the same destination.

731EB0.text:
Royal Commander
Notify the prince immediately! Hurry!

731F09.text:
Jack
Prince, another time distortion has been detected.

731F67.text:
Jack
There were two distortions, both leading to the same place.

731FE2.text:
Jack
We don't know the details.{page}Jack
But something has clearly happened.

73203B.text:
Earth
We won't learn anything debating here.

73206D.text:
Jack
Right. Prince, let's leave as soon as we're ready.

732140.text:
Jack
No idea. I've never seen a place like this.

73217B.text:
Jack
But standing here won't help. Let's look around.

732222.text:
Jack
No! I've never seen a Zoid like this!

732294.text:
Jack
A Charged Particle Cannon at this range?! We can't dodge it!

732337.text:
Alster
Damn. Let my guard down...

732363.text:
Alster
Are you all right, Liger Zero?!

7323C8.text:
Alster
Looks like we can't move... Are you guys all right?

73241F.text:
Jack
Yes. You saved us. Who are you?

732455.text:
Alster
Shouldn't you introduce yourself before asking{page}Alster
someone else's name?

73249A.text:
Jack
My apologies. I'm Jack. This is Earth, and Regina.

73254D.text:
Alster
I'm Alster. I live in the village nearby.

7325F3.text:
Earth
Alster. What was that thing?

73263D.text:
Alster
The Berserk Fury.{page}Alster
A vicious Zoid from the underground world.

732692.text:
Alster
It'd been quiet lately. Now it's acting up again...

7326E7.text:
Alster
What are you doing out here, anyway?

732734.text:
Jack
We're looking for someone.{page}Jack
Have you seen any suspicious people lately?

732791.text:
Alster
Hmm... No. But someone in the village might know something.

7327F0.text:
Jack
First, let's get Liger Zero somewhere safe.

73283B.text:
Alster
Thanks. Could you take it to my village?

732882.text:
Regina
Of course. You saved us.

7328B0.text:
Villager
Alster! Thanks for keeping up the patrols.

7328E9.text:
Villager
Suspicious people? You mean the ones with you?

732928.text:
Village Child
Alster! Take me to the forest sometime!

732987.text:
Villager
Suspicious people? Hmm... Haven't seen any.

7329E0.text:
Villager
Suspicious people? Nope. Haven't seen any.

732A0B.text:
Villager
But the Imperial army's come to the forest.{page}Villager
Is there going to be more fighting?

732A63.text:
Alster
Hey, Bluejem. Palty, you're here, too?

732C46.text:
Bluejem
It'll live. The wounds are deep,{page}Bluejem
but I've given it emergency treatment.

732CCB.text:
Alster
They're looking for someone. Heard anything?

732D1E.text:
Bluejem
Nothing in particular. Sorry I can't help.

732D6F.text:
Alster
Oh, right. Bluejem's a Zoid technician, believe it or not.

732DBC.text:
Alster
Since you're here, why not let him check your Zoids?{page}Alster
He's good. I guarantee it.

732E1D.text:
Jack
Oh, no. We couldn't ask you to go that far...

732E66.text:
Bluejem
I don't mind.{page}Bluejem
I'd like to work on some different Zoids for a change.

732EE3.text:
Regina
Earth! Could you at least hesitate a little?

732F42.text:
Bluejem
By the way... Is that unusual Zoid yours?

732FF8.text:
Alster
Oh, here we go. He can't resist a rare Zoid.

733138.text:
Imperial Officer
A major operation has been authorized to stop the{page}Imperial Officer
Berserk Fury attacks.

73318B.text:
Imperial Officer
We will burn the surrounding forest to eliminate the threat.

7331D8.text:
Imperial Officer
For your safety, all residents must evacuate immediately.

73321F.text:
Imperial Officer
I repeat: all residents must evacuate immediately.

733272.text:
Alster
Burn the forest?! You've got to be kidding!

7332AD.text:
Alster
Nothing will be able to live here if you do that!

733306.text:
Alster
And what happens to the village?!

73334C.text:
Jack
Let's speak to the commander.{page}Jack
You can hardly call such a reckless plan an operation.

7333AF.text:
Regina
Really. The Imperial army goes from one extreme to another.{page}Regina
Just like someone I know.

733460.text:
Alster
Damn it! Where's the commander?!

733522.text:
Alster
What's going on?! You're burning the forest?!

7335BE.text:
Alster
What do you think will happen to it?!

733601.text:
Alster
And the village?! You're fine with that?!

73364E.text:
Solid
My feelings don't enter into it.{page}Solid
A soldier's duty is to carry out his orders.

73369F.text:
Solid
The Berserk Fury's attacks are spreading to nearby villages.

7336EC.text:
Solid
We can't let the damage spread any farther.

733771.text:
Alster
You're as stubborn as ever!

7337B1.text:
Solid
Say what you like. The operation will proceed!

7337F0.text:
Solid
What are you doing? Do you live here?

733833.text:
Regina
Will you let us deal with the Berserk Fury?

733888.text:
Solid
Who are you? Outsiders should stay out of this.

733901.text:
Solid
You own a Zoid of great importance to the Empire.{page}Solid
You're not an outsider.

733954.text:
Alster
They're friends of mine. There. Not outsiders anymore.

7339CF.text:
Alster
A twisted argument is still an argument!

733A01.text:
Solid
Very well. You propose to eliminate the{page}Solid
Berserk Fury yourselves?

733A62.text:
Jack
It's a Zoid from the underground world, correct?

733AB1.text:
Alster
Yeah. It came from there and settled nearby...

733B00.text:
Alster
But it's pretty quick on its feet...

733B40.text:
Jack
Then we should strike at the source.

733B7E.text:
Earth
Even wild Zoids need supplies.

733BB6.text:
Solid
I see. Find its lair and attack it there.

733BFD.text:
Jack
Exactly. Cut off the source, and no more will appear.

733C80.text:
Solid
The army considered that plan.{page}Solid
Would you like to hear its odds of success?

733CD7.text:
Alster
We won't know until we try!

733D3B.text:
Solid
Very well. We'll attempt your plan before beginning{page}Solid
the main operation.

733D8A.text:
Solid
But if it fails, we burn the forest immediately.

733DCB.text:
Solid
One more thing. I'll be joining you.

733DFD.text:
Solid
I can't send civilians into danger alone.

733E48.text:
Alster
If you want to come, just say so.

733EF9.text:
Solid
Good. I look forward to working with you.

733F1D.text:
Solid
Let's move to our camp to the southwest.

733F60.text:
Solid
We'll use it as our base for the hunt.

733FAF.text:
Regina
You had that ready quickly.

733FE3.text:
Jack
Perhaps he was the one who proposed this plan to the army{page}Jack
in the first place.

734069.text:
Palty
Alster, what about your Zoid?

7340AD.text:
Alster
Oh, right! Zero's still being repaired...

7340EF.text:
Solid
Honestly. That's why we can't leave Zero in your hands...

734142.text:
Alster
Stop talking like it's your Zoid!

734184.text:
Solid
...No choice, then. You'll use our Liger Zero.

73420D.text:
Solid
Liger Zero X. Fitted with our newest armor.

734286.text:
Alster
Why lend me something that advanced...?

7342B4.text:
Alster
Didn't you want to pilot Zero yourself?

7342FF.text:
Solid
It can't be helped. Liger Zero chooses its pilot.

73433E.text:
Solid
We choose the best plan available.{page}Solid
That's a soldier's duty.

73437E.text:
Alster
Then I'll take it. My Zero's still the best, though.

7343D4.text:
Palty
You're grateful, really, aren't you?

734470.text: Alster and Solid joined the party!

7344A6.text:
Solid
First, let's head to our camp.

7344E5.text:
Imperial Soldier
Welcome back, Captain Solid!

73455F.text:
Solid
Did you think I'd stay a sergeant forever?

734591.text:
Solid
Heh. My information on the underground world earned me{page}Solid
a special promotion.

7345D4.text:
Solid
Now, report on the Berserk Fury.

73460D.text:
Imperial Soldier
No significant activity at present, sir.

734645.text:
Imperial Soldier
We also rescued a pilot whose Zoid was attacked by it.

7346AA.text:
Solid
A pilot? Have you identified them?

7346E4.text:
Imperial Soldier
Only that she's a woman, sir. She won't say anything else...

7347D9.text:
Jack
Possibly. May we see her?

734822.text:
Solid
Very well. Bring her to the command room.

73488C.text:
Fran
You?! What are you doing here?!

7348CF.text:
Earth
So it was you, Fran.

734903.text:
Solid
You do know her, then. Care to introduce us?

734A02.text:
Solid
Oh...? What's your girlfriend doing out here?

734A6D.text:
Earth
Probably investigating the Berserk Fury.

734AE2.text:
Fran
The Berserk Fury's an unusual Zoid... Its Zoid Core...

734B45.text:
Solid
...The Zoid Core. I see. Very well. Get some rest.

734B9E.text:
Solid
I need to speak with the men. Excuse me.

734BDD.text:
Solid
I'll come for you when it's time to leave. Be ready.

734C61.text:
Jack
But how did you end up being attacked?{page}Jack
Don't you have support troops?

734D12.text:
Fran
This time... I came on my own.

734D48.text:
Regina
On your own?! Without orders?

734D83.text:
Fran
Thanks to you, I've failed again and again. I've got nothing left.

734DCA.text:
Fran
But I won't let it end until I've beaten you, Earth!

734E3B.text:
Fran
...It's no use now.{page}Fran
I ran off on my own and accomplished nothing.

734E82.text:
Fran
Even if I went back,{page}Fran
the Emperor would just execute me.

734EBF.text:
Fran
Not that I have a way back...

734F4B.text:
Fran
Why would I?! You killed him! He was your best friend, too!

735050.text:
Earth
Stay close, and you can kill me whenever you like.{page}Earth
Not a bad deal for you.

7350A5.text:
Earth
Unless you plan to spend the rest of your life here.

735151.text:
Solid
Sorry to keep you waiting. It's time to leave.

7351BC.text:
Solid
You can't fight with those injuries, can you?

735200.text:
Fran
I can guide you. I was attacked near its lair.

735251.text:
Fran
There should be an old base south of here.{page}Fran
That's the place...

7352AC.text:
Solid
The old Imperial fuel depot...!

7352E2.text:
Solid
Are you all comfortable bringing her along?

735329.text:
Earth
Yes. She'll ride with me.

735385.text:
Solid
Then let's move out. Our target is the Berserk Fury's lair!

7353E3.text:
Fran
This is it. Its lair...

735418.text:
Earth
Looks like we've found the nest.

73545A.text:
Solid
Right. We'll eliminate the Berserk Fury swiftly.

7354C7.text:
Alster
Leave it to us! You stay alert, too, Solid!

735518.text:
Solid
Heh. No need to tell me. Charge!

735586.text:
Solid
Don't let your guard down. Still, we should be safe for a while.

7355D3.text:
Jack
Then what about the army's main operation?

735633.text:
Alster
Yes! Thanks, Solid! And you guys, too!

73567A.text:
Alster
Let's get back to the village!

73571E.text:
Palty
Good work, Solid. Alster didn't cause too much trouble, did he?

7357A3.text:
Alster
Hey! What's that supposed to mean?!

7357D5.text:
Palty
Hee hee. You can stay a while, can't you, Solid?

735820.text:
Solid
...No. I have duties to attend to. Excuse me.

7358A4.text:
Palty
Better than never taking anything seriously.

7358D9.text:
Earth
Flam, are you all right?

735905.text:
Fran
Just... tired. I'll be fine...

735958.text:
Palty
Don't push yourself. Come rest at my house.

7359F7.text:
Alster
Then how about we head to Bluejem's and check{page}Alster
on the Zoids?

735AB5.text:
Alster
Oh, it's Solid. Does his mission involve Bluejem?

735B18.text:
Bluejem
Analyze the Berserk Fury's Zoid Core?

735B5F.text:
Bluejem
What are you thinking, Solid?

735B97.text:
Bluejem
I told you. I won't help drag Zoids into war again!

735BFC.text:
Solid
Your intellect is an Imperial asset.{page}Solid
We can't waste it on personal sentiment.

735C4D.text:
Solid
The Berserk Fury is formidable. We need stronger Zoids!

735CAC.text:
Bluejem
Didn't Alster and the others just defeat it?

735D03.text:
Solid
And another could appear at any time! Then another!

735D66.text:
Bluejem
That's a possibility, not a certainty!

735DBD.text:
Solid
A soldier's duty is to prepare for the unexpected!

735E0A.text:
Alster
Bluejem's right, Solid! Zoids aren't tools for war!

735E6D.text:
Solid
Stay out of this, civilian!

735ED5.text:
Solid
You worked for the military! You're no outsider!

73603D.text:
Alster
What?! He's heading for the village square!

7360A1.text:
Solid
Damn. Pulling the troops out of the village backfired!

7360F0.text:
Blood
Get out of my way!

736230.text:
Blood
Silence, you pests! Where's Fran?!

73627D.text:
Earth
Flam? What do you want with her?

736393.text:
Blood
Flam! Are you all right?! Are you hurt?!

7363D7.text:
Fran
...Have you come to drag me back?

7364A6.text:
Fran
...Why? Why did you come for me?

7364E2.text:
Blood
Because I wanted to! Stop asking!

7365C0.text:
Solid
Enough of this farce. You aren't escaping with her!

7366A2.text:
Fran
Sorry for the old trick, but you're going to let us go.

7366DB.text:
Fran
Otherwise... You can guess, can't you?

736778.text:
Fran
Call me what you like.{page}Fran
We'll take the Berserk Fury's Zoid Core, too.

7367DB.text:
Solid
What?! We won't hand it over!

736815.text:
Alster
Bluejem has it, at the edge of the village. Take it and go!

736898.text:
Fran
Thank you, kid. Blood, go get it.

736958.text:
Fran
...I'm sorry, Earth. I don't think I can go with you...

736A26.text:
Alster
Palty! Are you all right?

736A5C.text:
Palty
Y-Yes. Just a little shaken.

736A9A.text:
Solid
This is a disaster! The Berserk Fury's Zoid Core...!

736B20.text:
Bluejem
Something terrible's happened! The Zoid Core!

736B5A.text:
Alster
Good riddance. I'm glad it's gone.

736BA0.text:
Bluejem
What are you saying?! If someone misuses it...!

736C01.text:
Earth
Don't worry. We'll deal with it.

736CF7.text:
Jack
...That's right. Please leave it to us.

736D68.text:
Bluejem
All right! I'll help however I can!

736DC2.text:
Bluejem
...I can trust you. There was something in your Zi Data...

736E1B.text:
Bluejem
The Trinity Liger, was it? What a great-looking Zoid...

736E6E.text:
Bluejem
I've worked out an upgrade plan for it.

736EBD.text:
Bluejem
Please give it a try.

736EF0.text:
Bluejem
I'll give you some of my other Zi Data, too.

736F2F.text:
Bluejem
Good luck. Keep the Zoids from being dragged into more fighting.

736FB1.text:
Solid
I'm sorry, but I'll leave the stolen Core to you.

737030.text:
Bluejem
Let me know how the Trinity Liger performs someday...

73714B.text:
Emperor
You've done well. You may leave.

73717F.text:
Blood
Yes, Your Majesty. But about Fran--

7371BD.text:
Emperor
I said you may leave.

737215.text:
Opis
His Majesty told you to leave, Blood. Will you defy him?

7372F9.text:
Gale
Blood, you're smarter than this. Leave.

7373BA.text:
Opis
Oh, what a touching scene! Hee hee!

73752B.text:
Opis
Guards! Take Fran away. Gently, now. Hee hee!

7375A1.text:
Opis
The folly of youth, perhaps. Hee hee!

7375D5.text:
Emperor
All the more reason these fools need a strong hand{page}Emperor
to guide them!

73765F.text:
Emperor
Power! Power is all I want!

73768F.text:
Emperor
Show me a force greater than the Death Saurer!

7376DC.text:
Opis
Might I suggest the Death Stinger?

737716.text:
Emperor
Heh heh. Yes, Opis! That's the power I want!

73775F.text:
Emperor
You won't disappoint me... will you?

7377A6.text:
Opis
Of course not, Your Majesty!

7377CB.text:
Emperor
{player}... Miserable brat.{page}Emperor
An insect daring to defy me!

737889.text:
Royal Soldier
Time distortion detected!{page}Royal Soldier
The castle's transporter has been activated!

7378D8.text:
Royal Commander
Right! Inform the prince!

737934.text:
Royal Commander
We're on duty!{page}Royal Commander
If you have something to report, say it clearly!

737992.text:
Royal Soldier
As the first distortion faded,{page}Royal Soldier
we detected another weak signal overlapping it.

7379ED.text:
Royal Soldier
The transporter was probably used again.

737A30.text:
Royal Commander
...What does that mean? Two enemies this time?

737A82.text:
Jack
Prince, they've detected another time distortion.

737AE0.text:
Regina
They never give up! Women hate men like that!

737B5D.text:
Regina
You're the sort women hate, too, Earth!

737B9D.text:
Jack
Regina seems to be right this time.

737BDF.text:
Regina
Huh? What do you mean?

737C0D.text:
Jack
Two distortions were detected.{page}Jack
It looks like there are two of them this time.

737C5E.text:
Jack
Though I don't understand why they left separately.

737C9C.text:
Regina
However many there are, we still have one job.

737D2D.text:
Regina
Oh, we agree! Is it going to rain?

737D8C.text:
Earth
Probably. Let's hope it isn't Spread Missiles.

737E09.text:
Jack
A-Anyway, let's follow as soon as we're ready!

737EBD.text:
Jack
We seem to be near New Helic City.

737F16.text:
Regina
New Helic City? The Republic's capital?

73801B.text:
Raven
Hiltz! Why did you shoot me?!

7380C2.text:
Hiltz
Couldn't withstand the Charged Particle Cannon?{page}Hiltz
A worthless insect's Organoid, after all.

738129.text:
Raven
You... I'll kill you myself!

738170.text:
Hiltz
Without Shadow, can you even raise your shield?{page}Hiltz
Never mind fire your cannon.

73822A.text:
Hiltz
The Dark Kaiser must be terribly disappointed by{page}Hiltz
your betrayal, Raven.

7382A9.text:
Hiltz
Disappear without a trace, Raven.

7382E2.text:
Hiltz
Why are you here? I don't remember calling for you.

73836C.text:
Reese
Because the Death Stinger's been revived...?{page}Reese
Is that why you shot me...?

7383CF.text:
Hiltz
Exactly. I have no further use for you.

7384B6.text:
Regina
What is that Zoid?! I've never seen anything like it!

7385C8.text:
Jack
Prince! Are you all right?!

738609.text:
{player}
I'm all right. Don't worry about me!

73862A.text:
Earth
We're fine over here, too.

7386BE.text:
Jack
Whatever it was... It probably destroyed New Helic City.

738726.text:
{player}
Yeah... How could anyone do this...?

738795.text:
Jack
We can't just stand here grieving.

7387C1.text:
Jack
There may be survivors. Let's look for them.

73886F.text:
Jack
Is that... Opis? Why is he here?

7388BC.text:
Regina
Isn't it obvious?! He had a hand in this destruction!

7389DA.text:
Opis
Well, well. Prince {player}.{page}Opis
How are you today?

738A8E.text:
Regina
Don't play innocent! Look around you!

738AD2.text:
Opis
Ahh, I see. Not exactly a cheerful view, is it? Hee hee.

738BBC.text:
Regina
Stay out of this, Jack!

738BEE.text:
Jack
Calm down, Regina. You too, Prince.

738CA9.text:
Jack
Dr. Opis, are you responsible for this?

738CE7.text:
Opis
Hardly. I wouldn't cause such pointless destruction.{page}Opis
That was the Death Stinger.

738D7E.text:
Opis
The deadliest Zoid ever created by the ancient Zoidians,{page}Opis
built to counter the Death Saurer.

738DD3.text:
Opis
Though Hiltz seems to have altered it considerably.{page}Opis
It's far from the original now.

738E35.text:
Regina
The Death Stinger is a nightmare from the past!{page}Regina
Why bring it back?!

738E86.text:
Regina
That thing is beyond human control!

738ECA.text:
Opis
Hee hee. His Majesty desires it.{page}Opis
And as a scientist, I find it fascinating.

738F1B.text:
Opis
Today was merely a preliminary inspection.{page}Opis
Until next time, everyone. Hee hee.

738FD0.text:
Blood
The Death Stinger is mine. Stay out of my way.

739023.text:
Regina
What are you saying?! We won't let the Emperor have it!

739070.text:
Blood
Didn't you hear me? I said it's mine.

739107.text:
Blood
I'm taking the Death Stinger for myself.

739137.text:
Blood
Anyone who interferes will pay. Even the Emperor.

739172.text:
Blood
Then I'll rule, with the Death Stinger's power!

7391F1.text:
Regina
What are you talking about...?

739229.text:
Regina
It'll bring nothing but ruin! You can't control it!

73927E.text:
Blood
I can! I have the strength!

7392F0.text:
Blood
I'll take the Death Stinger. Don't interfere. That's all.

739397.text:
Earth
The ravings of a man drunk on power.

73940D.text:
Jack
We can't leave the Death Stinger running loose.

73944C.text:
Jack
And we can't let the Emperor or Blood take it.

7394A2.text:
{player}
Right. We'll stop the Death Stinger ourselves!

7394C4.text:
Schubaltz
What's wrong? Didn't you hear the withdrawal order...?

739537.text:
Jack
Colonel Schubaltz! What are you doing here?

739574.text:
Schubaltz
The First Armored Division was sent to reinforce the defense of{page}Schubaltz
the Republic's capital.

7395CF.text:
Schubaltz
...But the division was wiped out.

7395FD.text:
Schubaltz
The Republican army lost seventy percent of its forces.{page}Schubaltz
They're retreating to Windine Lake.

739738.text:
Jack
Aren't you heading to Windine Lake, Colonel?

739785.text:
Schubaltz
I was checking for units that hadn't{page}Schubaltz
completed their withdrawal.

7397D8.text:
Schubaltz
I'm heading there now. What will you do?

739831.text:
Jack
Please let us come with you.

7398AD.text:
Jack
The Death Stinger is too dangerous.{page}Jack
We can't let the Emperor or Blood get their hands on it.

739914.text:
Earth
Destroy it. Then they can't take it.

739987.text:
Jack
...But we're far too weak on our own.

7399D0.text:
Schubaltz
Victory goes to those who concentrate their forces and{page}Schubaltz
use them flexibly. Sound reasoning.

739A9D.text:
Schubaltz
Van Flyheight and the others should be arriving about now.

739AF2.text:
Jack
Van? Then the Guardian Force will be there, too?

739B3D.text:
Schubaltz
Yes. They know how to combine their strength and adapt.{page}Schubaltz
And how to make miracles happen.

739C02.text:
Jack
Something's in the middle of it!

739C36.text:
Schubaltz
A secret project began when the Guardian{page}Schubaltz
Force was established.

739C89.text:
Schubaltz
A joint Imperial-Republican plan for the final battle.{page}Schubaltz
This is it.

739D30.text:
Earth
A fortress? No... A Zoid?!

739D62.text:
Jack
That's a Zoid? It's enormous...

739DA4.text:
Schubaltz
The Republic's ultimate weapon.{page}Schubaltz
And humanity's last hope.

739E87.text:
Jack
Yes. On a completely different scale...

739EC3.text:
Van
You could fit a whole company of large Zoids in here, easy.

739F97.text:
Moonbay
Long time no see! What have you been up to?

739FDE.text:
Regina
Oh! A bit of everything.

73A010.text:
Moonbay
A bit of everything, huh?

73A03A.text:
Moonbay
Making a fortune somewhere, were you?

73A0C4.text:
Earth
You're as mean-looking as ever.

73A0F6.text:
Irvine
Hah! Still as charming as ever, aren't you?

73A138.text:
Thomas
You're both as bad as each other.

73A174.text:
Van
Schubaltz told us. You're after the Death Stinger, too?

73A1F3.text:
Fiona
...It's too dangerous. It brings only destruction.

73A24C.text:
Irvine
It's a monster.{page}Irvine
Fell from a hundred thousand meters and didn't even flinch.

73A2B1.text:
Moonbay
And it swims through magma like water.{page}Moonbay
Who knows where it is now...

73A30E.text:
Thomas
A Charged Particle Cannon and a shield.{page}Thomas
The worst combination imaginable.

73A40E.text:
Moonbay
It escaped into the magma. We don't know--

73A451.text:
Announcement
Massive energy reading in the border mountains!{page}Announcement
All personnel to battle stations! Repeat...

73A539.text:
Lt. O'Connell
The Death Stinger is approximately 7,000 meters{page}Lt. O'Connell
from the Ultrasaurus.

73A594.text:
Lt. O'Connell
But a mountain range blocks a direct shot from its{page}Lt. O'Connell
Charged Particle Cannon.

73A5F1.text:
Lt. O'Connell
It'll have to go around the mountains.

73A63C.text:
Colonel Krueger
How long will that take?

73A672.text:
Lt. O'Connell
At least three hours.

73A6AA.text:
Thomas
The Ultrasaurus needs two more hours to finish charging...

73A707.text:
Colonel Krueger
Correct. Until then, it can't move.

73A770.text:
Moonbay
Then we should just about make it, right?

73A82A.text:
Van
We can't let our guard down.

73A858.text:
Van
It's Hiltz. Who knows what he'll try?

73A89C.text:
Republic Officer
Energy reading confirmed! It's the Charged Particle Cannon!

73A8DE.text:
Schubaltz
Impossible! He's going to shoot through the mountain?!

73A923.text:
Thomas
Why is he firing at the mountains...?

73A965.text:
Colonel Krueger
He's clearing every obstacle so he can fire directly at{page}Colonel Krueger
us from there.

73AA23.text:
Hiltz
A little farewell party for you all...

73AA5C.text:
Hiltz
...with music of fear and despair.{page}Hiltz
The music of your screams.

73AADA.text:
Colonel Krueger
How long before that cannon can hit us?

73AB3B.text:
Lt. O'Connell
At this rate... About thirty minutes.

73AB88.text:
Moonbay
We won't make it at all!

73ABC4.text:
Irvine
Well... Looks like my bad feeling was right.

73AC11.text:
Thomas
Damn it! What can we do?!

73AC4B.text:
Colonel Herman
Get hold of yourselves!

73AC6B.text:
Colonel Herman
We still have time! There must be a way out of this!

73ACB4.text:
Colonel Herman
We can give up after we've tried everything!

73AD01.text:
Colonel Krueger
Do you have a plan, Herman?

73ADAB.text:
Colonel Herman
Moonbay. Start the Ultrasaurus.

73ADE1.text:
Colonel Herman
Fiona, Thomas. Help her.

73AE69.text:
Colonel Herman
Yes. You've always wanted to handle a Zoid like{page}Colonel Herman
this, haven't you?

73AEA8.text:
Colonel Herman
Or is the legendary transporter just a legend?

73AEEF.text:
Moonbay
Well, when you put it like that... I can't back down!

73AF36.text:
Colonel Herman
Everyone else, hold off the Death Stinger!

73AF76.text:
Lt. O'Connell
But only Van and Irvine can sortie right now.

73AFEB.text:
Colonel Herman
We're counting on you.

73B003.text:
Colonel Herman
Even if you can't destroy it,{page}Colonel Herman
buy us as much time as you can.

73B060.text:
Van
What are you talking about? We'll smash it!

73B0B5.text:
Colonel Herman
It's in your hands.

73B165.text:
Earth
You need every fighter you can get.{page}Earth
We're making a miracle, aren't we?

73B1B0.text:
Colonel Herman
Heh. That's right. Glad to have you.

73B1DC.text:
Colonel Herman
All right! Begin the operation!

73B20B.text:
Irvine
Where are they?! Where's that fire coming from?!

73B2A1.text:
Van
We've fought these guys before!

73B2D8.text:
Van
We'll hold them here! {player}, go on ahead!

73B321.text:
{player}
Come on, everyone! Let's get to the Death Stinger!

73B343.text:
Hiltz
Heh. Struggle all you like. No one leaves this graveyard.

73B426.text:
Jack
Looks like it avoided a direct hit.

73B464.text:
Hiltz
Tch. Insects... You could have had an easy death.

73B4DE.text:
Earth
No. He's letting us live.

73B57C.text:
Regina
...Can we really beat that thing? That monster...?

73B647.text:
Jack
A fifty-fifty chance can become no chance or a sure{page}Jack
thing. It depends on our resolve.

73B69E.text:
Jack
Van and the others made a miracle happen.

73B6CE.text:
Jack
Then there's no reason we can't, too.

73B73B.text:
Regina
...You're right! We can make it happen!

73B77A.text:
Earth
Let's get back to the Ultrasaurus.

73B7A6.text:
Republic Officer
Good work out there.

73B7D0.text:
Jack
What about Van and the others?{page}Jack
Is the Ultrasaurus safe?

73B82A.text:
Republic Officer
Second Lieutenant Van Flyheight has safely{page}Republic Officer
rejoined the Ultrasaurus.

73B889.text:
Republic Officer
Colonel Herman, its commander, also left a message for you.

73B8E6.text:
Jack
I thought Colonel Krueger was in command?

73B928.text:
Republic Officer
Colonel Krueger was wounded while directing the battle.

73B965.text:
Republic Officer
Colonel Herman has taken command.

73B9AE.text:
Jack
I see... What's his message?

73B9EA.text:
Republic Officer
He commends your work and thanks you for your assistance.

73BA6B.text:
Regina
Then why did they leave us behind?!

73BAF8.text:
Jack
The Ultrasaurus appeared to be unarmed.{page}Jack
Staying there would've been dangerous.

73BB5D.text:
Regina
Maybe, but I still don't like it!

73BBDF.text:
Republic Officer
To a secret Imperial factory in the Pylemden Islands.

73BC28.text:
Jack
There you have it. What shall we do?

73BC5E.text:
Regina
Isn't it obvious? We're going, too!

73BCA7.text:
Earth
Nobody likes a clingy woman.

73BCD5.text:
Regina
Shut up! They like a clingy man even less!

73BD37.text:
Republic Officer
Dr. D also has an urgent request for you.

73BD7A.text:
Republic Officer
And there's one more message from Colonel Herman...

73BDEA.text:
Republic Officer
The Pylemden Islands are northeast of here, out at sea.

73BE2D.text:
Republic Officer
We have orders to take you there in a Whale King.

73BEDD.text:
Dr. D
Oh, it's you youngsters. Been a while.

73BF21.text:
Jack
Good to see you again, Dr. D. What are you doing here?

73BF7E.text:
Dr. D
Oh, nothing much. Just fitting a cannon I developed.

73C005.text:
Dr. D
The Gravity Cannon! A 25-meter, 16-caliber gun.{page}Dr. D
The ultimate gravity weapon!

73C064.text:
Regina
A Gravity Cannon? Where exactly have you put it?

73C0B5.text:
Dr. D
Too big to notice, eh? There! That's the Gravity Cannon.

73C190.text:
Jack
So this is the Gravity Cannon...

73C1FB.text:
Dr. D
Not even the Death Stinger could withstand the{page}Dr. D
gravity it generates!

73C252.text:
Dr. D
...Or so I'd like to say.

73C2EC.text:
Dr. D
Well... someone's stolen the ammunition.

73C364.text:
Dr. D
I'd love to, but these aren't ordinary shells.

73C3B9.text:
Dr. D
They use an extremely rare substance called planetalcite.

73C400.text:
Dr. D
It's also ridiculously heavy.

73C42A.text:
Dr. D
Planetalcite has its own internal gravity, you see.

73C46D.text:
Dr. D
Apply sudden pressure,{page}Dr. D
and it undergoes gravitational collapse...

73C4E6.text:
Dr. D
We direct that immense gravitational force straight{page}Dr. D
at the target.

73C529.text:
Dr. D
But without the stolen planetalcite,{page}Dr. D
we can't fire a thing.

73C57C.text:
Jack
Even if we go after it, where would we start looking?

73C5C7.text:
Dr. D
Oh, don't worry about that. We know where it is.

73C638.text:
Dr. D
Remember how I said planetalcite has its{page}Dr. D
own internal gravity?

73C681.text:
Dr. D
We've tracked the gravitational anomalies.{page}Dr. D
It's been hidden in seven separate places.

73C6DC.text:
Dr. D
It's so heavy, the thieves couldn't have carried it far.

73C733.text:
Dr. D
We're still narrowing down the exact locations.

73C777.text:
Regina
But if you already know that much...

73C7B9.text:
Dr. D
I'd send someone, but enemy scouts just spotted us.

73C800.text:
Dr. D
Hiltz's forces are bound to launch an air raid.

73C857.text:
Jack
So you can't spare anyone to recover the planetalcite?

73C8A8.text:
Dr. D
Exactly. I need you to retrieve it for us.

73C8EF.text:
Dr. D
Take the Dragoon Nest. It's built for underwater travel.

73C930.text:
Dr. D
You'll be able to search the sea with it, too.

73C96E.text:
Jack
A Dragoon Nest?! How did you get one here?

73C9B7.text:
Dr. D
Ho ho! Nothing's impossible for a genius!

73C9F5.text:
Jack
What do you mean by that, Dr. D?

73CA2F.text:
Dr. D
...Oh, what lovely weather! Perfect for a spot of skiing...

73CAAA.text:
Earth
You thieving old man... You stole the data from our Zoids.

73CB01.text:
Dr. D
Stole?! How rude! I prefer to call it scientific curiosity!

73CB3E.text:
Dr. D
Besides, you couldn't build one from those plans{page}Dr. D
yourselves, could you?

73CBA6.text:
Regina
Well... having this from the start would've made our trip{page}Regina
a lot easier.

73CC31.text:
Dr. D
Ho ho ho! Let's not split hairs.

73CC64.text:
Dr. D
To make it up to you, I'll throw in Irvine and Thomas.

73CCB5.text:
Irvine
Hey, old man! We didn't agree to that!

73CCF7.text:
Thomas
And stop talking about us like we're accessories for{page}Thomas
your Dragoon Nest!

73CD56.text:
Dr. D
So, will you do it?

73CDF1.text:
Dr. D
Thank you. I'm counting on you.

73CE15.text:
Dr. D
One more thing. I'm not so sure Hiltz is behind this theft.

73CEA2.text:
Dr. D
This isn't his style.{page}Dr. D
He wouldn't bother with such a roundabout scheme.

73CEEB.text:
Dr. D
It might be someone you know.

73CF7F.text:
Jack
I don't know. But I suspect we'll find out soon enough.

73CFF6.text:
Dr. D
Sounds like you have a few ideas.{page}Dr. D
Either way, we're running out of time. Hurry!

73D051.text:
Irvine
Well then, let's get to work.

73D08B.text:
Thomas
Glad to be working with you.

73D0B1.text:
Jack
Likewise. We're glad to have you.

73D103.text:
{player}
All right! Let's go recover that planetalcite!

73D11B.text: Irvine and Thomas joined the party!

73D14D.text:
Jack
Prince, Dr. D's calling us.

73D185.text:
Dr. D
It's me! We've located the planetalcite.

73D1C4.text:
Dr. D
Six of the hiding places are underground.

73D1F4.text:
Dr. D
We can't pin down the seventh. It seems to be moving...

73D235.text:
Dr. D
Check the ruins on the island south of here,{page}Dr. D
and the undersea cave to the west.

73D28C.text:
Dr. D
We're getting three readings from each location. Get over there!

73D331.text:
Regina
Raven? Weren't you fighting the Death Stinger?

73D3BD.text:
Raven
...You again. What do you want?

73D48B.text:
Earth
Why were you fighting the Death Stinger?

73D4CC.text:
Jack
You were fighting the Death Stinger, weren't you? Why?

73D515.text:
Jack
Aren't you and Hiltz on the same side?

73D55C.text:
Raven
The same side? Heh. I'm not on anyone's side.

73D589.text:
Raven
What business is it of yours who I fight?

73D5CE.text:
Jack
It isn't. But we seem to have a common enemy.

73D613.text:
Raven
You're fighting the Death Stinger?

73D652.text:
Raven
Ha ha... Now that's a good joke.

73D6E7.text:
Raven
Don't worry, Reese.{page}Raven
Apparently, they're fighting the Death Stinger.

73D73E.text:
Reese
Hiltz?! That... I'll never forgive him!

73D7AB.text:
Raven
I told you. It's none of your business!

73D7EF.text:
Jack
Fair enough. But we could still work together.

73D82B.text:
Raven
Together? Don't make me laugh! You think you can beat Hiltz?!

73D8C6.text:
Earth
We can't beat the Death Stinger alone. So help us.

73D907.text:
Earth
You're not just going to give up, are you?

73D93F.text:
Raven
Heh... Ha ha ha! Did you hear that, Reese?

73D976.text:
Raven
They want my help... Ha ha! That's priceless.

73DA75.text:
Raven
On one condition! I fight my way. Stay out of it.

73DAC2.text:
Jack
Understood. Welcome aboard, Raven. You too, Reese.

73DB10.text:
{player}
With them, we might just pull this off...

73DB28.text: Raven and Reese joined the party!

73DB59.text:
Jack
That's six recovered. Just one more to go.

73DBAC.text:
Regina
But who's behind all this? Was it Opis and Blood after all?

73DC09.text:
Jack
I'm... not sure. Wait, we're getting an emergency call.

73DC7A.text:
Dr. D
The last planetalcite reading is heading straight for us!

73DD2F.text:
Jack
Let's get back to the settlement! Quickly!

73DD89.text:
Blood
I told you! It's mine!

73DDBC.text:
Blood
I won't let you damage the Death Stinger!

73DDF9.text:
Blood
Now hand over that planetalcite!

73DE39.text:
Regina
Not a chance! Give us back the piece you took!

73DE99.text:
Blood
Opis! Stay out of my way!

73DEE0.text:
Opis
That's my line, Blood! What do you think you're doing here?

73DF6B.text:
Opis
What's gotten into you, Blood?{page}Opis
Do you mean to defy His Majesty?

73DFC2.text:
Blood
And if I do... what then?

73DFF8.text:
Opis
Hee hee! Showing your true colors at last, Blood!{page}Opis
Then I'll do this!

73E0A3.text:
Opis
Hee hee! I tampered with that piece before I gave it to you!

73E106.text:
Opis
Let it crush you, Blood!

73E190.text:
Opis
How does that gravity feel?

73E1B8.text:
Opis
Oh, don't bother answering. Hee hee!

73E27F.text:
Opis
Y-You coward! What are you doing?!

73E2B7.text:
Opis
No! My control device! You'll pay for that!

73E302.text:
Opis
Blood... His Majesty will hear about this! Hee hee!

73E3BD.text:
Blood
Why did you save me, {player}?!

73E3EE.text:
Regina
Oh, shut up! He saved your life, and you're complaining?!

73E449.text:
Regina
Because the prince is kind! Hopelessly, ridiculously kind!

73E4BB.text:
Regina
{player}, stay with me! Please... open your eyes...!

73E52D.text:
Regina
{player}! Don't you ever do anything like that again!

73E5BD.text:
Jack
Prince, I have to agree. Please be more careful.

73E636.text:
Jack
Well, that accounts for all the planetalcite.

73E685.text:
Jack
Let's get back to Dr. D.

73E6C8.text:
Dr. D
Ah, there you are! I've been waiting!

73E6F2.text:
Dr. D
Excellent work! Now we can finish the Gravity Cannon!

73E735.text:
Dr. D
And it looks like the Ultrasaurus has{page}Dr. D
finally arrived, too.

73E787.text:
Moonbay
Ugh, my shoulders are killing me.

73E7B3.text:
Colonel Herman
You handled her beautifully, though.

73E7E1.text:
Colonel Herman
Let's mount the Gravity Cannon and get ready for{page}Colonel Herman
the Death Stinger!

73E83F.text:
Jack
Where is the Death Stinger now?

73E895.text:
Dr. D
It's advancing on the Imperial capital, Guygalos.

73E8E0.text:
Dr. D
Destroying every town along the way.

73E918.text:
Irvine
It's following the route we took to Guygalos,{page}Irvine
wiping out everything we passed through.

73E983.text:
Regina
Huh? Why would it do that?

73E9B5.text:
Van
Hiltz wants to erase everything we've done...

73EA0A.text:
Van
And everything we're going to do.

73EA40.text:
Jack
Then the next place it'll attack is... here?

73EACD.text:
Colonel Herman
Van, Irvine, and Thomas will engage the{page}Colonel Herman
Death Stinger directly.

73EB18.text:
Colonel Herman
The Ultrasaurus will support them.

73EB44.text:
Colonel Herman
Your job is to clear the enemy Zoids away{page}Colonel Herman
from the Ultrasaurus.

73EBC4.text:
Operator
Radar contact! The Death Stinger and multiple enemy Zoid{page}Operator
units are approaching!

73EC1F.text:
Colonel Herman
So, they're here... All hands, battle stations!

73EC69.text:
Jack
Remember, our job is to keep the enemy Zoids away{page}Jack
from the Ultrasaurus.

73ECC2.text:
Jack
We have to hold this position until the Gravity Cannon fires.

73ED37.text:
Regina
Got it. {player}... please be careful.

73EDBC.text:
Jack
I wonder how Van and the others are doing.

73EDF2.text:
Jack
I think the Gravity Cannon fired while we were fighting...

73EE51.text:
Earth
...Looks like that last shot was intercepted.

73EEA4.text:
Regina
Then... then we've only got one shot left...

73EEE3.text:
Hiltz
I could finish you off easily. But I'll let you live for now.

73EF58.text:
Hiltz
Naturally, I'll destroy every town and village along the way.

73EF97.text:
Hiltz
Curse your own weakness as you wait for the{page}Hiltz
capital to vanish.

73EFDC.text:
Hiltz
I'll deal with you afterward.

73F012.text:
Van
We're not done yet, Hiltz!

73F04C.text:
Thomas
That's right, Van.{page}Thomas
Looks like he didn't have enough energy after all.

73F0F7.text:
Van
We're not dying until we've knocked you flat!

73F13E.text:
Van
Irvine! Thomas! We can't mess this one up!

73F22A.text:
Hiltz
Heh. Try all you like. It won't change a thing... What?!

73F2D6.text:
Colonel Herman
Hiltz! This is for the Republic!

73F363.text:
Regina
Hah... hah... Are there any left?

73F399.text:
Jack
I... I think we got them all...

73F3DD.text:
Regina
What happened to the Death Stinger...?

73F424.text:
Jack
I'm not sure.{page}Jack
It looked like the Gravity Cannon hit it this time...

73F55F.text:
Regina
What?! What's happening to it?

73F5E8.text:
Opis
Fascinating! The Death Stinger really is fascinating!

73F631.text:
Opis
But beside the power of the Zoid Eve, it's merely a catalyst.

73F6AE.text:
Jack
The Zoid Eve? What's that?

73F6EA.text:
Opis
The power to bring prosperity... or extinction... to every Zoid.

73F733.text:
Jack
Prosperity or extinction... to every Zoid?

73F773.text:
Opis
Hee hee! Oh, it's irresistible! My scientist's blood is boiling!

73F7C2.text:
Opis
A specimen that makes the Death Stinger look trivial!{page}Opis
I must have it!

73F80D.text:
Opis
Can you feel my excitement? No, of course you can't!{page}Opis
Hee hee hee!

73F86E.text:
Regina
What are you talking about?! The Zoid Eve is in Eveopolis...

73F8BD.text:
Regina
You didn't... You opened the gates to Eveopolis?!

73F906.text:
Opis
Precisely. Hee hee! Though sadly, I can't take the credit.

73F94D.text:
Opis
I'm in a generous mood today. Here's another little tidbit!

73F9C0.text:
Opis
Or rather, the Ancient Zoidian, Elisi Linette.

73FA71.text:
Opis
See you in Eveopolis! Hee hee!

73FB34.text:
Jack
And the Zoid Eve... Regina, can you explain?

73FBAD.text:
Regina
A city of the Ancient Zoidians who once flourished here on Zi.

73FBF8.text:
Regina
The Zoid Eve is there. It's the source of energy for every Zoid.

73FC4F.text:
Regina
But it was supposed to be sealed away...{page}Regina
How could Hiltz have opened the gates?!

73FD06.text:
Jack
It seems we have no choice but to go. Regina?

73FD4B.text:
Regina
The Zoid Eve is in Eveopolis... If its power is unleashed...

73FDA0.text:
Regina
If Hiltz gets his hands on it...

73FE4C.text:
{player}
Then we have to get there first!

73FEA5.text:
Regina
...West of here, in Rare Hertz Valley...

73FF54.text:
Regina
Let's get back to the Ultrasaurus first.

73FF9B.text:
Raven
This is where we part ways. I'll finish the Death Stinger myself.

73FFF3.text:
Reese
Raven, I'm coming with you!

740028.text:
Jack
Colonel Herman! Are you all right?

740060.text:
Colonel Herman
The Death Stinger caught us by surprise.{page}Colonel Herman
The Ultrasaurus still can't move!

7400B1.text:
Colonel Herman
Van and the others went after it, but...

7400FE.text:
Regina
They've probably gone to Eveopolis,{page}Regina
in Rare Hertz Valley...

74014B.text:
Colonel Herman
What?! We don't have time to check that now.

740186.text:
Colonel Herman
Take this Whale King and head for Eveopolis!

7401D7.text:
Colonel Herman
We'll catch up with you. I promise!

74022A.text:
Opis
You finally made it. Hee hee!

740288.text:
Opis
Just in time for the event of the century!

7402CC.text:
Jack
The event of the century?

740316.text:
Opis
The Death Saurer that appeared in Guygalos...{page}Opis
I thought it was the genuine article.

740367.text:
Opis
But it was a mere imitation,{page}Opis
cloned from the original's Zoid genes.

7403BA.text:
Opis
Now the true Death Saurer is about to be born!

740405.text:
Opis
The beast of destruction! Hee hee hee!

74044A.text:
Dark Kaiser
Death Stinger! I've been waiting.{page}Dark Kaiser
Now, merge with the Death Saurer!

7404AB.text:
Dark Kaiser
I shall claim your power... No, the Death Saurer shall claim it!

740504.text:
Dark Kaiser
What's wrong, Death Stinger?{page}Dark Kaiser
Surrender yourself to the Death Saurer!

740569.text:
Hiltz
Your time is up, Dark Kaiser.

7405A5.text:
Dark Kaiser
Hmm? What are you--

7405CD.text:
Dark Kaiser
Graaagh! What's happening to me?!

74063E.text:
Hiltz
You thought you'd gained the Death{page}Hiltz
Saurer's immense power...

740691.text:
Hiltz
But it was using you all along.

7406CE.text:
Hiltz
You were nothing but an eggshell protecting{page}Hiltz
its precious core.

74070C.text:
Dark Kaiser
I... I am the Death Saurer!

740771.text:
Hiltz
You have no right to command the Death Saurer!

7407AC.text:
Hiltz
You're just an inferior life-form.

7407D6.text:
Hiltz
Only I, an Ancient Zoidian, can claim everything!

740823.text:
Hiltz
Your part is over.{page}Hiltz
You've done well to protect the Death Saurer this long.

740870.text:
Hiltz
Thank you for your service. I'll take it from here.

74090D.text:
Opis
Hee hee! Magnificent! Absolutely magnificent!

74095C.text:
Opis
The true Death Saurer! Hee hee!

74099E.text:
Regina
No... Do you want to destroy this whole world?!

740A17.text:
Jack
The beast of destruction... It certainly lives up to the name.

740A98.text:
Regina
We can't... We can't fight a monster like that...

740B40.text:
Jack
He's right. As long as the prince keeps going...{page}Jack
as long as he doesn't give up, there's still hope.

740B99.text:
Jack
We're the Three Beast Knights.{page}Jack
Whatever happens, we stand at his side. Isn't that right?

740C44.text:
Regina
Yes. I'm one of the Three Beast Knights...

740CF9.text:
Earth
Damn it! Is that thing immortal?!

740D2F.text:
Jack
So this is... the true Death Saurer's power...!

740D76.text:
Regina
Stay with me, Earth! Jack! Don't give up!

740DF0.text:
Van
That's right! It's too early to give up!

740E56.text:
Van
Buy me a little time!

740EB6.text:
Van
I'm going to fire the Blade Liger out of the Gravity Cannon!{page}Van
With me in it!

740F2B.text:
Regina
What?! You're using the Blade Liger as a shell?!

740FAA.text:
Van
We won't know unless we try!

741065.text:
Regina
Are you trying to get yourself killed?!

7410B3.text:
Jack
...Right now, we have to put our faith in Van!

741134.text:
Regina
All right. Let's believe in a miracle!

741171.text:
Hiltz
Do you insects crave death that badly...?

7411A7.text:
Hiltz
Then I'll grant your wish.{page}Hiltz
Disappear, along with this wretched planet!

741202.text:
Regina
We're not letting you charge that cannon!

7412D8.text:
Schubaltz
Prepare to fire the Gravity Cannon!{page}Schubaltz
Power generator to maximum output!

7413A5.text:
Thomas
Generator output at 8.05 teravolts!{page}Thomas
Brother, it won't go any higher!

741412.text:
Schubaltz
It'll have to do! Lieutenant Van Flyheight will handle the rest!

7414D3.text:
Irvine
Hey, Moonbay! Hold her steady! We're drifting!

741526.text:
Moonbay
I'm doing the best I can!

74155A.text:
Moonbay
Come on, you big lug! Hold together!

741921.text:
Regina
...We did it! We did it, {player}!

741972.text:
Van
Hey! You made it! I knew you were tough!

7419B2.text:
Jack
Look who's talking... That was reckless, even for you.

7419F0.text:
Van
Yeah, I knew it was crazy!

741A1C.text:
Van
But you're hardly ones to talk!

741A5C.text:
Van
Seriously, thanks. I couldn't have done it without you.

741A98.text:
Jack
All we did was believe in you. That's all.

741B66.text:
Fiona
Free the Zoids in your world from all this fighting, too.

741BDA.text:
Van
Let's meet again someday. See you around!

741C41.text:
Fiona
And you... look after {player}, all right?

741C9C.text:
Regina
Let's go home. Back to our world.

741CF5.text:
Opis
You actually defeated the Death Saurer.{page}Opis
I never thought I'd see it.

741D39.text:
Opis
Hee hee! Prince {player},{page}Opis
you're quite an intriguing specimen yourself.

741D81.text:
Regina
Opis! Where have you been hiding all this time?

741DC5.text:
Opis
How rude! I'm here to study Zoids, not fight.

741E10.text:
Opis
And this has been a very productive expedition.

741E52.text:
Opis
Blood got in the way,{page}Opis
but I accomplished nearly everything I came for.

741E9D.text:
Opis
I even obtained the Death Saurer's Zoid genes!{page}Opis
The original's, of course!

741F02.text:
Jack
The Death Saurer's Zoid genes?!

741F62.text:
Opis
Leave them?! You can't possibly expect me to do that!

742026.text:
Regina
Enough! Hand over those Zoid genes!

742071.text:
Opis
Zoid genes? Whatever do you mean?

7420A9.text:
Regina
Don't play dumb! The Death Saurer's Zoid genes!

7420F2.text:
Opis
Hee hee! Those were delivered to His Majesty long ago.

74216F.text:
Opis
Hee hee! We have all the data we need. At last...

7421F4.text:
Opis
Our ultimate Zoid will be complete!

742228.text:
Opis
It'll make the Death Saurer look pathetic! Hee hee!

7422A3.text:
Opis
It's only a matter of time before it awakens.{page}Opis
Do come to the unveiling!

7422FC.text:
Opis
As its first victims! Hee hee hee hee!

74237C.text:
Regina
Even after all this... you're still going to toy with their lives...?

7423FB.text:
Regina
{player}... You're right.{page}Regina
