We can't just stand here feeling sorry for them!

74244D.text:
Regina
We're not letting them get away with this! Let's hurry back!

7424AA.text:
{player}
Right. Let's hurry back to Arcadia.

74251E.text:
Gale
Your Majesty. I've brought Fran.

74260F.text:
Emperor
He betrayed me. After everything I did to raise him!

742656.text:
Emperor
Even my own son cannot be forgiven for this.

7426D9.text:
Emperor
Flam, I'll give you two choices.

74270B.text:
Emperor
Obey my order... or become food for my ultimate Zoid.

742850.text:
Emperor
What is it, Gale? Are you asking me to spare this fool?

742893.text:
Gale
No. But we need more time.

7428C7.text:
Gale
Your ultimate Zoid still needs time to awaken fully,{page}Gale
does it not?

74294F.text:
Opis
The Zoid Core is almost awake. But before it can move...

7429E4.text:
Opis
Yes! Another five hours... No, four should be enough...

742A28.text:
Gale
Let Fran defend Arcadia Castle's main gate to the last.{page}Gale
She can buy us some time.

742A8B.text:
Emperor
If she's going to die anyway, we might as well make use of her?

742B3C.text:
Emperor
Don't disappoint me, Fran! Die for your emperor!

742C2C.text:
Opis
Hee hee! That's it... Slowly, open your eyes...

742C6B.text:
Opis
Can you see the world? The world you'll tear to pieces!{page}Opis
Hee hee hee!

742CD2.text:
Emperor
Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha!

742D2D.text:
Emperor
I am your father! Now, greet me!

742D66.text:
Emperor
Show your father what you can do!

742DF4.text:
Emperor
Ha ha ha ha ha!

742E26.text:
Emperor
Wonderful! Magnificent! That's my son!

742E77.text:
Royal Soldier
We've detected an enormous energy surge at Arcadia{page}Royal Soldier
Castle! Come quickly!

742F28.text:
Royal Soldier 1
We don't know! Please, get to the command room!

742F6F.text:
Royal Soldier 2
It's the castle! Arcadia Castle...!

74304D.text:
Regina
Wh-What is this horrible feeling...?

743098.text:
Earth
I don't know.{page}Earth
But there's something monstrous in that castle.

74310E.text:
Emperor
Hear me, you miserable insects!

743192.text:
Emperor
I am the emperor of the New Arcadian Empire!

7431BC.text:
Emperor
I am the new ruler of this land... No, of the whole of Zi!

743209.text:
Emperor
Behold the light of the Charged Particle Cannon!{page}Emperor
This is my power!

74324A.text:
Emperor
Defy me, and you'll become nothing but particles,{page}Emperor
scattered across the earth!

74329F.text:
Emperor
I am prepared to bathe this entire planet in that light!

7432DE.text:
Emperor
Submit to my rule! Know your place, insects!

743335.text:
Emperor
I am the emperor of the New Arcadian Empire!

743375.text:
Emperor
Heh heh... Ha ha ha ha!

7433BB.text:
Regina
Who does he think he is?! We're not letting him do this!

7433FE.text:
Regina
This planet doesn't belong to him...{page}Regina
It doesn't belong to anyone!

74344F.text:
Jack
An ultimatum. So their ultimate Zoid is complete?

7434CA.text:
Regina
You two! This concerns us too, you know!

74350C.text:
Jack
What are you talking about, Regina?

74353A.text:
Jack
We're the Three Beast Knights.{page}Jack
Whatever happens, we stand by the prince.

74358D.text:
Earth
He's made up his mind. There's nothing more to say.

743633.text:
Regina
...{player}, when did you start looking so grown-up?

74367F.text:
Regina
Getting a bit big for your boots, aren't you, {player}...?

7436B4.text:
Regina
Come on! We need some fighting spirit!

743766.text:
{player}
Let's go. We're the only ones who can stop him.

743787.text:
Regina
All right! This is the final battle!

743824.text:
Jack
Prince, here's what we know about the situation{page}Jack
at Arcadia Castle.

743875.text:
Jack
The enemy has been strengthening its defenses ever{page}Jack
since they occupied it.

7438CC.text:
Jack
The inside may be very different from the castle we remember.

74391F.text:
Jack
Of the two main gates,{page}Jack
the north gate collapsed in that cannon blast.

743972.text:
Jack
The underground passage we escaped through has caved in,{page}Jack
too. We can't use it.

7439C9.text:
Regina
So the south gate's our only way in?

743A01.text:
Jack
Yes. It was sealed tight, but it's open now.

743ACD.text:
Jack
It could go either way.{page}Jack
Regardless, we have to get through it to enter the castle.

743B50.text:
Regina
A frontal assault, then. Won't that be a bit much for just us?

743BA1.text:
Jack
We have a way to bolster our forces. Don't we, Earth?

743BFA.text:
Earth
Right. We've crossed all sorts of worlds and helped{page}Earth
plenty of people.

743C4F.text:
Earth
It's time to call in a few favors.

743CC0.text:
Jack
Exactly. This time, we'll invite them to our world to help us.

743D17.text:
Jack
The space-time transporter has limits, though.{page}Jack
We can't summon groups from several eras at once.

743D72.text:
Jack
We can only bring in two people to help us.

743DAD.text:
Jack
That's everything, Prince. Is it clear?

743DEE.text:
Jack
Earth and I will start arranging for reinforcements.

743E37.text:
Jack
Speak to either of us when you'd like to call someone in.

743EA8.text:
Regina
I'll make the final arrangements with the royal army.

743EDE.text:
Regina
Prince, let me know when you're ready to leave.

743F4D.text:
Jack
Here's everyone we've managed to contact.

743F7C.text:
Jack
Who would you like to ask for help?

744285.text:
Jack
Would you like to ask someone else?

7442CA.text:
Jack
Speak to me again whenever you'd like to call for help.

74431D.text:
Jack
Understood. I'll call them before we leave.

744389.text:
Earth
Who do you want to call?

744684.text:
Earth
Want to change the team?

7446C7.text:
Earth
Talk to me again when you want to call for help.

74470E.text:
Earth
Got it. I'll call them before we leave.

74478A.text:
Regina
This is it. Let's head for Arcadia Castle!

7447D2.text:
Royal Soldier
I'm sorry...{page}Royal Soldier
All those time jumps seem to have taken their toll.

744817.text:
Royal Soldier
The transporter is unstable. We can't use it right now.

744884.text:
Regina
We're finally back... Arcadia Castle.

7448E9.text:
Jack
Stay on your guard. The real fight starts here.

74492C.text:
Jack
There's a large energy reading beneath the castle.

744969.text:
Jack
We'll head straight for it.

74499B.text:
Jack
The royal army can handle{page}Jack
liberating the rest of the castle.

7449ED.text:
{player}
All right! Let's head straight for the basement!

744AA7.text:
Earth
Flam. Are you going to fight us?

744AD9.text:
Fran
Heh. What a silly question. Yes, I'll fight. But not to defeat you.

744B5C.text:
Fran
Yes. I'll fight for him. It's all I can do now.

744BCF.text:
Fran
Fighting's the only way I can be of any use...{page}Fran
Do you think I'm a fool?

744C28.text:
Earth
Silly question. Don't ask a man who can do nothing but fight.

744CEA.text:
Fran
...I lost. Blood... I couldn't do anything for you after all...

744E40.text:
Emperor
I have no place for useless wretches!

744E7D.text:
Fran
...So this is it for me... Goodbye, Blood...

744ED5.text:
Blood
Don't you dare say that!

744F33.text:
Blood
Come on, Fran! Come with me!

744FC2.text:
Regina
What was that?! An explosion? What about Fran?!

74502A.text:
Earth
Don't forget why we're here!

7450D6.text:
Jack
Earth, tell the royal army we've broken through the gate.

74510C.text:
Jack
We'll keep heading deeper into the castle.

745148.text:
Earth
Right. That's how it should be... Let's go.

745182.text:
Gale
...You're here. Sooner than I expected.

745207.text:
Gale
Heh. You sound awfully sure you can beat me.

745249.text:
Jack
We will. We won't lose to someone with nothing{page}Jack
to believe in.

745298.text:
Gale
Something to believe in...{page}Gale
I haven't heard that in a long time.

7452DA.text:
Jack
Then tell me! Why are you helping the emperor?!

74532D.text:
Gale
And what would you do if you knew? Forgive me?{page}Gale
Don't flatter yourself!

7453A0.text:
Gale
What use is pity for an enemy on the battlefield?

7453C8.text:
Gale
Can you fight like that?{page}Gale
Can you protect what matters to you?

745413.text:
Gale
Can you achieve what you've set out to do?

74544B.text:
Gale
Is that what your conviction amounts to?

7454E1.text:
Jack
Very well. I won't ask for your reasons again.

745519.text:
Jack
I'll face you as an enemy, and defeat you.

74554B.text:
Gale
Good. That's the way. Mercy has no place on the battlefield.{page}Gale
One day, it'll get you killed.

7455AA.text:
Gale
Now, show me the strength of your convictions!

745633.text:
Gale
Heh... You've shown me what you believe in...

7456A6.text:
Gale
Instructor... You still call me that?

7456DD.text:
Gale
But there's nothing left for me to teach you.

745711.text:
Gale
Go on. The emperor should be in the underground factory.

745758.text:
Gale
Do your duty... Finish what you set out to do.

7457AF.text:
Jack
Instructor Gale... Thank you for everything you taught me.

74584D.text:
Gale
Jack... There was so much more I wanted to say.{page}Gale
But it seems I'm out of time.

7458D6.text:
Gale
Forgive me for not being able to save you.

745915.text:
Gale
But you won't have to be lonely.{page}Gale
I'll go on ahead and wait for you.

7459D9.text:
Gale
Blood... Heh. So that's it...

745A1E.text:
Blood
Gale. Your life belongs to me now.

745A90.text:
Blood
Your daughter's in my care. That's why.

745AFA.text:
Gale
I see. Then I owe you my life.

745B41.text:
Blood
I'll decide where you die. Come with me!

745B8F.text:
Gale
I thought you preferred stabbing people in the back.

745BD6.text:
Blood
A brave warrior deserves to be faced head-on.{page}Blood
That's what I believe.

745C30.text:
Opis
Hee hee! At last, our guests arrive.

745C66.text:
Opis
I won't fall as easily as Gale and Fran! Hee hee!

745CB1.text:
Regina
Shut up! We're not losing to a man who hides{page}Regina
behind cheap tricks!

745D48.text:
Opis
Such a nasty tongue, too.{page}Opis
You'll never find a boyfriend talking like that.

745D9F.text:
Regina
S-Shut up! That's none of your business!

745DE4.text:
Opis
Then surely my methods are none of yours?

745E73.text:
Opis
Oh, never mind. Young girls are such fun to tease. Hee hee!

745EF0.text:
Opis
I'm always serious.{page}Opis
Especially about defeating you, right here and now!

745F52.text:
Opis
Grrr! Don't you have any respect for your elders?!

745F9D.text:
Regina
Ever thought about making room for the next generation?!

745FEA.text:
Opis
You insolent little brat!{page}Opis
Die with me, and I'll forgive you! Hee hee!

746089.text:
Regina
He's going to blow himself up?!

7460B5.text:
Earth
He doesn't know when to quit.

746164.text:
Opis
Hee hee! I am a genius, after all!{page}Opis
I've prepared all sorts of tricks for just such an--

7461F8.text:
Opis
Hee hee! Blood. And you've brought Gale and Fran...

74623D.text:
Opis
Have you betrayed the emperor, too?

746277.text:
Gale
I was never loyal to him. Neither were you, were you?

7462CA.text:
Opis
Hee hee! I'm a scientist.{page}Opis
I'd sell my soul to the devil for my research!

746351.text:
Opis
Hee hee! What now, then?

74638B.text:
Blood
Our last duty as the Four Generals.{page}Blood
We'll see the emperor's end for ourselves.

7463D6.text:
Opis
I see. Good luck with that.

746409.text:
Blood
You're coming too, Opis.{page}Blood
You're one of the Four Generals, remember?

74645D.text:
Emperor
So, you've made it this far.

74648F.text:
Emperor
The Four Generals are all useless!

7464BE.text:
Regina
It's over! Admit you've lost!

74650B.text:
Emperor
I've lost...? Heh heh heh...

74657C.text:
Emperor
As long as I have this ultimate Zoid...

7465A8.text:
Emperor
I am the ruler of this kingdom! No, of all Zi!

74661B.text:
Regina
What... What is that horrible Zoid...?

746664.text:
Earth
Tch. Here comes the main attraction.

746690.text:
Jack
So this is the source of his power...!

7466CE.text:
Emperor
Well?! This is my power!

746704.text:
Emperor
That's what separates me from the fool who clung to this{page}Emperor
musty old kingdom!

746749.text:
Emperor
And it's what separates me from you, {player}!{page}Emperor
His son!

746979.text:
Regina
But... we never heard that His Majesty had a brother...

7469F4.text:
Emperor
In this rotten kingdom, when twins are born to the royal{page}Emperor
family, the younger is killed at birth.

746A53.text:
Jack
I... I've heard of that custom.

746A8B.text:
Jack
But there's never been any mention of twins being born...

746AD4.text:
Emperor
Do you think they'd announce that they'd killed one of{page}Emperor
their newborn sons?

746B59.text:
Emperor
That's where this scar came from...

746BB2.text:
Earth
So... this is revenge against Arcadia?

746C21.text:
Emperor
I should have been killed, yet here I stand.{page}Emperor
Doesn't that strike you as strange?

746C72.text:
Emperor
It's simple. I was chosen by God! I was blessed!

746CBD.text:
Emperor
No one but me can rule Arcadia!

746D02.text:
Emperor
My worthless brother was an evil man,{page}Emperor
standing in the way of my divine mission!

746D57.text:
Emperor
And everyone who served him is just as guilty!

746D90.text:
Emperor
So is the land that accepted his rule!{page}Emperor
And this planet, Zi, that let him live!

746DDF.text:
Emperor
I'll punish everything that betrayed me!{page}Emperor
This is divine judgment!

746E4B.text:
Emperor
I began by passing judgment on my brother.

746E73.text:
Emperor
By now, his particles must be drifting through the air.

746ED6.text:
Emperor
I wish you could have seen the terror on his face!

746FDC.text:
Emperor
Those eyes! You have the same eyes as my brother!

747015.text:
Emperor
Don't look at me like that! I won't allow it, {player}!

747096.text:
Emperor
Am I losing?! Am I going to be defeated?!

7471C4.text:
Jack
There are so many people who still need you.

7471FF.text:
Jack
And so much that only you can do.

747271.text:
Opis
Heeeek! My ultimate Zoid! My beautiful creation!

747383.text:
Blood
I'll defeat you and rule this kingdom!

7473E9.text:
Blood
Let's settle which of us deserves to rule!

74746C.text:
Fran
I've decided to follow Blood. So I'll defeat you, Earth.

7474C5.text:
Earth
I see... You've found something to live for besides revenge.

747563.text:
Gale
I'm no longer your instructor.{page}Gale
Now, I want to face you as a fellow soldier.

7476B9.text:
Opis
Oh, nothing. I just wondered if we had a moment of our own.

747811.text:
Emperor
I am the emperor! I cannot be defeated!

74783F.text:
Emperor
Heh heh... Ha ha ha ha!

74786F.text:
Emperor
Meet your end with me!

7478AE.text:
Opis
He's sent the space-time transporter out of control!

747916.text:
Opis
The transporter creates a kind of black hole to cross{page}Opis
time and space!

747965.text:
Opis
If that black hole runs out of control...

7479E4.text:
Opis
This entire planet will disappear.

747A14.text:
Emperor
Heh heh... Ha ha ha ha!

747A50.text:
Jack
Isn't there a way to stop it?!

747A88.text:
Opis
The black hole connects to a white hole.

747AC7.text:
Opis
An entrance and an exit.{page}Opis
Together, they keep the passage through time and space stable.

747B28.text:
Jack
Then if we destroy the exit...?

747B62.text:
Opis
The black hole will lose its exit and disappear.

747B96.text:
Opis
But to destroy the exit,{page}Opis
someone has to cross to the other side.

747BD7.text:
Opis
They'll never return to this world!

747C17.text:
Regina
But couldn't we use the transporter in the ruins...?

747C59.text:
Opis
It's out of control! We have no idea where it leads!

747CB0.text:
Emperor
Vanish, all of you! Ha ha ha ha!

747D43.text:
Blood
You do what you have to do.

747D84.text:
Fran
Blood! You're not going alone!

747E74.text:
Gale
Young people are always so reckless.{page}Gale
It seems they'll need me with them.

747EF3.text:
Gale
Jack. Look after my daughter... Julia.

747F8A.text:
Opis
Good grief. Rushing off without even knowing how to{page}Opis
destroy the gate...

748004.text:
Regina
Why?! Why are you all doing this?! All of you...!

7480E7.text:
Earth
Prince. Let's go. There's work for us to do...

748136.text:
Jack
He's right, Prince. Everyone's waiting for us. Let's go.

748237.text:
Queen
I wish your father could be here...{page}Queen
If he could see you now...

748284.text:
Queen
I'm sure he'd know the kingdom is in good hands.

748306.text:
Queen
Your duties as king of Arcadia are waiting for you.

748389.text:
Regina
Your Majesty, Prince {player}.{page}Regina
Everything's ready. Please come to the throne room.

7483DA.text:
Queen
...Very well. I'll go ahead.{page}Queen
Regina, take care of {player}, won't you?

7484E3.text:
Regina
...So much has happened...{page}Regina
But it feels like it all went by in an instant.

748544.text:
Regina
...You're growing into a man, aren't you, {player}...?

748584.text:
Regina
And I kept thinking of you as my little brother...

7486C7.text:
Regina
...Honestly. You're still a handful, little brother...

748789.text:
Earth
Finished with the love scene?

7487E4.text:
Regina
Wh-Wh-What are you talking about?!

748905.text:
Regina
Is this a Trinity Liger?!

74893D.text:
Jack
A Trinity Liger? I've never heard of that Zoid.

748988.text:
Regina
They say it was built to guard Arcadia's ancient legacy.

748A36.text:
Regina
Its Zoid Core is dead... But the Zi Data looks usable.

748AB7.text:
Regina
It's like a blueprint for building a Zoid from a Zoid Core.

748B00.text:
Regina
The technology was invented in Arcadia.{page}Regina
With this data, you don't need a military facility.

748B5F.text:
Regina
An ordinary Zoid lab can build it for you.

748BA2.text:
Regina
You'll still need a Zoid Core and parts, of course... And money.

748C3C.text:
Regina
Excuse me, could you take a look at this Zi Data?

748C80.text:
Dr. T
Incredible! This is Trinity Liger Zi Data!

748CD5.text:
Regina
How do you know about the Trinity Liger?

748D26.text:
Dr. T
I'm Dr. T, head of the Zoid lab here in Arcana.

748D67.text:
Dr. T
The king asked me to research Arcadia's ancient legacy.

748DBE.text:
Dr. T
The Trinity Liger is the biggest part of that research.

748E01.text:
Dr. T
But I had no idea where it was... Where did you find this?

748E6E.text:
Regina
Deep in a secret passage beneath Arcadia Castle...

748EAE.text:
Dr. T
I see... Without all that's happened,{page}Dr. T
you might never have found it.

748F07.text:
Dr. T
Is His Majesty safe?

748F5E.text:
Regina
Um... Anyway, can you build a Trinity Liger from this data?

748FC1.text:
Dr. T
Hmm. With most Zoids, it'd be simple...{page}Dr. T
But the Trinity Liger needs a special core.

749020.text:
Dr. T
...There may only be one in the whole world.

749067.text:
Dr. T
Without it, I can't build a Trinity Liger.

74910D.text:
Dr. T
Hmm... If only we had a Trinity Liger Zoid Core...

749165.text:
Dr. T
I've been helping the royal army, too.{page}Dr. T
I adjusted the space-time transporter so you can use it.

7491B8.text:
Dr. T
But the enemy's transporter interferes with it.{page}Dr. T
We can't quite pick and choose which era we visit.

749224.text:
Dr. T
If only there were a Trinity Liger Zoid Core in another era...

749282.text:
Dr. T
Th-That's... A Trinity Liger Zoid Core!

7492C5.text:
Dr. T
Yes! With this, the Trinity Liger can live again!

749312.text:
Dr. T
You have to let our lab build it!

749362.text:
Dr. T
How's the Trinity Liger doing?

7493C3.text:
Dr. T
Oh, I'd love to be a Zoid pilot too!{page}Dr. T
Racing across the land like the wind!

74942A.text:
Dr. T
I'm jealous of you all.

74945F.text:
Dr. T
Hello! Come on in.

749481.text:
Dr. T
How's the Trinity Liger...?

7494EE.text:
Dr. T
What have you done to my Trinity Liger?!

749524.text:
Dr. T
Its beauty! Its power! Its nobility! You've ruined it all!

749583.text:
Dr. T
I was supposed to be the first to modify the Trinity Liger!

7495DF.text:
Dr. T
I should've been the first to modify the Trinity Liger!

74963F.text:
Dr. T
Win with the Trinity Liger for me, won't you?

74968D.text:
Dr. T
I'd love to go traveling and collect Zi Data myself.

7496C3.text:
Researcher
Have you tried Deck Commands?{page}Researcher
They're special tactics and battle plans.

749736.text:
Researcher
Before battle, choose up to six in the Cmds menu.

749783.text:
Researcher
You can use one per turn. Once you've used it,{page}Researcher
you can't use it again until the next battle.

7497F0.text:
Researcher
Use them well, and they'll give you an edge.

74983D.text:
Researcher
Here, try this command we developed at our lab.

749883.text:
Researcher
Have you tried Deck Commands?{page}Researcher
They're special tactics and battle plans.

7498F6.text:
Researcher
Before battle, choose up to six in the Cmds menu.

749943.text:
Researcher
You can use one per turn. Once you've used it,{page}Researcher
you can't use it again until the next battle.

7499B0.text:
Researcher
Use them well, and they'll give you an edge.

749A0A.text:
Regina
Honestly, {player}! Going off on another trip...{page}Regina
Don't you know you're the king now?!

749A64.text:
Earth
Then why are you coming?{page}Earth
Can't say no to the man you love?

749AB3.text:
Regina
I-I-I'm just doing my duty as one of the Three Beast Knights!

749B02.text:
Jack
Still, this newly discovered era is quite intriguing.

749B3F.text:
Jack
It seems completely unlike anywhere we've visited.{page}Jack
We ought to investigate.

749B9C.text:
Earth
I'm getting tired of castle life anyway.{page}Earth
It'll be good to travel with the others again.

749C21.text:
Regina
Ah, King {player}.{page}Regina
Let me know when you're ready to leave.

749C71.text:
Jack
Earth and I will call the companions you'd like to bring.

749CB9.text:
Regina
Your Majesty, are you ready?

749CFE.text:
Regina
All right! Let's set off on a new adventure!

749D40.text:
Vega
Huh? How'd I end up in this weird place?

749D70.text:
Vega
...Oh well! Come play with my Fury!

749DC6.text:
Vega
No way! That's impossible! This has to be a dream!

749E5A.text:
Regina
He must've been caught in a time jump.

749E98.text:
Jack
Looks like he was collecting Zi Data and Zoid Cores, too...

749EEB.text:
Jack
He left some interesting things behind.

749F25.text:
Researcher
We've found Zi Data for the Zoids the emperor's army used!

749F6E.text:
Researcher
We've found the Zi Data the emperor's army was collecting!

749FB7.text:
Researcher
I'd love to use it to develop Zoids for our own kingdom.

74A01A.text:
Jack
There are three planetalcite readings left in these ruins.

74A05B.text:
Jack
There are two planetalcite readings left in these ruins.

74A09C.text:
Jack
There's one planetalcite reading left in these ruins.

74A0DD.text:
Jack
There are no more planetalcite readings in these ruins.

74A127.text:
Dr. D
I'm still pinpointing the location.{page}Dr. D
Can you keep fighting for a little longer?

74A183.text:
Dr. D
Destroy the auxiliary devices around Chronos Fortress{page}Dr. D
to the north.

74A1D9.text:
Dr. D
The amplifier itself is in the underground hangar at Chronos{page}Dr. D
Fortress. Destroy it!

74A23B.text:
Dr. D
First, fetch the laser from the underground armory{page}Dr. D
behind this fortress.

74A2A3.text:
Dr. D
Break through the bedrock deep inside the volcano.{page}Dr. D
It's our last hope. I'm counting on you!

74A302.text:
Royal Guard
Earth's in the soldiers' quarters. He never skips{page}Royal Guard
training. You can tell he used to be an Imperial officer.

74A369.text:
Royal Guard
Prince, please stay inside the castle.

74A39E.text:
Royal Guard
The Zoid hangar is downstairs.{page}Royal Guard
It's not safe to be in there, so please stay out.

74A3F1.text:
Royal Guard
The Three Beast Knights come from Arcadia, the Empire,{page}Royal Guard
and the Republic. Earth represents the Empire.

74A45C.text:
Royal Guard
The Republic countered the Empire's might with tactics.{page}Royal Guard
Jack served in their army.{page}Royal Guard
I always learn something from his lessons.

74A4DD.text:
Royal Guard
The Three Beast Knights come from Arcadia, the Empire,{page}Royal Guard
and the Republic. Jack represents the Republic.

74A54C.text:
Queen of Arcadia
{player}... What's the matter?{page}Queen of Arcadia
Aren't you supposed to be studying?

74A59E.text:
Royal Guard
The fighting on the Central Continent has eased.{page}Royal Guard
I hope the whole planet can enjoy some peace...

74A613.text:
Royal Guard
Arcadia's a small kingdom, surrounded by countries we{page}Royal Guard
can't trust. His Majesty must have a lot on his mind.

74A680.text:
Royal Guard
The royal family's guarded a secret treasure for generations.{page}Royal Guard
Nobody knows what it is, though.

74A6F3.text:
Royal Guard
His Majesty is making his rounds of the castle.

74A736.text:
Royal Guard
The Zoid hangar is downstairs.{page}Royal Guard
It's dangerous, so please stay out.

74A789.text:
Royal Guard
Prince, please stay inside the castle.

74A7BE.text:
Queen of Arcadia
{player}... What's the matter?{page}Queen of Arcadia
Aren't you supposed to be studying?

74A810.text:
Boy
Loads of Zoids went into the castle!{page}Boy
I'm going to be a Zoid pilot when I grow up!

74A87B.text:
Townsperson
Yesterday, I thought we'd have peace forever...{page}Townsperson
What's going to happen to us now?

74A8E6.text:
Townsperson
Damn them! Strutting around like they own the place!{page}Townsperson
...Not that I can do anything about it.

74A951.text:
Emperor's Soldier
A curfew is in force across the kingdom!{page}Emperor's Soldier
Stay indoors unless you have business outside!

74A9AC.text:
Emperor's Soldier
Arcadia is under the emperor's control!{page}Emperor's Soldier
Anyone who defies us will be arrested!

74AA0D.text:
Emperor's Soldier
Civilians are forbidden to go outside!

74AA47.text:
Bartender
The kingdom fell so easily... And now this curfew.{page}Bartender
It's killing my business.

74AAB2.text:
Townsperson
Another war... I haven't got long left, but my grandchildren do.{page}Townsperson
Will they grow up in peace?

74AB2B.text:
Zoid Pilot
The emperor's army took the castle while the Republic and{page}Zoid Pilot
the Empire were busy glaring at each other...

74AB90.text:
Roman
Prince... Whatever happens, stay alive.

74ABC9.text:
Roman
...Oh, yes! Let me teach you this tactic!

74AC10.text:
Townsperson
Welcome! Oh... Sorry, no children in the tavern,{page}Townsperson
even with an adult.

74AC63.text:
Townsperson
We stand against the Empire, but they're far stronger than we{page}Townsperson
are. If war breaks out, this area will be abandoned.

74ACDA.text:
Townsperson
We're on the border between the Helic Republic and the Guylos{page}Townsperson
Empire. There's a ceasefire now, so we can relax.

74AD53.text:
Researcher
Which Zoid should I build next...?

74AD8B.text:
Townsperson
This has always been a Rare Hertz zone.{page}Townsperson
When I was young, Zoids used to go berserk all the time.

74ADF6.text:
Townsperson
See that volcano over there? That's Mount Ossa.{page}Townsperson
The Republic has a fortress there.

74AE5D.text:
Townsperson
Rare Hertz is a strange, harmful wave that drives Zoids mad.{page}Townsperson
Pulse Guards can block some of it these days.

74AEC8.text:
Townsperson
The southern desert's a Rare Hertz zone.{page}Townsperson
Pulse Guards aren't foolproof, so I'd stay away.

74AF2F.text:
Townsperson
Mount Ossa is the Republic's last line of defense.{page}Townsperson
Get past it, and the capital's right there.

74AF96.text:
Townsperson
There's no place like this town...

74AFC9.text:
Townsperson
Mount Ossa's an active volcano.{page}Townsperson
It still erupts now and then. It's quite a sight at night.

74B028.text:
Townsperson
You youngsters traveling?{page}Townsperson
There's not much here, but stay and rest a while.

74B085.text:
Townsperson
I heard there was a skirmish at Red River...{page}Townsperson
Are we heading for another war?

74B0EC.text:
Zoid Pilot
Hmph. The Republic and the Empire are at it again,{page}Zoid Pilot
and everyone here acts like nothing's wrong.

74B14D.text:
Researcher
Which Zoid should I build next...?

74B185.text:
Townsperson
Prince {player} gathered the kingdom's troops and rose{page}Townsperson
up against the enemy!

74B1C5.text:
Townsperson
Prince {player}'s alive!{page}Townsperson
If only we knew the king and queen were safe, too...

74B21F.text:
Townsperson
Prince {player}'s raised an army against the emperor!{page}Townsperson
How cool is that?!

74B26F.text:
Townsperson
I heard Prince {player} formed a royal army.{page}Townsperson
Will our town turn into a battlefield, too...?

74B2C7.text:
Boy
I'm going to fight alongside Prince {player}!

74B2F4.text:
Girl
Daddy was a soldier at the castle.{page}Girl
But he hasn't come home... I wish he'd hurry back.

74B35D.text:
Bartender
Prince {player}'s raised an army!{page}Bartender
Drinks are on the house today! Drink up!

74B3BD.text:
Roman
Prince {player}! I've heard the news!{page}Roman
This old man's rooting for you, even if I can't join you.

74B41F.text:
Zoid Pilot
The prince of Arcadia's formed a royal army, eh?{page}Zoid Pilot
Still a kid, and already doing all that. Good for him!

74B488.text:
Townsperson
Right! I'm joining the royal army too!{page}Townsperson
Think the girls will swoon over me then?

74B4F1.text:
Imperial Soldier
Bases along the border keep getting attacked.{page}Imperial Soldier
We finally had peace, too... What a mess.

74B566.text:
Imperial Soldier
The war ended after His Majesty Rudolph took the{page}Imperial Soldier
throne. We're less busy now, but I'm grateful for it.

74B5D7.text:
Townsperson
His Majesty Rudolph takes his{page}Townsperson
duties seriously for someone so{page}Townsperson
young. He's still at an age when he should be playing.

74B63A.text:
Townsperson
The Guylos Empire's changed since Rudolph took the throne.{page}Townsperson
For the better, of course. You can't beat peace.

74B6AF.text:
Townsperson
The war's over, and my boys came home safely.{page}Townsperson
That's all I ever wanted.

74B708.text:
Townsperson
The Guardian Force! An elite unit that protects the peace!{page}Townsperson
I wish I could join... Maybe I should enlist.

74B76F.text:
Townsperson
This is just a sleepy border town,{page}Townsperson
but Guygalos is a real city! I'd love to visit, just once.

74B7DE.text:
Townsperson
Our Guylos Empire will grow more prosperous than ever!{page}Townsperson
With Emperor Rudolph leading us, how could it not?

74B84D.text:
Bartender
Welcome. Passing through? There's not much here,{page}Bartender
but it's peaceful. Make yourself at home.

74B8BA.text:
Zoid Pilot
War's over. So much for the mercenary business.{page}Zoid Pilot
Maybe I'll have to start hauling cargo.

74B90F.text:
Zoid Pilot
I thought I'd find work in the Guylos Empire...{page}Zoid Pilot
Seems I wasn't the only one. Know anyone who's hiring?

74B994.text:
Waitress
Welcome! Please take any empty seat.

74B9E1.text:
Townsperson
The waitress here is cute,{page}Townsperson
but you should see the ones in Guygalos!

74BA40.text:
Townsperson
Long live the Guylos Empire! Long live Emperor Rudolph!{page}Townsperson
And three cheers for our lovely waitress!

74BAAD.text:
Imperial Soldier
His Majesty sent our First Armored Division to secure the{page}Imperial Soldier
border. We certainly didn't expect this on arrival...

74BB24.text:
Imperial Soldier
Our commander has His Majesty's full trust.{page}Imperial Soldier

75380E.text: You must think I'm a pushover.

75383A.text: I wanted to see Mount Iselina...

7538DA.text: Heh heh. Where are you aiming?

753B26.text: You think you can hit Leena?!

753C70.text: Nobody beats me in a turn!

753D00.text: I've still got a lot to learn...

753DB6.text: How can you miss so often?

753DFC.text: Born to be king... and I lost?!

753E2B.text: I can't go home in disgrace...

753E75.text: Missed! I'm destined to be king!

7540EE.text: I prefer shooting to getting shot!

754119.text: This Zoid can't keep up with me?

754148.text: I'm losing?! To the likes of you?!

754177.text: Beat me with such poor skill?!

754257.text: So this is the Zoid's limit...

7542D7.text: You thought that would hit me?

75433E.text: Insects! Do you want to die?!

75460E.text: You won't hit me that easily!

75472E.text: What?! I am the Death Saurer!

7547EF.text: Looks like this is as far as I go...

754839.text: Ho ho! Your aim is 0.3 left.

754938.text: I can't face the Judge now!

754963.text: If I lose, the Judge will hate me!

754B1A.text: Ha ha ha! Missed! You missed!

7551EF.text: Damn it! I've still got fight left!

755227.text: Damn! Beaten here of all places!

755309.text: Damn! They got the upper hand?!

755364.text: Too easy! Where are you aiming?!

7553A4.text: What did you do to that Zoid?!

755401.text: Watch out! What are you doing?!

755436.text: Aw, you got me a little.

75546E.text: Heh heh. This looks like fun.

755558.text: Ala Barone won't die from this!

75579C.text: Don't let the Republic outdo us!

755922.text: I refuse to lose to you maggots!
